title: Service Instructor
description:
**Join our team as a Service Instructor in commercial cleaning in the Kemi and Tornio area!**

Are you an experienced cleaning professional interested in a guiding role where you can support your teams daily work and help ensure high-quality service delivery? At N-Clean, we work responsibly as part of a reliable and supportive team.

As a Service Instructor, you will work under the supervision of your manager and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at customer sites. You will work responsibly and ensure that tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with agreed quality standards and operating practices. Acting as a key link between employees, management, and customers, you will support your supervisor in daily operations. Please note that this role does not include formal managerial responsibilities.

Customer service plays a central role in this position, and success requires a customer-oriented mindset and strong interpersonal skills. In your role, you will have a direct impact on the customer experience and the success of customer relationships. Active collaboration, clear communication, and a solution-oriented approach are essential for this position.

**Your responsibilities include**

- Ensuring the quality and smooth execution of daily cleaning operations, planning work allocation, and utilizing resources cost-effectively

- Continuously developing operations together with your supervisor and actively contributing improvement ideas

- Guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- Collaborating with customers

- Regular participation in practical cleaning work


**What we expect from you**

- Ability to guide and support colleagues in daily situations, promote an inclusive and respectful work environment, and provide clear feedback

- Strong organizational skills and a proactive approach

- A customer-focused working style and positive attitude

- Ability to work under pressure and solve problems effectively

- Communication skills in Finnish or English, both spoken and written. Language skills are important in this guiding role to ensure clear communication, understanding of work instructions, safe working practices, and management of employment-related matters. If one language is fluent, the other can be at a basic working level. We value a diverse workplace where different languages and cultural backgrounds are seen as strengths.

- If you are not a Finnish citizen, you must have a valid work permit

- A valid driver's license and the possibility to use your own car, as the working area is extensive and the role requires travel between sites

- Previous experience in cleaning services. Knowledge of commercial cleaning and cleaning industry qualifications are considered an advantage


**What we offer**

- A permanent full-time employment contract, 37.5 hours per week

- Shifts on weekdays and weekends, including early morning, morning, daytime, and evening shifts

- Start date to be agreed upon separately

- Comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy

- Fair employment terms, a safe working environment, and support for employee well-being

- Competitive salary in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Property Services Employees, €2,235/month


**Equality and Responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and respectfully and do not tolerate discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to maintaining a safe and well-being-focused workplace.

**Did you know?**

People enjoy working at N-Clean. Our employee Net Promoter Score (eNPS) is an outstanding **55**. This is reflected in the way we value one another and in our ability to work and succeed together.

N-Clean has been recognized in the HUMAN POWER competition for several consecutive years, reflecting our long-term commitment to creating a people-centered and responsible working life. In 2024, we were named the Most Human-Centric Workplace, and in 2025, we achieved 3rd place overall and 3rd place in Finland's Most Human-Centric Working Life Act category. These recognitions highlight our people-focused recruitment approach, where meaningful encounters, respect, and an excellent candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do.

**Join our top team!**

**Submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 8 October 2026.**

Please note that we review applications during the application period and may close the recruitment process before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

Applications are accepted only through the application form on our website.

title: Service Instructor
description:
**Come Work With Us as a Service Instructor in Commercial Cleaning Services in Joensuu**

Are you a cleaning services professional interested in a coordinating role where you can support your team's daily work and help ensure high-quality service delivery? With us, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

As a Service Instructor, you will work under the supervision of a manager and play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at customer sites. You will work responsibly and ensure that all tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with agreed quality standards and operating procedures. You will act as a key link between employees, management, and customers, supporting your supervisor in daily operations. However, the position does not include formal supervisory responsibility.

Customer service plays a central role in this position, and success requires a customer-oriented mindset and strong communication skills. In your role, you will directly influence the customer experience and the smoothness of customer relationships, making active collaboration, clear communication, and a solution-focused approach essential.

**Your responsibilities will include:**

- Ensuring the quality of daily cleaning operations, planning work allocation, and using resources in a cost-conscious manner

- Continuously developing operations together with your supervisor and actively contributing improvement ideas

- Guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- Customer cooperation and communication

- Regular participation in practical cleaning work


**We expect you to have:**

- Experience in cleaning work and knowledge of commercial cleaning services

- The ability to guide and support a work community in everyday situations, promote an equal and respectful work atmosphere, and provide clear feedback

- Strong organizational skills and a proactive attitude

- A customer-focused approach and positive mindset

- The ability to work under pressure and solve problems effectively

- Fluent spoken and written Finnish language skills

- A valid work permit if you are not a Finnish citizen

- A valid driver's license and access to a car, as the work area is extensive and the role requires travel between sites

- Previous experience in team guidance or supervisory roles and/or relevant industry education will be considered an advantage


**What we offer:**

- A permanent full-time employment contract, 37.5 hours per week

- Shifts primarily on weekdays in early morning hours starting from 6:00 a.m. Flexibility to work different shifts, including weekends when needed, is appreciated

- A start date to be agreed upon together

- Comprehensive onboarding through our renewed Onboarding Path and N-Clean Academy

- Fair employment terms, a safe working environment, and support for employee wellbeing

- Competitive compensation according to the collective agreement for the property services industry: €2,235/month (or €13.88/hour for part-time positions)


**Equality and Responsibility**

Every employee is important to us. We treat everyone equally and with respect, and we do not tolerate discrimination in any form. We operate responsibly and are committed to maintaining a safe and healthy work community.

**Did You Know?**

At N-Clean, people enjoy working. Our employee eNPS score is an outstanding **55**. This is reflected in our daily work through mutual respect and a genuine commitment to succeeding together.

N-Clean has achieved success in the HUMAN POWER competition for several years, demonstrating our long-term commitment to developing a people-centered and responsible working life. In 2024, we were selected as Finland's Most Human-Centric Workplace. In 2025, we placed third in the competition and also achieved third place in the Most Human-Centric Working Life Initiative category. This recognition reflects our people-centered recruitment approach, where meeting people, appreciation, and a great candidate experience are at the heart of everything we do.

**Join Our Top Team!**

**Submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 8 October 2026.**

Please note that we review applications during the application period, and the recruitment process may be closed before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

Applications are accepted only through the application form available on our website.

title: Lähihoitaja, Pispan kotihoito
description:
Pispan kotihoidossa on asiakkaita noin 130 neljässä eri hoitotiimissä. Moniammatillisen työyhteisömme yhteinen tavoite on tarjota asiakkaillemme laadukasta hoitoa ja tukea heidän omannäköistä arkeaan kotona. Hyödynnämme työssämme aktiivisesti hyvinvointiteknologiaa ja kehitämme kotihoidon palveluja yhdessä. Kotihoidon tavoitteena on edistää asiakkaan kokonaisvaltaista perusturvallisuutta, kuntoutumista sekä arjessa selviytymistä.

Lähihoitajana teet tärkeää työtä kohdatessasi asiakkaan hänen omassa kodissaan ja mahdollistamalla hänen selviytymisensä arjessa. Työsi on itsenäistä, liikkuvaa ja päivät ovat erilaisia. Kotihoidossa tehtäviisi kuuluu mm. lääkehoito, kirjaaminen sekä muut monipuoliset ja ihmisläheiset hoito- ja hoivatyöt. Jokapäiväisessä käytössämme on myös työtä tukevaa teknologiaa, kuten lääkeautomaatteja ja kuvapuhelimia.

Miksi hakea meille?
Saat meillä hyvän perehdytyksen sekä tuen työkavereilta ja esihenkilöltä.
Pystyt vaikuttamaan omiin työvuoroihisi, jotta vapaa-ajan ja työn yhdistäminen olisi mutkatonta.
Tarjoamme hyvät työsuhde-edut kuten vuosittaisen liikunta-, kulttuuri-, työmatka- ja hyvinvointiedun Epassilla, työnantajan lounasedun ja tyhy- sekä Virkisty Vapaalla ry:n toimintaa.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?
Olet nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja (sosiaalihuolto) tai perushoitaja.
Puhut ja kirjoitat sujuvasti suomea.
Sinulla on B-luokan ajokortti, auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi. Käytössämme on leasing-autoja ja sähköpyöriä helpottamaan kulkemista asiakaskohteidemme välillä.
Sinulla on LOVe - lääkehoidon verkkotesti suoritettuna hyväksytysti (LOVe LOP, PKV, KIPU1, GER 1). Tarvittaessa voit suorittaa lääkehoidon osaamisen myös työpaikalla, heti työsuhteen alussa.
Katsomme eduksi aiemman työkokemuksen kotihoidosta.

Aloitus tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan. Toivomme, että voit aloittaa tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian. Tehtävä on määräaikainen 31.12.2026 asti. Koeaika on puolet työsuhteen kestosta. Työaika on kokoaikatyö, keskimäärin 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa. Työhön sisältyy aamu- ja iltavuoroja. Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 4 momentin mukainen rikosrekisteriote ennen työsuhteen alkamista. Lisäksi suosittelemme vahvasti tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 §:n mukaista rokotesuojaa.

Pispa on rempseä ja huumorilla höystetty tiimi, joka ottaa avoimesti vastaan uusia työntekijöitä. Jätä hakemuksesi Kuntarekryssä heti, haastattelemme jo hakuajalla!

title: POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
description:
POSTDOCTORAL OR DOCTORAL RESEARCHER IN PHOTOCATALYTIC RADICAL CHEMISTRY
The University of Helsinki, Department of Chemistry, invites applications for a postdoctoral or doctoral researcher position in photocatalytic radical chemistry at the newly established Lahdenperä Group. Initially, the position is fixed-term for 12-months with a possibility of an extension.
Position description
The successful candidate will join an organic chemistry research group at the Department of Chemistry located at Kumpula campus. The research group aims to develop new concepts for controlling radical reactivity in photocatalytic transformations. The project focuses on the development of new approaches for controlling radical reactivity through hydrogen atom transfer (HAT) at surfaces and interfaces.
The project will involve:
* Development and optimisation of photocatalytic radical transformations
* Mechanistic studies of radical reactions and detailed investigation of HAT processes.
* Surface functionalization and interface chemistry.
* Design and synthesis of organic molecules.

The postdoctoral researcher will additionally be expected to contribute to the supervision of students and participate in future funding applications.
Requirements
Postdoctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a PhD degree in chemistry or a closely related field by the start of employment, or be close to completion of their doctoral studies.
Consideration will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas:
* synthetic organic chemistry.
* photocatalysis, radical chemistry, hydrogen atom transfer processes.
* reaction mechanism studies.
* flow chemistry.

The successful candidate should demonstrate the ability to conduct independent research and publish scientific results in international peer-reviewed journals.
Doctoral Researcher
Applicants must hold a Master's degree (or equivalent) in chemistry or a closely related discipline that qualifies them for doctoral studies at the University of Helsinki.
Previous experience in organic synthesis, photochemistry, catalysis or related experimental chemistry is advantageous but not required.
Selected candidates for the interview process will be required to provide a copy of their university transcript before interview date.
For both positions
We are looking for candidates who are:
* highly motivated and scientifically curious.
* willing to develop new experimental skills.
* persistent and independent in tackling challenging research questions.

Excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.
Salary and benefits
The salary follows the salary system of University salary system and is based on the researcher's qualifications, experience, and stage of doctoral or postdoctoral career.
For postdoctoral researchers, the starting salary will be approximately 3900–4200 €/month.
For doctoral researcher the starting salary will be approximately 2600–2800 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
A diverse and equitable study and work culture is important to the University of Helsinki. That is why we do our best to promote an inclusive university community. We encourage all qualified applicants from different gender identities, linguistic and cultural backgrounds, and minorities to apply for the position. You can read about the accessibility and inclusivity of our university via this link.
How to apply
Applications should include:
* Curriculum vitae, including a publication list (if applicable).
* A concise motivation letter describing your research interests, relevant experience, reasons for applying and career plans. Please indicate your desired starting date in the application.
* Degree certificate (PhD for postdoctoral applicants; Master's degree for doctoral researcher applicants).

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
The deadline for applications is October 16th, 2026.
Ideally, the selected candidate will start as soon as possible, although flexibility in the starting date can be arranged. Regardless, candidates who are unable to start immediately are still encouraged to apply. The selected applicants will be given support to apply for available grants or fellowships.
Review of applications will begin immediately and continue until a suitable candidate is found. Interviews may start before closing date 16.10.2026.
Additional information
Further information about the position can be obtained from Dr. Antti Lahdenperä, antti.sk.lahdenpera@helsinki.fi.

title: Telecom Core Network Expert (PS Core / CS Core)
description:
This is a temporary, project-based assignment supporting a leading telecom consultancy in a mobile core network performance audit. The role is ideal for an experienced consultant, freelancer, or senior telecom professional looking for an interesting short-term engagement with high-impact work.

We are looking for a Senior Telecom Core Network Expert to join a demanding international network audit project through Barona IT Talent.

About the Assignment

You will support a team conducting a comprehensive audit of a mobile operator's core network environment. Your role is to act as a senior subject matter expert, helping identify bottlenecks, analyze root causes, and provide concrete technical recommendations.

The project is expected to start during October and run for approximately two months. The work can be performed primarily remotely, with potential limited travel if required.

We are open to finding:

- One expert with both PS Core and CS Core expertise,
- or Two specialists covering the respective domains separately.

Responsibilities

Depending on your area of expertise, your work may include:

PS Core Network Audit

- Auditing GPRS/EPC core network architecture and performance Analyzing SGSN, MME, GGSN, SGW and PGW performance
- Assessing interfaces, capacity, redundancy and security
- Evaluating DNS and IP backbone implementations
- Reviewing legacy and cloud-native core deployments
- Investigating alarms, faults, logs and performance KPIs
- Analyzing user mobility and session management performance

CS Core Network Audit

- Auditing Circuit Switched Core architecture and topology
- Assessing MSC, MGW, HLR, HSS and related core elements
- Reviewing traffic routing principles and signalling performance
- Analyzing capacity, utilization and service quality KPIs
- Evaluating virtualized and legacy core implementation
- Supporting fault analysis and network optimization recommendations

You will work closely with experienced audit professionals while providing expert guidance throughout the analysis and reporting phases.

What We Are Looking For

We expect you to have:

Extensive experience with (#Ericsson) mobile core networks (2G/3G/4G/5G environments)

- Strong expertise in either PS Core, CS Core, or both
- Knowledge of both legacy and virtualized/cloud-based core network architectures
- Proven ability to identify network issues, bottlenecks and performance challenges
- Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities
- Previous experience in telecom consulting, auditing, or operator network assessments
- Ability to work independently and provide actionable recommendations
- Professional-level English communication skills
Experience working directly with mobile operators is considered a strong advantage.

What We Offer

- Flexible remote working model
- Collaboration with leading telecom experts
- An interesting, specialist-level project assignment
- Possibility to participate in similar future assignments based on project needs and performance
Interested?

Submit your CV and wanted information to our candidate database as soon as possible. We review candidates continuously and aim to identify suitable specialists quickly.

More information arja.martikainen@barona.fi

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Tyks Psykiatrian varahenkilöstö, Turku
description:
Nyt siihen tarjoutuu mahdollisuus, kun meillä on haettavana sairaanhoitajan toimi Psykiatrian tulosryhmän keväällä perustetussa varahenkilöstössä!

Psykiatrian tulosryhmään perustettiin 11 sairaanhoitajan uusi varahenkilöstö keväällä -26, jonka tavoitteena on vastata akuutteihin poissaoloihin psykiatrian eri osastoilla. Tarkoituksena on lyhytaikaisten sijaisuuksien paikkaaminen ammattitaitoisella ja psykiatrista kokemusta omaavilla sairaanhoitajilla.

Tehtäväsi

Varahenkilöstössä työskentelevät sairaanhoitajat muodostavat oman yksikön eli nimettyjä kotiosastoja varahenkilöillä ei ole. Varahenkilöt varataan Respa-varausjärjestelmän avulla eri yksiköihin ja toimintaa koordinoivat varahenkilöstön osastonhoitaja yhteistyössä osastojen esihenkilöiden ja vuorovastaavien kanssa. Sairaanhoitajat työskentelevät 3-vuorotyössä ja heillä on käytössä autonominen työvuorosuunnittelu. Osastot sijaitsevat Tyks kantasairaalan alueella Kompassisairaalassa ja rakennuksessa 11 sekä Mäntymäen sairaala-alueella Kupittaan sairaalassa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Pääset mukaan rakentamaan ja kehittämään psykiatrian tulosryhmän keväällä 2026 perustettua varahenkilöstöä, jonka tehtävänä on tukea psykiatrian osastoja akuuteissa henkilöstötarpeissa. Työssäsi saat hyödyntää psykiatrista osaamistasi monipuolisesti eri osastoilla ja tutustua laajasti psykiatrian toimintaympäristöihin sekä erilaisiin potilasryhmiin.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuoroihisi autonomisen työvuorosuunnittelun avulla sekä työn, jossa kehittämiselle, uuden oppimiselle ja ammatilliselle kasvulle on aitoa tilaa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Jos nautit vaihtuvista työyhteisöistä ja pystyt heittäytymään erilaisiin työympäristöihin, siedät epävarmuutta sekä koet erilaisten potilasryhmien kanssa työskentelyn ammatillisesti antoisaksi, niin tämä paikka on juuri sopiva sinulle.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) mukainen sairaanhoitajan laillistus.

Lisäksi toivomme kehittämis- ja kehittymismyönteisyyttä, sillä tavoittelemme toimivaa ja pysyvää uutta rakennetta psykiatrian osastojen tueksi.

Lisäksi edellytetään hyvää suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa. Ruotsin kielen taidosta on etua.

Eduksi luetaan kokemus psykiatrisesta osastohoidosta.

Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta ja innostut monipuolisesta työstä psykiatrian eri osastoilla, hae mukaan rakentamaan psykiatrian varahenkilöstön toimintaa. Odotamme hakemustasi!

title: Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer
description:
**OPEN CALL FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST FOR SECONDED NATIONAL EXPERTS AT THE EUROPEAN CHEMICALS AGENCY (ECHA), HELSINKI**

Seconded National Experts (SNEs) are drawn from the civil services of EU countries. They bring their unique skills and knowledge to ECHA for a period of time before taking the experience acquired during their stay at the Agency back to their home administration.

ECHA offers job opportunities for **Seconded National Experts (SNEs)** in the following profile:

**Profile Reference:** ECHA/SNE/2026/002

**Profile Title:** Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer

**1\. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS**

Candidates for secondment must:

· Have current employment in the national, regional or local public sector or international civil service. Alternatively candidates may be employed in a non-profit or voluntary sector;

· Hold a university degree in a field relevant to the areas of work described in this call;

· Be a national of an EU or EFTA Member State or a candidate country as decided by the Council;

· Be able to communicate in written and spoken English as this is the working language of ECHA.

**2\. SECONDMENT**

The secondment will be subject to an exchange of letters between the Head of People and Development of ECHA and the applicants employer. The duration of the first secondment is a maximum of one year. This period may be renewed for a maximum of three additional years.

Seconded National Experts remain in the service of their employer throughout the period of their secondment. The sending organisation must continue remunerating the SNE, who will thus benefit from social security coverage. During their secondment, SNEs will receive subsistence allowances and reimbursement of expenses as set out in the Rules on the secondment of national experts to the European Chemicals Agency (Decision ED-0050).

The SNE Rules

**3\. PROFILE**

**Seconded National Expert – Communications Officer; ref.: ECHA/SNE/2026/002**

Our ideal candidate is a communications professional with experience gained working in a national authority, national ministry, European institution or European agency. Comfortable in a changing environment, you are adaptable, resilient and have good interpersonal and networking skills. You are curious about developments in your field and communications more broadly.

The Unit is responsible for ECHAs communications activities, including press relations, external and internal communications, social media, digital communications and its website. We focus on delivering professional proactive, clear and strategic communications services, that support the Agency's activities and promote ECHAs work and achievements.

**Job description**:

The Seconded National Expert will work in the Communications Unit – G3.

The Communications Officer will contribute to the Units daily interaction with internal and external stakeholders. The jobholder will also be responsible for relations with internal business areas on specific regulatory topics in support of ECHAs external communications strategy. The role for this profile will be assigned according to the Units needs and the jobholders competencies.

Duties will include, depending on needs:

**External Communications:**

Drafting press releases, briefings, speeches etc.;

Developing content for ECHAs website;

Dealing with press queries, interviews and briefings;

Supporting senior management with media appearances;

Organizing and supporting events for external stakeholders;

Support the production of webinars and videos;

Support the management of the Agency's corporate communication channels and social media presence; ,

Acting as a spokesperson when required; and

Working with colleagues across ECHA to determine communication priorities and key messages to be delivered to internal and external stakeholders.

**Internal Communications:**

Cooperating with colleagues in determining communications priorities;

Content development for ECHAs Intranet;

Organizing and supporting internal staff events; and

General support to internal communication initiatives.

**Project Work**

The Unit is responsible for a number of ECHA wide projects, where input may be required, including:

Building a new website;

Implementing the new ECHA corporate identity;

ECHAs 2027 Conference – 20-21 May 2027;

ECHAs 20th Anniversary 1 June 2027-31 May 2028;

Chairing the EU Agencies Heads of Communications & Information Network – 1 March 2027-28 February 2028;

**Requirements:**

Successful completion of a full course of university studies attested by a degree, where the normal duration of university education is three (3) years or more.

Of your total professional experience, at least one (1) year must be in a field or fields relevant to the areas of work mentioned above e.g. for example, external/internal communications or stakeholder relations.

Only qualifications issued by EU Member State authorities or EEA authorities and qualifications recognised as equivalent by the relevant EU or EEA Member State authorities will be accepted.

**Selection criteria:**

If you meet the requirements set out above, you will be assessed on the basis of the following selection criteria. The candidates who are judged to be the most suitable on the basis of the selection criteria will be invited to a (remote) interview.

The following will be considered as **assets**:

· Ability to communicate effectively in English at all levels both orally and in writing;

· Experience of working in a communications/stakeholder relations function in a complex regulatory environment; and

· Demonstrated understanding of the link between your current experience, the Communications Officers role and ECHAs strategic priorities.

title: Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technician
description:
Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy is establishing its Finnish operations in Hyvinkää for the import, storage, logistics, sales and rental of professional scaffolding systems and related equipment.

The Hyvinkää site includes approximately 10,000 m² of operating and storage area, approximately 300 m² of covered shed/workshop space, and additional container-based storage.

We are recruiting two Scaffolding Equipment Maintenance & Logistics Technicians to support and manage the daily handling, inspection, maintenance, storage and inventory control of scaffolding equipment.

This is a technical logistics role requiring previous experience with scaffolding, construction equipment or comparable technical products.

Main responsibilities

\- Receiving, unloading and checking incoming deliveries.

\- Identifying scaffolding components and verifying quantities against shipment documents.

\- Inspecting equipment for damage, wear and defects.

\- Carrying out maintenance, repair and basic metalwork where required.

\- Organising scaffolding equipment in the yard, covered areas and storage containers.

\- Maintaining stock and inventory records.

\- Preparing and loading customer deliveries.

\- Maintaining tools, workshop and storage areas.

\- Supporting the development of warehouse and maintenance processes.

\- Following occupational safety and company procedures.

International coordination

The role includes regular communication with Affix manufacturing, sourcing, supply-chain and back-office teams outside Finland, including teams in India. Coordination may relate to shipments, packing lists, product codes, quality issues, damaged equipment, stock discrepancies, replacement components and delivery planning. Previous experience working with international manufacturing, logistics, sourcing, supply-chain or back-office teams is therefore important.

Required experience and skills

\- Relevant experience with scaffolding, construction equipment, structural-metal products or comparable technical equipment.

\- Experience in inspection, maintenance, repair, warehousing or logistics.

\- Ability to identify components and understand product compatibility.

\- Experience maintaining stock or inventory records.

\- Ability to read shipment and product documentation.

\- Sufficient English for daily international communication.

\- Ability to work independently and perform physically demanding work.

Considered an advantage

\- Experience with Ringlock, Cuplock or similar scaffolding systems.

\- Scaffolding-industry experience.

\- Metalworking or welding skills.

\- Forklift experience.

\- Experience with warehouse-management systems.

\- Car driving licence (Category B).

\- Experience in international import, export or container logistics.

Pre-employment requirement

\- A drug test will be conducted before a final job offer is made.

What we offer

\- Permanent, full-time employment.

\- A key role in establishing Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy's Finnish warehouse, maintenance and logistics operations.

\- International cooperation with Affix teams abroad.

\- Employment terms in accordance with Finnish legislation and the Commerce Sector Collective Agreement.

title: ERP Service Manager – Wärtsilä
description:
About the role

In this role, you will take ownership of the day-to-day operational cadence of Wärtsiläs ERP Application Development (Minor Enhancements). Following a major ERP transformation, our development machinery is accelerating, and we need a hands-on ERP Service Manager to act as the key operational glue between internal business workgroups and our external development partner.

You will manage the daily operations of enhancement requests, keeping monthly planning cycles, 1-month sprints, and SAP release dates strictly on track. Your primary focus will be supporting Wärtsilä's organization in operational delivery and ensuring our external offshore partner achieves high throughput and quality.

What can we offer to you
- Permanent and full-time work contract as Academic Work consultant at Wärtsilä
- Salary: about 4,000–6,000 EUR/month based on your background and skillset. For highly experienced candidates, a higher salary level may also be negotiated.
- Impactful role: You will play a central part in running the critical ERP development engine of a global listed company.
- Flexibility: We offer a possibility to hybrid work. Preferred office is Helsinki, but offices also in Turku and Vaasa.
- International environment: Opportunity to work in a diverse, global team and continuously improve ways of working.

Work tasks

You will ensure that the development engine runs like clockwork, driving operational accountability across functional teams and external vendor resources.
- Overseeing daily operational development activities and sprint cadences across functional workgroups (e.g., Sales, Logistics, Finance).
- Managing the operations for enhancement requests (ServiceNow) delivery from planning to release.
- Supporting the monthly planning sessions, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release readiness checks.
- Serving as Wärtsilä's operational interface toward the external application development lead and offshore development team.
- Managing the development team capacity based on agreed allocations.
- Tracking the application development KPIs to continuously optimize throughput.

We are looking for

Mandatory requirements:
- Strong track record in a Service Manager, Delivery Manager, or similar operational lead role within IT or ERP environments.
- Hands-on experience with agile delivery methodologies, sprint management, and release cadences.
- Proven capability in managing external IT service providers and vendor deliverables.
- Excellent written and spoken English language skills.

Considered as an advantage:
- Experience in working with Indian offshore development partners and managing cross-cultural vendor environments.
- General understanding of SAP environments (e.g., S/4HANA, Fiori, BTP) and release management concepts.
- Finnish language skills.

Who succeeds in this role:

You are an organized, resilient, and proactive coordinator who takes full ownership of outcomes. You possess the assertiveness to challenge vendors on deliverables while remaining a constructive, supportive partner to internal stakeholders.

Recruitment timeline:
- Interviews with Academic Work: Weeks 39-40
- Interviews at Wärtsilä: Week 41
- Final decisions: Weeks 41-42

Practicalities
- Location and remote work policy: Primarily Helsinki (Salmisaari), but Vaasa or Turku are also possible. Hybrid model.
- Background checks: The selected candidate will undergo a standard security clearance (turvallisuusselvitys) by Finnish Security Intelligence Service.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Semestervikariat för närvårdare, Majbergets servicehem (Borgå)
description:
**Östra Nylands välfärdsområde söker NÄRVÅRDARE för semestervikariat av olika längd för tiden 8.10.2026 – 30.4.2027. Arbetsuppgifterna är förlagda till Majbergets servicehem i Borgå.**

Majbergets servicehem är ett servicehus med dygnet runt vård, där det huvudsakligen bor äldre med minnessjukdomar. Vi har sammanlagt 60 boenden i fyra olika grupphem. Vi gör miljön och deras omgivning så hemtrevlig som möjlig samt tar i helhet hand om deras välmående. Vi erbjuder dig trevliga kolleger och omsorgsfull introduktion. Vi satsar på arbetshälsa och säkerhet.

Vi uppskattar din förmåga att möjliggöra en personlig och god vardag för våra boenden genom att beakta deras individuella behov och önskemål. Vi förutsätter flexibilitet, en ansvarsfull attityd, samarbetsförmåga och en förmåga att fungera som medlem i en multiprofessionell arbetsgrupp. Vi uppskattar också erfarenhet av arbete med äldre, men det är inte en nödvändighet, eftersom just du kan vara vårt nya, stigande vårdproffs!

Om du identifierade dessa egenskaper hos dig själv, ta tag i den här intressanta möjligheten!

**Behörighetsvillkor** är närvårdarexamen eller tidigare primärskötarexamen samt registrering i registret över yrkesutbildade personer inom socialvården (JulkiSuosikki). I uppgifterna krävs goda muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i finska eller svenska. Om det inte finns sökande som uppfyller behörighetsvillkoren beaktar vi också närvårdarstuderande i rekryteringen. För studerande förutsätter vi ett studieutdrag.

Anställningsvillkoren följer arbets- och tjänstekollektivavtalet för social- och hälsovårdssektorn (SH-avtalet. Arbetet görs i två skift. De uppgiftsrelaterade lönerna för behöriga närvårdare är 2746,46 euro/månad, uppgiften tillämpas prövotid.

I uppgiften krävs vaccinationsskydd enligt smittskyddslagen § 48 samt tuberkulosutredning enligt smittskyddslagen § 55. I arbetsavtalsförhållanden som är längre än tre månader ska den som anställts förete ett straffregisterutdrag enligt lagen om tillsynen över social- och hälsovården (741/2023) innan arbetet påbörjas.

Sänd din ansökan så fort som möjligt, men senast 7.10.2026 kl. 13.00. Vi intervjuar och anställer redan under ansökningstiden. Närmare upplysningar ger chef för Majbergets servicehus Mathilda Rosenqvist, tel. 040 358 9922 eller mathilda.rosenqvist@itauusimaa.fi.

title: Bid Manager (Junior), VR Fleetcare
description:
**Etsimme sinua**

Me Clevryllä etsimme asiakkaallemme, VR FleetCarelle, Bid Manageria (junior) heidän toimipisteelleen Helsingin Ilmalaan. Tehtävä on määräaikainen 31.12.2026 saakka ja tulet työllistymään tehtävään Clevryn kautta. Aloitus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Bid Managerina työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä työparisi kanssa tarjoten teknistä tukea tarjousprosessien läpivientiin. Tehtävässä tulkitaan teknisiä dokumentteja ja piirustuksia, tarkistetaan toimittajien tarjouksia ja osallistutaan kustannusarvioiden valmisteluun. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös erinäisiä projektinhallinnan ja -koordinoinnin tehtäviä.

Tämä rooli sopii erinomaisesti teknisen koulutuksen omaavalle henkilölle, jolla on jo aikaisempaa kokemusta projektityöskentelystä esim. suunnittelun tai teknisen asiantuntijatyön kautta. Raideliikenteen tai muun raskaan teollisuuden toimintaympäristön tuntemus on iso etu.

**Pääasialliset vastuut**

- Tarjousprosessien läpivienti sen eri vaiheissa, tekninen tuki

- Projektinhallinnan tehtävät, kustannusarvioiden valmistelu

- Yhteistyö muiden sidosryhmien kanssa


**Odotamme sinulta**

- Teknisen alan koulutusta (yliopisto, AMK)

- Kokemusta projektinhallintatyöskentelystä sekä kykyä tulkita teknisiä dokumentteja raskaan teollisuuden toimialalla

- Suomen ja englannin kielitaitoja


**Asiakasyritys**

Me VR FleetCarella tarjoamme asiakkaillemme raidekaluston- ja ratainfran tehokasta huoltoa, kunnossapitoa ja modernisointia pohjoismaissa sekä Baltian alueella. Olemme raideliikenteen asiantuntijayritys, jonka taustalla on 160 vuoden kokemus alasta pohjoisissa olosuhteissa. Turvallinen tavara- ja henkilöliikenne on lähtökohta kaikelle toiminnalle. Avain onnistumiseen on henkilöstömme, yli 1000 raidekaluston huippuasiantuntijaa.

VR FleetCare luo lisäarvoa asiakkaille yhdistämällä alan parhaimman raidekalustoasiantuntijuuden, digitaalisuuden, kumppaniverkoston sekä jatkuvan kehittämisen yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa.

Digitalisaatio on vahvasti läsnä FleetCaren strategiassa. Olemme panostaneet viime vuosina mm. toiminnanohjausjärjestelmien, rajapintojen, mobiilisovellusten, pilvipalveluiden sekä raporttien uusimiseen ja jatkokehittämiseen. Seuraavaksi suuntaamme tekemistä tekoälyn ja automaation lisäämiseen, datan hyödyntämiseen sekä pilvipalveluiden optimoimiseen. VR FleetCare on suomalaisen rautatieoperaattori VR Groupin tytäryhtiö.

**Hae tehtävään heti!**

Mikäli tunnistit itsesi yllä mainitusta, niin haethan tehtävään nopeasti, sillä etenemme heti potentiaalisten hakijoiden kanssa. Viimeinen hakupäivä on 30.9.2026, mutta nopeus on valttia! Aloitus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Recruitment Manager Valtteri Kainulainen (valtteri.kainulainen@clevry.com). Huomioittehan, ettemme voi tietosuojasyistä ottaa hakemuksia vastaan sähköpostitse, ja hoidamme asiakasyrityksen puolesta kaikki tiedustelut työpaikkaan liittyen.

**Lisätietoa rekrytointiprosessistamme**

Me Clevryllä uskomme siihen, että työntekijän menestyksen tehtävässä ratkaisevat kovia taitoja paremmin pehmeät taidot ja halu kehittyä. Tämän vuoksi rekrytointiprosessiimme kuuluu psykometriset arvioinnit, jotka kartoittavat roolissa tarvittavia pehmeitä taitojasi sekä kognitiivisia kykyjäsi. Kartoittamalla työn kannalta kriittisiä pehmeitä taitoja, voimme auttaa työnhakijoita tunnistamaan ja sanoittamaan omia vahvuuksiaan paremmin sekä työllistymään helpommin ja nopeammin. Tässä prosessissa pääset tekemään johtamisraportin sekä verbaalisen kykytestin. Hakuprosessiimme kuuluu myös haastattelu sekä Clevryllä että asiakasyrityksessä, joten rekrytoinnin edetessä pääset tutustumaan vielä paremmin meihin molempiin.

**Lisätietoa Clevrystä**

Yli 30 vuoden ajan me olemme olleet muuttamassa työelämää pehmeitä taitoja korostavaan suuntaan rekrytointien, henkilöarviointien ja liikkeenjohdon konsultoinnin avulla. Me toimimme globaalisti Pohjois-Amerikasta Singaporeen erilaisten asiakkaiden, konsulttien ja kandidaattien kanssa, ja meidän pääkonttorimme sijaitsevat Helsingissä, Tukholmassa ja Brightonissa. Me tarjoamme palvelukseenne yli 150 pehmeiden taitojen tunnistamiseen sertifioitua rekrytoijaa, psykologia ja asiantuntijaa. Me rakennamme parempaa työelämää yhdistämällä toisilleen sopivimmat työnhakijat ja työnantajat keskenään!

title: Project Planner / Senior Project Planner
description:
Are you an experienced project planning professional with a passion for industrial projects? Do you want to play a key role in large-scale investments that support a more sustainable future? If so, we would love to hear from you.
Due to growing demand, we are looking for Project Planners and Senior Project Planners to join Sweco's expanding industrial projects organisation.
In this role, you will be responsible for project scheduling, progress monitoring and reporting in demanding industrial projects. Working closely with discipline leads, engineering managers, procurement managers and other project stakeholders, you will coordinate and consolidate project progress information into a clear overall view. You will support proactive project management by ensuring that project schedules and progress reporting provide an accurate picture of project status and upcoming risks.
You will report to project managers and other project leadership team members and may also work directly with clients by participating in project meetings and reviews. Depending on your experience and interests, you may take on responsibility for larger and more complex projects as a Senior Project Planner.
Our projects include a wide variety of industrial investments within sectors such as energy, process industry, chemicals, hydrogen, batteries and other industrial production facilities. At Sweco, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary project organisation together with leading experts across engineering, procurement and project management.
We have a flat organisational structure and value collaboration, initiative and continuous development. You will receive support from experienced colleagues while having the opportunity to influence project practices and ways of working.
Regarding location, we offer flexibility. The role can be based at any of our offices in Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Kouvola, Tampere, Helsinki, Turku or Varkaus, with a flexible combination of office-based and remote work depending on project needs.
What helps you succeed in this role
You have a suitable higher education degree, for example in engineering, technology, business or another relevant field (BSc, MSc or equivalent). For the Project Planner role, you typically have around three years of experience in project planning and scheduling or project controls. Experience from industrial projects is preferred, and experience in EPCM project environments is considered an advantage. You have experience using Primavera P6, which is an essential requirement for this role. Experience with Microsoft Project is considered an advantage. Knowledge of the Front-End Loading (FEL) project model is beneficial, as is experience working in multidisciplinary project organisations.
In addition, we expect you to have:
- Experience in project scheduling, progress monitoring and reporting
- The ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, procurement and project management teams
- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills
- Fluent written and spoken English
- Finnish language skills are considered an advantage

You are proactive, organised and solution-oriented. You enjoy working with large and complex projects and can identify critical issues while maintaining a clear view of the overall project situation.
What we offer you
- A curious, courageous and supportive Sweco community. At Sweco, we work together with a low hierarchy and a strong culture of trust. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are ready to share their knowledge, challenge ideas constructively and support you when needed.
- Meaningful and influential projects. You will lead projects that support the renewal of industry and contribute to a more sustainable society. Our work has a concrete impact on the environment where people live, work and move.
- Opportunities to grow and shape your career. We support your professional development through demanding assignments, peer support and the learning opportunities provided by Sweco Academy.
- Flexibility for a balanced everyday life. We believe that work and life should support one another. We combine office-based and remote work flexibly according to the needs of the project and the team. As this is a client- and project-driven role, regular on-site work and travel are expected.
- Comprehensive employee benefits. You can tailor parts of your benefits package to suit your individual needs.

Would you like to become our colleague?
You can apply for this position via the link below by Monday 19.10.2026. You can leave your application letter in English or Finnish. We go through applications and meet those interested in the position already during the application period, so please don't wait until the last minute.
If you have any questions about the task or working with us, Team Manager Eetu Lehtimäki will be happy to talk to you. You can reach Eetu at 050 3360561 (on weekdays between 11-12) or eetu.lehtimaki(a)sweco.fi.
Paikkakunnat: Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Kouvola, Tampere, Helsinki, Turku, Varkaus

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja
description:
Haluatko työskennellä monipuolisissa teollisuuden kunnossapitotehtävissä ja päästä mukaan varmistamaan tuotannon sujuvaa toimintaa modernissa työyhteisössä?

Haemme Installerylle kunnossapitoasentaa Vantaalle asiakaskohteeseemme. Tarjoamme kiinnostavia tehtäviä teollisuuden tuotantolaitosten kunnossapidon parissa sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä.

Installery on erikoistunut teollisuuden projekti-, kunnossapito- ja tarkastuspalveluihin. Meidät tunnetaan laadukkaasta työnjäljestä, vahvasta ammattiosaamisesta ja asiakaslähtöisestä toimintatavasta.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Kunnossapitoasentajana tärkein tehtäväsi on varmistaa asiakkaamme tuotannon häiriötön ja jatkuva toiminta. Työpäiväsi rakentuvat pääosin asiakkaamme järjestelmien ylläpidosta ja ennakoivasta huollosta, diagnostiikasta pienistä projektiluontoisista töistä ja toiminnan kehittämisestä. Lisäksi olennainen osa työtä on dokumentointi ja jatkuva parantaminen.

Työskentely tapahtuu pääosin päivävuorossa, ja n.4-5 viikon välein olevasta viikon varallaolojaksosta.

Asiakkuuksiimme kuuluu muun muassa kriittisen infran, uusiutuvan energian, elintarviketeollisuuden, teollisuuspesun ja korkean teknologian toimijoita. Meillä pääset työskentelemään mielenkiintoisissa ympäristöissä ja jättämään oman kädenjälkesi teollisuuden huippuosaajien rinnalla.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Toivomme sinulta työkokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, vianhausta ja ongelmanratkaisusta vähintään 1–2 vuoden ajalta. Meiltä löytyy kiinnostavia kohteita myös kokeneemmille kunnossapitoasentajille.

Tehtävässä menestymistä tukee sähkö-, automaatio-, kone- tai mekaniikka-alan koulutus, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme käytännön kokemusta ja kiinnostusta koneita ja laitteita kohtaan.

Työkielemme on suomi. Lisäksi englannin perustaidot ovat eduksi esimerkiksi teknisten manuaalien tulkinnassa.

Miksi Installery?

Meillä työskentelet avoimessa, työntekijälähtöisessä ja ammattimaisessa työyhteisössä, jossa osaamista arvostetaan ja kehitetään aktiivisesti.

Tarjoamme:

- monipuoliset ja kiinnostavat teollisuuden kunnossapitokohteet

- mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja edetä urallasi

- modernit toimitilat Helsingin Käpylässä

- tiiviin yhteisön sisaryhtiömme Engineryn kanssa, joka toimii teollisuuden sähkö-, automaatio- ja mekaniikkasuunnittelun parissa


Meillä voit rakentaa pitkäjänteisen uran. Haluamme mahdollistaa projektikierron eri kohteissa sekä tarjota urapolkuja esimerkiksi työnjohtoon, asennusvalvontaan ja suunnittelutehtäviin.

Palkka ja edut

Kunnossapitoasentajan palkka on kokemuksestasi riippuen noin 2800–3600 €/kk.

Lisäksi tarjoamme kattavat työsuhde-edut:

- laadukkaat työvälineet ja työvaatteet

- matkapuhelimen hankintabudjetin (1000 €)

- kattavan työterveyshuollon ja vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen

- liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun (400 €/vuosi)

- yrityksen yhteiskäyttöveneen ja vesijetin käyttöösi Helsingissä

- yhteisiä tapahtumia, virkistysmatkoja sekä liikuntaharrastusmahdollisuuksia


Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi hakulomakkeemme kautta pikimmiten. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja pyrimme palaamaan sinulle mahdollisimman nopeasti.

Installeryn Juha Ryödi kertoo mielellään lisää tehtävästä numerossa 040 487 8179.

Tervetuloa mukaan Installeryn porukkaan!

title: Analyst (Commercial Projects & Financial Analysis), Uusimaa
description:
About the role

In this role, you will be the analytical backbone for senior commercial leads and project managers across high-stakes energy deals. Your day-to-day focus will center on hands-on quantitative work, building and running diverse Excel models for investment calculations, deal valuations, and complex partnership structures. You will analyze broad commercial cases - ranging from long-term PPAs and joint ventures to corporate structures and M&A activities and translate your findings into clear presentations for decision-makers. Rather than working in a static setup, you will navigate a fast-moving, agile environment where project priorities evolve quickly. This position is an ideal next step for an ambitious analyst with some experience from transaction advisory, investment banking, or consulting who enjoys quantitative modeling and wants to apply their skills directly inside an industry leader.

You are offered
You will work on high-stakes commercial cases presented directly to executive leadership while receiving close guidance and support from experienced senior professionals. The position offers strong long-term career advancement and internal mobility within the company, along with a balanced hybrid work model including a few remote days per week.

Work tasks

This role focuses on providing quantitative support and financial modeling for large-scale energy projects and strategic business developments.
- Supporting senior leads on large-scale customer and partnership deals
- Building detailed Excel models for investment calculations, valuations and contract structures
- Performing market and corporate finance analysis for joint ventures and M&A projects
- Turning quantitative data into clear slides and presentations for management and clients
- Utilizing AI tools (e.g., Copilot) to speed up analysis and reporting

We are looking for

- University degree in Finance, Economics or a related field
- Relevant experience in analyst roles from Investment Banking, Big 4 (Transaction Services / Corporate Finance) or similar advisory role
- Strong Excel skills for hands-on financial modeling and investment calculations
- Solid foundation in Corporate Finance principles and valuation methods
- Strong quantitative abilities and comfort working with complex data
- Ability to present and explain financial findings clearly to stakeholders
- Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Please note that a security clearance will be conducted for the chosen candidate, and any offer of employment is conditional upon a successful security clearance check.

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Finnish or Swedish
- Familiarity with the energy industry or large-scale infrastructure investments
- Background in Corporate Finance studies
- Experience with asset or portfolio optimization analysis

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Detail-oriented and structured
- Change-oriented
- Stress tolerant
- Proactive
- Collaborative
- Intellectually curious

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Safariopas, poro-ohjelmat
description:
Oletko oma-aloitteinen, ulospäinsuuntautunut, joustava ja palvelualtis persoona, joka viihtyy myös kiireisessä ympäristössä? Meillä pääset työskentelemään käytännönläheisessä, vaihtelevassa ja kansainvälisessä ympäristössä, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen. Saat kohdata matkailijoita eri puolilta maailmaa ja olla mukana luomassa heille unohtumattomia Lapin elämyksiä yhdessä porojen kanssa.

Haemme nyt **kahta kokoaikaista poro-opasta vakituiseen työsuhteeseen** sekä **kokoaikaisia ja osa-aikaisia oppaita määräaikaisiin työsuhteisiin** talvisesongille marraskuusta 2026 maaliskuuhun 2027!

Työn kuvaus

Poro-oppaana pääset työskentelemään monipuolisesti eläinten ja matkailijoiden parissa. Työhösi kuuluu safareiden ja muiden ohjelmien toteuttamista, asiakkaiden ohjaamista ja opastamista sekä eläinten hyvinvoinnista ja turvallisuudesta huolehtimista. Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu safareihin liittyviä valmistelu- ja huoltotöitä sekä muita päivittäisiä tehtäviä yhdessä muun henkilökunnan kanssa.

Etsimme sinua, jos

- Olet reipas, ulospäinsuuntautunut, joustava ja palvelualtis

- Viihdyt ihmisten parissa ja nautit kansainvälisestä työympäristöstä

- Sinulla on sujuva englannin kielen taito (muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi)

- Olet valmis tarttumaan erilaisiin tehtäviin

- Työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti, vastuullisesti ja turvallisuus edellä

- Olet kiinnostunut eläinten kanssa työskentelystä ja haluat huolehtia eläinten hyvinvoinnista

- Sinulla on B-ajokortti


Katsomme eduksi

- Aikaisemman kokemuksen safarioppaan tai poro-oppaan tehtävistä

- Hygieniapassin

- Voimassa olevan ensiapukoulutuksen (EA1)


Tarjoamme sinulle

- Monipuolisen ja elämyksellisen työn Lapin matkailun parissa

- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä porojen ja kansainvälisten asiakkaiden kanssa

- Mahdollisuuden oppia uutta ja tehdä monipuolisia työtehtäviä

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan

- Rennon ja hyvähenkisen työyhteisön

- Hyvän perehdytyksen ja mukavat työkaverit


Jos tunnistat itsesi kuvauksesta ja olet valmis hyppäämään mukaan vauhdikkaaseen talvisesonkiin, saatat olla juuri se tyyppi, jota etsimme! Tule mukaan Raitolan huipputiimiin ja tekemään kansainvälisille asiakkaillemme ikimuistoisia Lapin elämyksiä.

title: Solution Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Architect to help shape the future of banking technology. You will lead the architecture of domain-oriented data products and APIs that enable critical business capabilities across the bank. Working at the intersection of business, technology and data, you will partner with architects, engineers, product managers and senior stakeholders to create scalable, secure and resilient solutions. You will provide end-to-end architectural leadership across multiple delivery streams, while enabling teams to make effective decisions within clear architectural guardrails.

Your impact:
You will establish reusable data and API capabilities that accelerate delivery, improve interoperability and create value for customers and business partners.

What youll be doing:
 Lead architecture across domains
 Define and evolve the architecture vision, principles and roadmap for Data Products and Domain APIs.
 Align business capabilities, data assets, APIs and technology platforms across multiple delivery streams.
 Oversee the end-to-end solution architecture and coordinate the work of software architects embedded in individual delivery streams.
 Identify interfaces, data flows and cross-domain dependencies, and guide teams in evaluating solution alternatives.

Drive data product excellence:
 Establish patterns and standards for domain-owned data products that are discoverable, trustworthy, reusable and governed.
 Clarify data ownership, product boundaries, quality expectations, metadata, lineage and lifecycle responsibilities.
 Partner with business and technology stakeholders to maximise the value and safe use of data across the organisation.
 Promote modern data architecture practices, including data product thinking and domain ownership.

Shape the domain API landscape:
 Define API-first architecture principles, design standards, governance and lifecycle management practices.
 Guide the definition of domain boundaries, API contracts, versioning, security and reusable integration patterns.
 Ensure APIs are secure, scalable, resilient, observable and easy for consumers to use.
 Support event-driven and service-oriented integration approaches where they provide clear business and technology value.

Build resilient, delivery-ready solutions:
 Define solution-level functional requirements and non-functional requirements for availability, performance, security, scalability, resilience and operability.
 Define subsystems and interfaces, allocate responsibilities and clarify interactions with the wider solution context.
 Build and maintain the architectural runway needed for sustainable delivery and future change.
 Enable Continuous Delivery and DevOps through pragmatic design guidelines, automation and investment advocacy.

Collaborate and influence:
 Work closely with Product and Solution Management, business stakeholders, engineering teams, Enterprise Architects and external suppliers.
 Contribute architectural expertise to planning, high-level design, solution demonstrations and continuous exploration.
 Help shape and realise architectural enablers, including appropriate capacity allocation for enablement work.
 Communicate complex architecture decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
 Mentor architects and engineering teams, foster collaboration and enable decentralised decision-making.

Requirements:
 Experience and domain knowledge
 Significant experience in Solution Architecture, Domain Architecture, Enterprise Architecture or a comparable senior architecture role.
 A proven track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data, API and integration solutions.
 Experience leading architecture across multiple teams, products or technology domains.
 A strong understanding of banking technology and business processes. 
 Experience with Core Banking platforms is highly desirable.
 Experience working in complex, regulated environments with demanding security, resilience and data governance requirements.

- Do you have experience within banking sector? If yes, please elaborate.*

title: Business Controller
description:
At Valmet Automotive, we are shaping the future of industries. To support our continuing development, we are looking for a commercially minded and analytically strongBusiness Controller to join our finance team.

* Supporting strategic and operational decision-making through business cases, scenario analyses, and financial modeling
* Ensuring visibility of balance sheet development, working capital, and cash flow performance
* Ensuring accurate monthly reporting in close cooperation with the accounting team

What you bring?
* Relevant academic degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in business controlling, financial planning and analysis, or a similar finance role
* Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, financial performance management, and profitability analysis
* Good understanding of balance sheet management, cash flow, and working capital dynamics
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn financial data into meaningful business insights

title: AI Lead, Marine
description:
We are looking for an AI Lead for the Marine Business Unit to take ownership of Marine-specific AI development and turn business and engineering needs into practical solutions.

As part of the Marine Business Unit strategy, we are increasing our focus on artificial intelligence to improve competitiveness, efficiency, engineering processes, and ways of working. The role bridges technology, engineering and business, turning Marine challenges into AI-driven solutions and leading initiatives from idea to implementation.

Your role and the team

As our Marine AI Lead, you will drive the adoption and development of AI solutions across our Marine Business Unit. You will identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities, translate business needs into practical development initiatives, and lead projects from concept to implementation. You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions
- Driving and prioritizing a strong pipeline of AI initiatives
- Making informed technology and development decisions
- Improving engineering productivity and processes through AI
- Creating competitive advantage through Marine-specific AI applications

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

This position can be based in Turku or Espoo. Please let us know your preferred location in your application.

What helps you succeed in this role

- Relevant educational background
- Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, and AIOps
- Hands-on experience in developing and implementing AI solutions
- Experience in maritime, shipbuilding, engineering, CAD/CAE, PLM, or other industrial environments is an advantage
- Ability to turn business and engineering needs into practical technical solutions
- Understanding of software development, system architectures, integrations, and data flows
- Strong project ownership, collaboration, and communication skills
- A curious, pragmatic, and business-oriented mindset

title: Legal Counsel @ Enity Bank Group
description:
Are you a curious and solution-oriented lawyer looking to further develop your expertise in the banking sector? Are you interested in working for a Nasdaq Stockholm-listed Nordic banking group with an innovative and friendly culture?

If you answered **YES**, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **Enity Bank Group's Finnish branch** as a new **Legal Counsel**! This is a broad in-house role where you will be the key legal point of contact for Enity Bank Group's Finnish operations, while working closely with the wider legal team across the Nordic organisation. You will be the sole lawyer in Finland, while having the support of your legal colleagues across the Nordics whenever needed.

_Enity believes in people's potential and is challenging the Nordic mortgage market by making banking more inclusive, sustainable and human. As a listed company, Enity operates through the brands Bluestep Bank, Bank2 and 60plusbanken, offering mortgages to customers often excluded by traditional banks – for example, due to self-employment, type of employment, age or credit history – as well as savings products. The Group operates across Sweden, Norway and Finland and is entering its next phase of growth, with an ambition to develop through new products, partnerships, distribution models and M&A. In Finland, Enity operates through a local branch of Enity Bank Group AB (publ)._

**In this role**, you will support the Finnish business on a wide range of legal and regulatory matters, with a particular focus on mortgage lending, consumer credit and the day-to-day legal needs of the branch. The role offers significant independence and close interaction with both the local business and colleagues across the Group. In more concrete terms, you will:

- provide legal advice to the Finnish branch on a broad range of matters

- support the mortgage business on matters relating to lending, security, property law, consumer protection, debt collection and insolvency

- review marketing materials and customer communications from a legal and regulatory perspective

- review and negotiate commercial agreements

- support the business in relation to customer matters, complaints and disputes

- monitor relevant Finnish legislation and regulatory developments and support their implementation within the branch

- advise on regulatory requirements applicable to the Finnish operations and support interactions with relevant authorities when needed

- prepare internal legal guidance and training

- support the Group in connection with potential acquisitions and other strategic transactions, including legal due diligence, transaction documentation and integration-related matters


The position is based in Helsinki and reports to the Bank's CLO, who is based in Stockholm. You will be part of the Nordic Legal team and collaborate closely with legal colleagues across the Group. In Finland, you will act as the main legal point of contact for the local organisation and work closely with the Branch Manager for Finland, contributing to the continued development and growth of Enity Bank Group's business in Finland.

**This role would be ideal for a legal professional who:**

- has a Finnish master's degree in law and at least three years of relevant post-qualification experience (however this is just the minimum requirement, and the role has plenty to offer a more senior lawyer as well) preferably from a bank, financial institution, law firm or other regulated business;

- has experience from one or more of the following areas: banking and finance, mortgage lending or other consumer credit, consumer protection, insolvency, debt collection or disputes or financial regulation;

- is comfortable taking ownership of matters and working independently, while also collaborating closely with colleagues across different functions and jurisdictions;

- can translate legal and regulatory requirements into clear, practical advice and is interested in understanding the commercial context in which you work; and

- has excellent communication skills in Finnish and English. Knowledge of Swedish is considered an advantage.


**Enity Bank Group offers you:**

- a versatile position with excellent opportunities for professional growth;

- a front row seat in a growing company, where you have the opportunity to influence and gain responsibility;

- a supportive and close-knit culture with shared moments, such as after-works, company get-togethers and events; and

- the possibility to travel occasionally and to work as a part of a Nordic team with colleagues in Stockholm and Oslo.


**Interested?** Send us your CV and cover letter no later than **5 October 2026.** If you would like to discuss the position in more detail, feel free to reach out to Minjon's recruiter Olivia Yli-Pelkonen (+358 40 769 5401 or olivia.yli-pelkonen@minjon.fi). We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period, so don't wait to apply!
