title: Project Controller
description:
Project Controller position available

The Chr. Michelsen Institute (CMI) has one, 100%, permanent Project Controller position available. CMI is a private research institute with English as the working language.

This position replaces a team member who is transitioning to a new role. 

The position is part of the Project Unit within the institute's Administration and reports to the Head of Projects. The Project Unit works across CMI to facilitate research and commissioned projects throughout their lifecycle by providing expert advice in grant management and project administration.

The preferred start date is January/February 2027. 


Job description and essential work tasks

As a Project Controller, you will work as part of the Project Unit at CMI with responsibility for a dedicated project portfolio, ensuring sustainable operations and continuous professional development of oneself and the unit.

The Project Unit is responsible for: 

  • The full lifecycle of research projects, including budgeting, financial monitoring, reporting, invoicing, contracts, and project close-out.
  • Compliance with funding regulations and legislation, contribute to the continuous development of grant management practices, and foster collaboration and knowledge sharing within the Project Unit and across the Institute.
  • Supporting application processes by providing administrative, financial, and compliance expertise.
  • Monitoring the market for commissioned research opportunities. 

Key work tasks in the Project Controller role

  • Provide financial and administrative oversight of research projects throughout their entire lifecycle, from the proposal stage to project completion.
  • Collaborate and communicate closely with researchers involved in the research projects within your assigned project portfolio.
  • Provide professional and administrative support for grant applications and tenders to national and international funding bodies and clients; contributing to the development of new project proposals.
  • Prepare project budgets, financial reports, invoices, and process financial documentation.
  • Manage the formal and legal aspects of agreements and contracts, including further developing and adapting contract templates.
  • Ensure the quality of administrative and financial reporting to funding agencies and clients.

What We Are Looking for in a Project Controller

Experience and Qualifications

  • A higher education degree in a relevant field.
  • Experience in project administration and financial control.
  • Understanding of grant compliance, funding regulations, and research administration.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English.
  • Experience with funding programmes from the Research Council of Norway and the European Union is an advantage.
  • Experience with commissioned work acquisition and bid management is an advantage. 

Personal skills

You are a proactive and solution-oriented professional who works effectively both independently and as part of diverse teams. 

You are organised, able to manage competing priorities and deadlines, communicate clearly and professionally, and are comfortable navigating digital systems and administrative processes. 

You enjoy learning, adapting to new requirements, and following through to deliver results.


CMI can offer you:
  • The opportunity to be part of knowledge organization contributing to societal change. 
  • A vibrant and international working environment, with English as the primary working language.
  • Work-life balance and home office opportunities.
  • This position is placed either in the Adviser or Senior Adviser category, wage is determined by the position category and the candidate's experience. 
  • Salary for Adviser positions starts at NOK 688 271.-
  • Salary for Senior Adviser positions starts at NOK 787 831.- . 

Relevant staff benefits:

  • In addition, to the annual 5 weeks holiday leave, CMI offers staff additional paid leave from the 24th of December to the 1st of January, and during the Easter week each year.
  • Support for gym membership.
  • Excellent travel insurance that covers both work and private travel (terms apply).
  • Defined contribution pension (innskuddspension). Contributions are paid with 7% of the salary up to 7.1 G and 25.1% of the salary between 7.1-12 G (2% are deducted from the employee, terms apply).

Location 

This position is located in Bergen, Norway. CMI is not in a position to offer remote working arrangements for new staff members. We offer home office agreements, allowing all staff to work up to two days a week from home office in Norway.


How to apply:

CMI only accepts applications through the JobbNorge recruitment system.

Please submit the following:

  • A cover page outlining your motivation for the position, and your qualification for the role
  • CV
  • Proof of highest degree received (i.e., copy of diploma or transcript)
  • A minimum of three references, including phone numbers and e-mail addresses

The application deadline is set to the: 15th of October 2026. 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

CMI is an independent, development research institute based in Bergen, Norway, with around 110 staff members. In cooperation with partners from all over the world, we address key development challenges in Africa, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Latin America.

We combine high-quality research with an engagement to make knowledge accessible and used. We work in multi-disciplinary teams, where the main disciplines are economics, political science, and social anthropology. We have an international staff and an engaging working environment.

Our vision is 'research for a just and equal world', and our mission is to address global challenges by providing research-based knowledge that inspires and shapes policy and practice.

Our values are: inclusive & empathetic, collaborative, curious & bold and respectful. You can read CMI's strategy, vision, mission and values in full here: Who we are (cmi.no). 

CMI's strategic priorities for 2023-2028 are:

  • High-quality research: increasingly be internationally recognized for cutting edge, interdisciplinary academic and policy-relevant research.
  • Impact for societal change: To strengthen our influence, and shape public debates and policies in our fields of expertise.
  • Equal knowledge production: To be a role model in equal and inclusive partnerships in all of our endeavors.

CMI's structural priorities for 2023-2028 are:

  • An inclusive workplace: CMI must have an inclusive and healthy work culture that encourages and thrives on diversity, including in perspectives.
  • A developing & sustainable organization: CMI continues to adapt to changing needs and requirements by having sufficient staff with the right competencies, resources, and technology to support our operations.
  • Social responsibility: CMI works for sustainability in all areas of our operations, especially those focused on environmental, social and governance issues.

Hvorfor jobbe i VARD?

Hos VARD blir du en del av et internasjonalt selskap der innovasjon, samarbeid og kontinuerlig utvikling er en naturlig del av arbeidshverdagen. Vi er opptatt av å skape et arbeidsmiljø der mennesker trives, utvikler seg og lykkes sammen.

title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
  • a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works
  • names and contact information for two reference persons. Reference letters are not required at the application stage.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For relevant positions, OsloMet conducts background checks of applicants in cooperation with an external provider, in order to verify information contained in available documents. Background checks are always carried out with the candidate’s consent, and employment in these positions is conditional upon an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information about this.


Other information 

If you would like more information about the position, feel free to contact:

  • Head of unit Siri Brorstad Borlaug, (+47) 993 05 003 
  • Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit, (+47) 922 81 887

title: Er du vår nye superhelt medarbeider?
description:
Åpnet annonsen på Finn.no? For den beste leseropplevelsen anbefaler vi at du åpner annonsen i vårt rekrutteringssystem Teamtailor, ved å trykke "Søk her" til høyre for, eller i bunnen av Finn-annonsen.

Elsker du å jobbe tett med andre, og motiveres du av å skape resultater i team? I Big Bite er vi like opptatt av menneskene på begge sidene av disken, og vi definerer oss selv som Superhelter for sultne folk i farta!

Er du vår nye superhelt på Big Bite Horisont?

Ikke alle helter har kappe. Noen har caps med logo på. Og nå jakter vi den rette medarbeider som kan jobbe både dag, kveld og helg. Du skal ikke bare temme sult og slukke tørst, men også spre hverdagsglede. 💥

Med Big Bite får du sjanse til å være med på en lærerik reise i et helnorsk fastfood-konsept som tilbyr rask og rimelig mat i farta, med nysmurte subs som hovedprodukt. 🌯

Veteran eller ungt heltetalent?
Rett mentale innstilling veier vel så tungt som en CV med erfaring. Du vil fort se at Big Bite-systemet ikke holder kunnskapen innelåst. Tvert om, vi deler. Her bygger veteraner opp ferskinger.

I tillegg kan du skilte med andre superkrefter, som at du:

  • Er serviceinnstilt og fremoverlent
  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo
  • Har et øye for salg

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK og står sterkt hos oss. Vi ser derfor etter kandidater som gjenspeiler disse:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.
  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.
  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.
  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Hvorfor skal du velge oss?
Vi tilbyr grundig opplæring og en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger. I fellesskap jobber vi for gode kundeopplevelser, likeså viktig er det at vi tar vare på hverandre i Big Bite-familien. 🥳

Blir du trigget av dette håper vi å høre fra deg!

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Big Bite.

For ytterligere informasjon ta gjerne kontakt med franchisetaker Chanett Louise Mørner på tlf: 93219254

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Big Bite åpnet sin første avdeling i Trondheim i 1997 med en ambisjon om å lage rask og smakfull mat til folk i farta. I dag finnes Big Bite i hjertet av over 70 kjøpesenter og handlegater over hele Norge. Vi er en sterk nasjonal merkevare i vekst. Idéen er enkel, men supergod. Subs laget av ferske baguetter fra lokal baker, friske salater og lune wraps - servert innen sekunder med et smil på kjøpet.

title: PhD fellowship
description:
About the position 

A 100% 3-year PhD fellowship in chromatin and computational biology is available in the project group of Dr. Julia Madsen-Østerbye, research group of Prof. Philippe Collas, at the Division of Biochemistry, Department of Molecular Medicine, Institute of Basic Medical Sciences, University of Oslo (Collas Lab). The position is part of an interdisciplinary project investigating epigenomic mechanisms by which mutations in nuclear lamins cause lipodystrophies and associated metabolic diseases.


More about the position 

You will be expected to carry out wet-lab 3D genomics experiments and analyze data in the context of additional datasets (RNA-seq, ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, protein interactome, etc.) to investigate the impact of lamin mutations on spatial genome organization in lipodystrophy patient-derived cells. You will be expected to carry out advanced computational analyses. Our underlying model system is the in vitro differentiation of adipose tissue stem cells into adipocytes.

The project is in collaboration with the Danish Cancer Institute in Copenhagen, and you will have the opportunity to undertake a research stay in Copenhagen.

You will be part of a cross-disciplinary team of cell biologists and bioinformaticians in the Division of Biochemistry at the Department of Molecular Medicine. The Division hosts an active community of cell biologists working on, among other areas, chromatin and nuclear architecture using various model systems (BIO). 

You will take part in the Medical Faculty’s PhD program and be expected to complete the project and PhD within three years.


Responsibilities
  • Carry out wet-lab genomics work
  • Carry out computational analyses and interpret data
  • Maintain an accurate electronic laboratory journal
  • Present research findings at group meetings, seminars and conferences
  • Contribute to manuscript preparation
  • Complete the required medical faculty’s doctoral coursework
  • Write, submit and defend your PhD thesis

 Qualifications requirements
  • Applicants must hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in chromatin/genome biology, minimum grade B (ECTS grading scale) or equivalent. The Master’s degree must include a thesis of at least 30 ECTS. 
  • Programming skills in Python, R or equivalent scientific computing languages.
  • Experience in bioinformatic analysis of genomic data. 
  • Excellent English written and oral communication skills.
  • Experience with 3D chromatin conformation capture methods (practical and/or computational) is a plus.
  • Experience with electronic laboratory notebook systems is a plus.

Personal skills
  • A positive and systematic mindset.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new skills.
  • Collaborative and enjoys working as part of a team.
  • Good communication skills with molecular biology researchers, technicians, and bioinformaticians.
  • Contributes to a collegial and inclusive working environment. 

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

  • Committed colleagues in an active, international and interdisciplinary research environment.

  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

title: Postdoctoral Fellow
description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three- or four- year Postdoc position at the Department of Education, University of Oslo.

We are seeking a candidate with deep insight and interest in investigating the interaction between collaborative learning processes in specific knowledge domains in educational sciences and AI tools and infrastructures.

Different types of AI (generative and domain specific intelligent technologies) change the conditions for student learning in higher education. The position is anchored in the learning sciences a field in rapid development. The field needs to improve both descriptions, understanding, and explanations about the interaction that takes place between students, content, context and AI. The learning sciences is an interdisciplinary field of knowledge, building on learning-theoretical principles but also capitalizing on research from various other subfields – educational psychology, sociology of education, design studies or computer science, and more recently, learning analytics and AI in education.

GenAI have the last years changed important parts of the knowledge infrastructures for students in  higher education. Multiple resources contribute to form their learning trajectories. To navigate and use multiple resources increases the complexity for students learning processes and demands for agency and cognitive efforts change.  Today we have limited insight into students’ processes and outcomes with AI within specific areas in higher education.

This postdoc project is planned as design-based research (DBR) study based on different AI tools and infrastructures. Design-based research is a specific design approach that has been developed in the learning sciences over the last 30 years. It implies that researchers and practitioners collaborate in the design, implementation and analysis of the project. They will usually have different roles in the different phases of the projects, and a DBR study usually runs in several iterations to improve the students’ learning opportunities.

The project will be implemented in collaboration with the senior members of the KITE research group (se link to KITE below) and, if relevant, members of other research groups at the Faculty of Educational Sciences.  

The study will be conducted with students at the Faculty of Educational Sciences and, if relevant during the project period, with students from other faculties at University of Oslo.

The project will be part of the portfolio of KITE’s AI related projects in the TRUST center (se link below).  Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact the contact persons for guidance in the preparation of their application and project proposal. 


More about the position

The appointment is a fulltime position for a period of three or four years. In a four-year position 25% of the time is devoted to teaching duties, usually in the form of teaching activities at the department. The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position will also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

Please see the guidelines concerning appointments to post-doctoral and research positions at the University of Oslo.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term. 

The appointed postdoc will be part of the faculty research group KITE, which conducts research on knowledge work, collaboration and learning with emerging technologies in higher education and in work settings. The group has an extensive national and international network of researchers and user partners and participants in the AI-centre TRUST (The Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI - TRUST – The Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI).


Qualification requirements
  • The applicants would need to have PhD in either; learning sciences, educational sciences, educational psychology or human-computer interactions studies.   
  • The focus of the PhD-thesis needs to contain knowledge areas such as learning theory, cognitive theories with applications on studies of learning, design of learning environments, design-based research methods, digitalization and AI preferable in higher education, but background in K-12 studies might also be of relevance. Applicants with PhD thesis that involves studies of interaction with intelligent technologies will be given priority. 
  • Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved. 
  • Proficiency in English is required. Fluent and written communication in Norwegian would be seen as an advantage in the work with the study design and data analysis. 

Personal skills
  • Strong collaborative and communication skills
  • A commitment to work towards the project’s common goals
  • Ability to work focused and independently
     

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon applicants with diverse background, variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for colleagues that could contribute to advanced research in the field of collaborative learning with AI. 

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A professionally stimulating working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range from NOK 595.000 - to NOK 670.000 per annum -, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

How to apply

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter that includes statement of motivation, summarizes scientific work and project proposal within research area described above. Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact the contact persons for guidance in the preparation of their application a project description of 7-8 pages, including a progress plan, which should outline 3-4 scientific articles/papers. 
  • Applicants are asked to outline a postdoc project that includes their interest towards collaborative learning and AI in higher education. They must formulate a project proposal with a clear theoretical framing, research methods, description of design processes, data analysis and justification of relevant research questions.

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their university’s grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

In assessing the applications, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, the project description, and the quality of the project as well as the candidate’s motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project during the period of employment.

title: Er du klar for et viktig samfunnsoppdrag og forvalte en stor eiendomsportefølje?
description:
Boligstiftelsen etablerte egen administrasjon som overtok forvaltningen av stiftelsen fra 2021 med daglig leder og driftssjef. I 2023 ansatte stiftelsen fire egne driftsteknikere etter at kommunen sa opp avtalen om vaktmestertjenester. 

 

Som daglig leder skal du forvalte og videreutvikle stiftelsen som en viktig samfunnsaktør i tett samarbeid med vår kunde og samarbeidspartner Ringerike kommune. Du skal videreføre det arbeidet som er igangsatt samtidig som du bidrar til å sette retning, ta tak i nye utfordringer, skape engasjement og sørge for gjennomføring av viktige prosjekter og oppgaver i samarbeid med egen organisasjon og styret.

 

Du får ansvaret for en driftsorganisasjon med høy eiendomsfaglig- og driftsmessig kompetanse.

 

Vi ser etter en leder som evner å kombinere strategisk blikk med operasjonell handlekraft og som skaper resultater sammen med andre.

 

 

Sentrale arbeidsoppgaver vil være

●       Lede og videreutvikle stiftelsens arbeid

●       Sikre god økonomistyring og bærekraftig forvaltning og drift av eiendomsporteføljen

●       Videreutvikle relasjonene og samarbeidet med Ringerike Kommune

●       Utvikling – og reforhandling av avtaler

●       Styrke stiftelses omdømme som en viktig samfunnsaktør med stort samfunnsansvar

●       Videreutvikle standarder på tekniske og økonomiske områder

●       Lede ulike type prosjekter / prosjektutvikling

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi søker en trygg, tydelig og samlende leder med god økonomiforståelse, gode gjennomførings- og samarbeidsevner og som evner å sette retning for vår videre utvikling.

 

Du har erfaring fra lederstillinger med resultatansvar og kan vise til gode resultater når det gjelder utviklings- og forbedringsarbeid. Det er en fordel (behøver ikke) om du har erfaring fra eiendom, økonomi eller annen kompetanse- og tjenestebasert virksomhet. Det viktigste er at du evner å forstå vår virksomhet og se mulighetene som ligger foran oss og at du har kraft til å realisere dem i samarbeid med egen organisasjon og kunde/samarbeidspartner.

 

Høyere utdanning er ønskelig, men relevant ledererfaring kan kompensere for utdanning.

 

 

Vi håper du kjenner deg igjen i flere av disse beskrivelsene

●       Du er en tydelig, troverdig og tillitsskapende leder

●       Du evner å bygge langsiktige relasjoner internt og eksternt

●       Du kommuniserer godt med kunder, samarbeidspartnere,       medarbeidere og andre

●       Du er tålmodig og har sterk gjennomføringskraft og evner å omsette  planer til handling

●       Du trives med å utvikle organisasjoner og mennesker

●       Du trives både med strategiske og operativt oppgaver

 

 

Ønsker du nærmere informasjon om stillingen så kontakter du Temp-Team ved Glenn G. Hovde på tlf. 982 44 777 eller epost gho@temp-team.no

Alle henvendelser til Temp-Team behandles konfidensielt om ønskelig også overfor Ringerike Boligstiftelse i innledende fase.

 

Søknad med CV lastes opp via stillingsannonsen.

Søknadsfrist: Snarest og senest 21.10.2026

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ringerike boligstiftelse er en alminnelig stiftelse opprettet av Ringerike kommune og Ringerike boligbyggelag i 1970 og forvalter 650 boenheter fordelt på ca. 62 000 kvm. Stiftelsens hovedformål er å skaffe boliger til tidsbegrenset utleie å erverve eller forestå oppføring av trygdeboliger, samt boliger og institusjoner til bruk for pleie- omsorg, helse og sosialtjenesten og leie ut leiligheter i slike bygg i Ringerike kommune. Ringerike boligstiftelse har som målsetting at eiendommene skal bidra til økt livskvalitet for beboerne og økt produktivitet for de ansatte.  Vi er lokalisert på Hvervenmoen i moderne lokaler og er 6 ansatte.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Population Genomics
description:
About the position

A 4-year position as PhD Research Fellow in Population Genomics is available at the Natural History Museum (NHM), University of Oslo. The 4-year fellowship includes 25% career-enhancing work, such as curation, teaching, supervision, research support and public outreach.

The project is supervised by Dr. Andrew Foote (NHM).
The PhD project will reconstruct the colonisation of high latitudes by North Atlantic killer whales (Orcinus orca), to better understand how populations responded to past climatic warming at the Pleistocene–Holocene transition. Range expansions and demographic change leave signatures in the genome, including changes in genetic diversity and in how genetic variation is distributed within and among populations. These signatures are not uniform along the genome, but depend on local genomic parameters such as mutation and recombination rate.

The candidate will quantify changes in genetic diversity and variation through time, and investigate how these patterns vary across the genome. The project will combine an existing dataset of approximately 200 contemporary genomes with a new time series of ancient killer whale genomes generated within the project. The tasks will include ancient DNA laboratory work, bioinformatic processing of Next Generation Sequencing data, and population genomic analyses, including demographic inference.
The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The selected candidate will be enrolled in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences. Within two months of commencing the position, the candidate must submit a PhD agreement, including a plan for the required doctoral courses and a project description. For more information about the programme, see: http://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/   


Qualifications / Requirments 

You must have:
•    An MSc degree in evolutionary biology, population genetics, bioinformatics, or a related field.
•    Research experience in population genetics or population genomics.
•    Experience with bioinformatic analysis of Next Generation Sequencing data, including command-line work in a high-performance computing environment.
•    Programming or scripting skills (e.g., R, Python, bash).
•    Excellent written and verbal communication ability in English. English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/EEA countries and exemptions from the requirement, see: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8 

Desirable qualifications (in ranked order):
•    Experience with ancient DNA laboratory work.
•    Experience with demographic inference, coalescent methods, or population genetic simulations.
•    Strong interest in evolutionary responses to past climate change

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows, according to the Norwegian educational system:
•    The average grade for courses included in the Bachelor's degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
•    The average grade for courses included in the Master's degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
•    The Master's thesis must have grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system
See: https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc7 

The evaluation of applicants will focus on the following:
•    Relevance and quality of the MSc thesis
•    Relevance and quality of scientific publications (not necessarily expected at this level)
•    Grades at relevant university-level courses (population genetics, evolutionary biology, bioinformatics, statistics, programming, wet-lab molecular techniques)
•    The fit of the applicant's career plan, interests, and skills as formulated in the cover letter (see How to apply below)
•    Personal suitability (incl. collaborative skills) and motivation for the position
•    An interview, including a 15 minute presentation of your MSc thesis (only short-listed candidates)


What are we looking for in you?

•    Honesty and high standards for scientific integrity
•    Ability to give and receive scientific criticism in a constructive manner
•    A positive attitude and drive for learning skills, methods and theory
•    Ability to work in a structured manner, facilitating teamwork
•    Ability to prioritise and complete work tasks
•    Ability to work independently, as well as collaboratively in an international and interdisciplinary research environment
•    Careful and well-documented approach to laboratory and computational work

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


How to apply

The application must include (as separate and numbered documents):

1.    Cover letter with a statement of motivation and research interests
2.    CV summarizing education, positions and academic work, scientific publications, and other relevant experience
3.    Statement explaining how a PhD in population genomics will fit into the applicant’s career plan (max 1 page)
4.    Copies of educational certificates and transcripts of records (as a single PDF)
5.    Documentation of English proficiency if applicable
6.    Names and contact details of 2-3 references (i.e., name, affiliation, relation to candidate, e-mail, and phone number). The references will be contacted if necessary. Letters of recommendation are therefore not required.

Applicants should deliver the application with the requested attachments through our electronic recruiting system. Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge. Click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


We can offer you

•    Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development. 
•    Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
•    Onboarding program for new employees.
•    Good welfare schemes.
•    A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
•    Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse (SPK), which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
•    Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
•    Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow (position code 1017) in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund (SPK).


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Natural History Museum at the University of Oslo is Norway’s most comprehensive natural history collection. For almost 200 years, specimens of animals, fungi, plants, rocks, minerals and fossils have been collected, studied and preserved here. The museum is located at Økern and in the beautiful Botanical Garden, which is not only popular for recreation, but is a scientific collection in itself.

title: Passionate about brewing and eager to learn and grow together with us?
description:
FLO continues to expand, new opportunities are constantly emerging across the company. For the right person, this role can be the beginning of an exciting career with us. You’ll have the opportunity to develop your technical skills, take on more responsibility and potentially move into other roles as the company grows. Based at our production facility in the countryside outside Oslo, you’ll become part of an ambitious and hands-on production team where quality, craftsmanship and continuous improvement are at the heart of what we do.

 

The role

Reporting to our Head of Production, you’ll be involved throughout the brewing and production process – from brewing and quality control to carbonation, filtration and kegging. Your key responsibilities will include:

 

  • Brewing Operations: Execute brewing processes according to recipes and established procedures, ensuring excellent quality and consistency in every batch.
  • Quality Control: Perform quality testing using equipment such as the Anton Paar Alcolyzer, pH meters, Dissolved Oxygen meters and CO₂ measurement devices.
  • Carbonation: Manage and fine-tune beverage carbonation to achieve the desired specifications.
  • Kegging & Filtration: Operate kegging and filtration equipment, ensuring our products meet the highest standards.
  • Cleaning & Sanitation: Carry out thorough Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) procedures for tanks, hoses, carbonation units, pumps, the brewhouse and other production equipment in accordance with our SOPs.
  • Production Data: Accurately record and update production and quality data in our ERP systems Odoo.
  • Packaging Support: Support packaging operations when required and work closely with colleagues across production.

You’ll also play an active role in keeping our workplace clean, safe, organized and efficient – and we want you to contribute ideas. We believe the people closest to production are often the ones who see the best opportunities for improvement.

 

Who are you? You’re someone who takes pride in your work and cares about the details that make the difference between a good product and a great one. Ideally, you have formal education in brewing, beverage production, food science or a related field, combined with some practical experience from a brewery or similar production environment. However, we’re also interested in people with the right technical understanding, attitude and desire to learn. We think you’ll thrive at FLO if you: 
 

  • Have a genuine interest in brewing and beverage production
  • Have relevant education and preferably some practical brewing or production experience
  • Are technically minded, practical and comfortable working hands-on
  • Understand the importance of hygiene, accuracy and consistency
  • Take ownership and responsibility for your work
  • Enjoy working as part of a team
  • Are curious and always looking for ways to improve
  • Want to continue learning and developing professionally
  • Are comfortable working in a fast-moving company where things evolve as we grow

Why FLO?

FLO AS is an ambitious company with exciting plans for the future. We are investing in our growth, our production and, importantly, our people. Joining us now means becoming part of that journey. For the right person, there will be significant opportunities to learn, develop and progress within the company. As FLO grows, new positions and responsibilities continue to emerge, creating opportunities for internal promotion and career development. 

 

You’ll be joining a company you can build a career with. Our production facility is located in a rural area outside Oslo. Due to the location, having access to a car is strongly recommended. Candidates must already have the legal right to live and work in Norway. Applicants residing within the EU/EEA who are eligible to work in Norway are welcome to apply.

 

If you want to learn, develop and be part of building something exciting, we’d love to hear from you: Whether you already have brewing experience or are early in your professional brewing career, this could be your opportunity to take the next step. We’re looking for someone who wants to master the craft, contribute to the team and develop alongside a company with big ambitions. Add Persona is managing the recruitment process on behalf of FLO AS. If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, you are warmly welcome to get in touch with us. We look forward to hearing from you!

 

Come brew with FLO – and be part of what we’re building.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

FLO is a leading company in beverage development and production, known for our innovative approach, high quality standards, and strong customer partnerships. As a dedicated co-packer, we produce private-label beverages for customers in Norway, across the Nordic region, and in international markets, as well as manufacturing products for other brand owners.

 

FLO operates from modern, high-quality facilities at Sollihøgda. Today, we are a team of 29 employees with diverse professional backgrounds, united by a shared drive: to create together, deliver quality, and have fun along the way. We value diversity, continuous development, and a start-up mindset built on the belief that nothing is impossible. At FLO, success is not only about the results we achieve, but also about how we achieve them – as a team that supports, challenges, and celebrates together.

title: Chef - Frich's Hotel Surnadal
description:
Would you like to create memorable dining experiences in a modern hotel surrounded by some of Norway’s most beautiful nature?

 

Frich’s Hotel Surnadal is looking for a Chef to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with quality ingredients, takes pride in their craft, and wants to be part of a kitchen focused on great food and genuine hospitality.

About Frich’s Hotel Surnadal

Located in the heart of Surnadal, Frich’s Hotel Surnadal is surrounded by spectacular mountains, fjords and some of Norway’s most impressive natural scenery. With Trollheimen nearby and excellent opportunities for outdoor activities, Surnadal is an attractive place for anyone looking to combine their career with life close to nature.

 

The hotel has recently undergone a major renovation, including a brand-new reception area, restaurant, kitchen and conference facilities. Today, it offers a modern and welcoming environment where quality, comfort and guest satisfaction are at the center of everything we do.

At Restaurant HØST, we celebrate Nordic food traditions through carefully selected ingredients, seasonal menus and authentic flavors. We believe great meals bring people together, and we strive to create experiences that make our guests feel truly welcome.

Your Responsibilities

• Prepare and cook high-quality dishes for hotel and restaurant guests
• Ensure consistency, presentation and quality in every service
• Contribute ideas for menu development and seasonal offerings
• Follow HACCP procedures and maintain high hygiene standards
• Assist with food preparation, ordering and kitchen organization
• Work closely with colleagues in both the kitchen and front-of-house teams
• Help create memorable dining experiences for our guests

Who We Are Looking For

• Previous experience as a chef, cook or culinary professional
• Culinary certification (fagbrev)
• Passion for food, quality ingredients and guest satisfaction
• Ability to work efficiently in a busy kitchen environment
• A positive attitude and strong teamwork skills
• Flexible, reliable and willing to contribute wherever needed

What We Offer

• A modern and recently renovated workplace
• Opportunity to work with quality ingredients and seasonal menus
• A supportive and friendly team environment
• Varied working days with opportunities for professional development
• The opportunity to contribute to the continued growth of Restaurant HØST
• Competitive salary and employment conditions
• Assistance with accommodation during the initial period, giving you time to settle in and find a suitable long-term housing solution

 

If you are looking for your next opportunity in Norway and would like to work in a professional kitchen surrounded by beautiful nature, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of the team at Frich’s Hotel Surnadal.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Frich's Hotel Surnadal is a modern and recently renovated hotel located in the center of Surnadal, surrounded by the stunning mountains and fjords of Western Norway. The hotel offers comfortable accommodation, conference facilities, and Restaurant HØST, which focuses on Nordic food traditions, quality ingredients, and genuine hospitality. Popular with both business travelers and tourists, the hotel serves as a natural meeting place for locals and visitors exploring the beautiful Nordmøre region.

title: Vil du bli en del av Ramudden Rådgivning?
employer: RAMUDDEN NORGE AS AVD TRØNDELAG SØR
description:
Ramudden Rådgivning ser etter en ny kollega til vår avdeling i Trondheim. Avdelingen jobber hver dag for å legge til rette for trygg og effektiv gjennomføring av arbeid på og langs vei. Nå søker vi etter deg som ønsker en variert arbeidshverdag og som motiveres av å bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som konsulent i Ramudden Rådgivning vil du jobbe med planlegging og utarbeidelse av løsninger for arbeid på og langs vei. Sikkerhet står sentralt i arbeidet, og løsningene du utarbeider skal bidra til å ivareta både de som utfører arbeidet og de som ferdes i området.

Dine viktigste arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

  • Utarbeidelse av arbeidsvarslingsplaner
  • Utarbeidelse og oppfølging av gravesøknader
  • Trafikkplanlegging

Hvem er du?

Erfaring fra lignende stilling eller bransje er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For oss er det viktigste at du er motivert for å lære, tar ansvar for egne oppgaver og bidrar til et godt samarbeid med både kolleger og kunder.

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er opptatt av å levere god service og høy kvalitet
  • Er opptatt av sikkerhet i arbeidet
  • Tar initiativ og følger opp oppgaver på en god måte
  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig, både selvstendig og i team
  • Har god arbeidskapasitet og klarer å prioritere når det er mye å gjøre
  • Er komfortabel med å bruke PC som arbeidsverktøy og setter deg raskt inn i nye systemer

Hva vi tilbyr

  • Solid opplæring og gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Gode kollegaer og et faglig sterkt miljø
  • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø

Vil du bli en del av laget?

Vi vil gjerne høre fra deg!

Send inn søknad, eller ta kontakt dersom du har spørsmål om stillingen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

title: Research coordinator at NORA
description:
About the position

We are seeking a candidate for a temporary 1-year position as research coordinator at NORA.ai. NORA is a national network hosted at the University of Oslo (UiO).

We are looking for an allrounder: a research coordinator to assist with tasks related to the NORA Research Schools, as well as tasks involving event organization, national and international research coordination activities and administrative tasks. You will be given the opportunity to build and strengthen Norwegian research and innovation within artificial intelligence - one of the most exciting and important research fields, mentioned as a priority area within Emergent and industrial technologies in Norway’s Long-Term Plan for Research and Higher Education.


About NORA

NORA - the Norwegian Artificial Intelligence Research Consortium - is a national collaboration between 8 universities, 5 university colleges, and 4 research institutes within artificial intelligence, machine learning, and robotics. Our goal is to strengthen Norwegian research, education, and innovation in AI, machine learning, and robotics, as well as other relevant fields within artificial intelligence. Learn more about NORA at https://www.nora.ai. 

The NORA Secretariat consists of seven dedicated staff members with diverse cultural and academic backgrounds. The University of Oslo, through the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences and dScience - Centre for Computational and Data Science - hosts NORA. Our workplace is at Blindern, Oslo.


Your main tasks will be

Your main task will be to contribute to the organization of NORA's two Research Schools

  • NORA-tech (for cutting edge technologies within AI), and
  • NORA-HS (for humanities and societal questions within AI)

You will also contribute to the organization of other NORA events.

More about work tasks:

You will work closely with the CEO and the rest of the NORA secretariat. In particular, you will work closely with the Research Coordinator for the Research Schools and assist in the planning of research school events and their scientific content. You will also support the organization of NORA’s two main conferences and other national and international events. The tasks will be varied, and good collaboration skills are required. Some travelling must be expected.

Specific tasks will be:

title: Group Controller
description:
Mercell is the leading SaaS platform for public procurement in Europe.

We deliver digital solutions for public tenders and procurement across Europe and have built a large, subscription-based business with a strong Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) foundation. Headquartered in Oslo, Mercell is backed by Thoma Bravo, one of the world's leading software and technology investors.

At Mercell, we're on a mission to transform public procurement by making it more accessible and effortless for everyone involved. We envision a world where public buyers and suppliers work seamlessly together to make “a great deal easier” and help shape the future.

Our culture is built on continuous growth, trust and collaboration. We offer an international environment where talented people can thrive alongside ambitious colleagues who are passionate about creating value for our customers and shareholders.


Your Mission 

As Group Controller, you will join our Group Finance team in a broad, hands-on role spanning financial controlling, FP&A and finance operations. Your work will cover areas such as cost controlling, reporting, forecasting, cash management and working capital.

You will work closely with colleagues across Finance and the business, taking ownership and contributing where needed. This is an opportunity to build on your accounting or audit experience, broaden your operational understanding and grow across several areas of finance.


Core Responsibilities  

  • Contribute to financial reporting, analysis and controls, ensuring reliable numbers and useful insights.

  • Support cost controlling, budgeting and forecasting in certain areas in close dialogue with the business.

  • Support with cash management, cash forecasting and working capital to support day-to-day financial operations.

  • Contribute to effective operations around transfer pricing and inter-company financing; internal cost allocation, internal funding and other financial management on legal entity level

  • Improve processes and ways of working, combining attention to detail with a practical, hands-on approach.


Required Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting, Finance or similar.

  • Strong experience (ideally a minimum of 3-5 years) in accounting, auditing or financial or business controlling, with a solid understanding of financial reporting and analysis. Big4 background is an advantage.

  • An interest in moving closer to the business and developing broader experience in financial reporting and operations.

  • Good Excel skills and confidence working with financial systems and data. Experience with Oracle Netsuite is an advantage.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate across teams.


Preferred Qualifications  

  • You are curious, structured and enjoy getting things done. You take responsibility for the quality of your work, ask questions and are keen to understand how the numbers connect to everyday operations.

  • You enjoy variety and working in a small team where colleagues support each other. You bring a sound technical foundation and a willingness to learn; experience across every part of the role is not expected. Cash management and other operational finance activities offer opportunities to develop as you grow in the role.

  • You are proactive and thrive in a fast- paced environment where we set ambitious goals and continuously improve how we work

  • You have high professional standards.

 

Start date: As soon as possible

Duration: Full time

Workplace type: Hybrid - working onsite at the office min. 3 days and from home, balancing flexibility with collaboration

Location: Oslo, Norway

Application Deadline: 11 October 2026. However, do not wait to submit your application - we will read applications and talk to potential candidates as we receive them 

 

What we offer 

Mercell offers an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of a leading European SaaS company backed by one of the world's foremost technology investors.

You will join an ambitious, international organisation where you can develop and improve financial controlling and finance operations, while broadening your experience across Finance.

We offer a dynamic working environment, excellent opportunities for professional and personal growth, modern offices and a competitive compensation package.

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/pages/perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.


Has this sparked your interest?

Then we can't wait to have you join our mission and looking forward to receiving your application!


-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

title: Scientific Programmer
description:
This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys tackling undefined challenges, and is motivated to learn and innovate continuously.

In our small and dynamic software team, you'll have the opportunity to engage with all parts of the software stack, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse skills and ideas are valued.

You will be an integral part of our research and development team, by developing and maintaining our products and services for well logging applications. We have developed sensors that emit radar pulses and sample them after reflecting off the wellbore. The Scientific Programmer will assist with improving and developing our software and algorithms to transform the raw data to intuitive 3D visualizations. The key to develop the processing algorithms is understanding how our sensors behave and how the pulses propagate.

Example of tasks:

  • Mathematical modelling of signal pulses

  • Development of new data processing algorithms

  • Improvement of the user interfaces to existing software

  • Increasing the quality of the codebase

  • Improving the performance of the existing processing algorithms

Part of your work could also be in our lab where you will be testing and verifying your own and the team's new solutions and software.

The candidate we are looking for has:

  • Master's degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or similar fields with good academic results

  • Previous experience in, and theoretical knowledge of, digital signal processing

  • Competency in object-oriented programming, with particular focus on Python

  • Good mathematical abilities, preferably with a background in Physics

  • Understanding of the importance of type hinting, logging, exception handling and documentation during development


Experience with the following is beneficial and will be emphasized in the evaluation, so please mention if you have any knowledge or work experience of the following:

  • Mathematical modelling of physical systems

  • Multiprocessing and multithreading in Python

  • The HDF5 file format

  • The QT framework and the Python wrapper 'PyQT5'

  • The data visualization library 'PyQtGraph'

  • Version control with Git

  • Collaborative programming


Requirements:

You will need to be fluent in English, both written and verbal. Norwegian language skill is an advantage. Since the position could require some training in the USA, you must fulfill VISA requirements for travels to the USA.

What we offer you:

As an employee of WELL ID, you'll be at the forefront of developing cutting-edge products and services. You'll have ample opportunities to collaborate with customers and contractors, supported by our team through mentorship programs and continuous learning initiatives to help you succeed.

  • High tech Research and Development

  • Small organization where your effort is recognized

  • Opportunities for growth and personal development

  • A healthy work environment with a lot of experience and niche expertise

Office location in Greater Stavanger area.

title: Customer Success Operations Manager
description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. Our mission is to redefine livestock farming by giving farmers better control, deeper insights, and more efficient ways to care for their animals.

Since Monil was founded in Norway in 2022, we have grown rapidly from a small startup into an international scale-up operating across Norway, Sweden, the UK, and the US. Today, our technology is trusted by thousands of farmers across multiple markets.

We are building much more than a virtual fence. Our ambition is to become the digital shepherd for modern livestock farming helping farmers monitor animal health, automate grazing, and gain deeper insights into animal behaviour and welfare.

At Monil, our customers are farmers. That is why we call our Customer Success team Farmer Success. As we continue to scale internationally, we are looking for a Customer Success Operations Specialist to improve the systems, processes, data, and workflows behind Farmer Success. You will help us deliver fast, accurate, and consistent customer support across markets and enabling our Farmer Success team to spend more time helping farmers and less time navigating manual processes and inefficient tools.


About the Role

As our Customer Success Operations Specialist, you will own and improve workflows, data, and operational processes that enable Farmer Success to run effectively and scale across markets.

You will identify bottlenecks, standardize ways of working, and use automation, data, and AI to improve both the customer experience and the everyday work of our Farmer Success teams.

The role reports to the Head of Farmer Success and works closely with Farmer Success teams across markets, Sales Operation, Marketing, and our Business Systems Lead.

You will act as the operational owner of Farmer Success systems and processes. This means identifying business needs, improving how our tools are used, and prioritizing operational improvements. For integrations, system architecture, procurement, and larger technical changes, you will collaborate closely with our Business Technology Team.


The Technology You’ll Work With

Our current technology stack includes Odoo, Grafana, Looker Studio, BigQuery, Aircall, and phone and messaging solutions such as WhatsApp and Messenger.

Our tools will continue to evolve as we grow, and you will help us identify, evaluate, and implement what we need next. You do not need prior experience with every system in our current stack, but you should be comfortable learning new tools and understanding how systems, data, processes, and people work together.


Your Key Responsibilities

  • Improve systems and processes: Identify bottlenecks in Farmer Success workflows and playbooks, and develop solutions that simplify, improve, or automate how the team works. Use new technology to help us deliver consistently high-quality support and customer care across markets.

  • Enable AI and automation: Identify, prioritize, and implement practical AI and automation opportunities that improve internal efficiency and customer-facing interactions.

  • Own Farmer Success systems: Act as the operational owner of Farmer Success tools, including our CRM, calling system, messaging solutions, and loyalty program. Identify system needs and collaborate with the Head of Business Technology on business cases, procurement, integrations, and larger changes.

  • Build reporting and insight: Develop dashboards and reports in tools such as Looker Studio and Odoo to track key KPIs, operational performance, and customer health across markets. Turn farmer enquiries and feedback into actionable insights for Farmer Success and the wider Monil organization.

  • Maintain system and data quality: Keep Farmer Success systems current, reliable, and scalable. Establish and maintain high standards for customer and case data so teams across Monil can trust and use the information available.

  • Improve the customer journey: Collaborate with Sales RevOps to ensure consistent processes, systems, and information flow throughout the customer journey—from lead and purchase to onboarding and long-term customer success.

  • Support onboarding and knowledge sharing: Help onboard new Farmer Success team members and maintain the documentation, playbooks, and best practices needed to support consistent ways of working across markets.


Who You Are

You have experience improving customer support operations, customer success processes, or the systems behind them. You have worked hands-on with workflows, data, and tools, and can point to changes you helped implement and the results they delivered. A relevant degree is welcome, but equivalent practical experience is just as valuable.

You are analytical, structured, and curious about how systems and processes can improve the experience of both farmers and the team supporting them. You identify better ways of working and take ownership of turning ideas into lasting improvements.

A key part of this role is building AI-powered workflows that help deliver fast, accurate answers to farmers at scale. We would particularly like to meet candidates who can share concrete examples of using AI agents to make a meaningful, lasting improvement to a process. Broader experience with AI and automation is a strong advantage.

You enjoy collaborating across teams, translating operational needs into clear system and process requirements, and communicating with both technical and non-technical colleagues. You thrive in a growing company where many processes are still being built, and you care as much about the farmer’s experience as the systems behind it.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer
