Ser du muligheter der andre kanskje ser begrensninger? 

Nav Eiganes og Tasta har ledig en fast stilling som veileder i vårt team for oppfølging av voksne over 30 år som står helt eller delvis utenfor arbeidslivet. Vi søker deg som er trygg i møte med mennesker i ulike livssituasjoner, og som evner å være raus, tålmodig og tydelig. Du brenner for å skape muligheter i arbeidslivet, og er ikke er redd for å ta kontakt med arbeidsgivere for å åpne dører for dem vi følger opp. 
 
I denne rollen vil du kartlegge den enkeltes ressurser, muligheter og behov, og bidra til at flere kommer nærmere arbeid, tiltak og utdanning. En viktig del av jobben er å motivere og støtte mennesker gjennom endringsprosesser, styrke troen på egne muligheter og bidra til mestring på veien mot økt deltakelse i arbeidslivet. Du vil samarbeide tett med lokalt næringsliv og andre samarbeidspartnere for å finne gode løsninger, samtidig som du forvalter Nav sitt regelverk og saksbehandler i henhold til gjeldende lover og retningslinjer.

Kontoret er lokalisert i Byfjordparken 15 på Tasta. Vi har cellekontor, små lukkede landskap med 2 til 4 medarbeidere og et større åpent landskap. Kontoret disponerer biler som brukes til ekstern møtevirksomhet.

Hvis du ønsker en meningsfull jobb med varierte arbeidsoppgaver, faglige utfordringer og gode utviklingsmuligheter, håper vi at du søker på stillingen som veileder hos oss.
Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gi helhetlig arbeidsrettet oppfølging og veiledning til personer med behov for bistand mot arbeid eller utdanning.
  • Kartlegge ressurser og behov, utarbeide planer og bidra til mestring og utvikling i endringsprosesser.
  • Samarbeide med arbeidsgivere, utdanningsinstitusjoner og andre aktører for å fremme inkludering i arbeid og aktivitet.
  • Saksbehandle og forvalte Nav sine tjenester, virkemidler og regelverk, samt veilede i bruk av digitale løsninger.
  • Dokumentere oppfølging og sikre god kvalitet i veilednings- og forvaltningsarbeidet.

Nav er i stadig utvikling og endring. Det må derfor påregnes at andre oppgaver kan bli lagt til stillingen ved behov, herunder tilknytning til annen avdeling eller annet team.

Kvalifikasjoner

Du må ha:

  • Fullført utdanning tilsvarende bachelorgrad fra universitet eller høyskole, gjerne innen sosialfag, samfunnsfag, pedagogikk, arbeids- og velferdsfag, psykologi eller andre relevante fagområder. Relevant erfaring og/eller utdanning kan kompensere for utdanningskravet. Utenlandske utdanningsgrader må være godkjent av Hk-dir eller Nokut og godkjenningen må lastes opp som vedlegg til søknaden. 
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne med gode norskkunnskaper. Ved annet morsmål enn norsk, må det dokumenteres språknivå tilsvarende minst B2.
  • God digital kompetanse og evne til å ta i bruk nye systemer og arbeidsverktøy. Gjerne erfaring med Microsoft 365.
  • Erfaring med veiledning og motivering av mennesker, fortrinnsvis mot arbeid, tiltak og/eller utdanning. 

Det er også en fordel om du har: 

  • Erfaring fra å kontakte bedrifter og / eller har erfaring fra å samarbeide med eksterne samarbeidspartnere.
  • Erfaring med saksbehandling og lovanvendelse.

Vi er mer opptatt av hva du kan, dine erfaringer og kompetanse, enn hvor flink du er til å skrive en jobbsøknad. Derfor ber vi deg om å levere en god og beskrivende CV hvor du får frem hva du har gjort og oppnådd som gjør deg kvalifisert for stillingen du søker på. I tillegg kommer vi til å be deg svare på noen korte spørsmål, som en del av søknadsprosessen. Du trenger altså ikke å skrive eller legge ved et søknadsbrev. 

Personlige egenskaper

For at du skal kunne oppleve mestring og trives i rollen over tid, ser vi det som svært viktig at du innehar disse personlige egenskapene i stor grad:

  • Samarbeider med andre: Du bygger gode relasjoner og samarbeider godt med både kolleger, arbeidsgivere og andre samarbeidspartnere.
  • Tar Initiativ: Du handler på eget initiativ og tar selvstendige avgjørelser. 
  • Tilpasningsdyktig: Du omprioriterer arbeid når omstendighetene krever det og har et friskt blikk på nye situasjoner og endringer, uten å feste deg ved eksisterende.
  • Planlegger og strukturerer: Du arbeider systematisk, håndterer flere saker samtidig og sikrer kvalitet i oppfølging og saksbehandling.
  • Motstandsdyktig: Du står trygt i krevende situasjoner, håndterer motgang på en konstruktiv måte og bevarer ro og fokus i en hektisk arbeidshverdag. 

Personlige egenskaper vektlegges sterkt, og det vil bli benyttet DNV-GL-sertifisert personlighetstest i rekrutteringsprosessen. 

Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende arbeidshverdag med varierte og givende arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Dyktige medarbeidere og et godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, blant annet relevante kurs og videreutdanning innen eksempelvis Forvaltningsrett og kollegaveiledning.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow
description:
Job description

Applicants are invited for a three- or four- year Postdoc position at the Department of Education, University of Oslo.

We are seeking a candidate with deep insight and interest in investigating the interaction between collaborative learning processes in specific knowledge domains in educational sciences and AI tools and infrastructures.

Different types of AI (generative and domain specific intelligent technologies) change the conditions for student learning in higher education. The position is anchored in the learning sciences a field in rapid development. The field needs to improve both descriptions, understanding, and explanations about the interaction that takes place between students, content, context and AI. The learning sciences is an interdisciplinary field of knowledge, building on learning-theoretical principles but also capitalizing on research from various other subfields – educational psychology, sociology of education, design studies or computer science, and more recently, learning analytics and AI in education.

GenAI have the last years changed important parts of the knowledge infrastructures for students in  higher education. Multiple resources contribute to form their learning trajectories. To navigate and use multiple resources increases the complexity for students learning processes and demands for agency and cognitive efforts change.  Today we have limited insight into students’ processes and outcomes with AI within specific areas in higher education.

This postdoc project is planned as design-based research (DBR) study based on different AI tools and infrastructures. Design-based research is a specific design approach that has been developed in the learning sciences over the last 30 years. It implies that researchers and practitioners collaborate in the design, implementation and analysis of the project. They will usually have different roles in the different phases of the projects, and a DBR study usually runs in several iterations to improve the students’ learning opportunities.

The project will be implemented in collaboration with the senior members of the KITE research group (se link to KITE below) and, if relevant, members of other research groups at the Faculty of Educational Sciences.  

The study will be conducted with students at the Faculty of Educational Sciences and, if relevant during the project period, with students from other faculties at University of Oslo.

The project will be part of the portfolio of KITE’s AI related projects in the TRUST center (se link below).  Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact the contact persons for guidance in the preparation of their application and project proposal. 


More about the position

The appointment is a fulltime position for a period of three or four years. In a four-year position 25% of the time is devoted to teaching duties, usually in the form of teaching activities at the department. The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position will also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

Please see the guidelines concerning appointments to post-doctoral and research positions at the University of Oslo.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term. 

The appointed postdoc will be part of the faculty research group KITE, which conducts research on knowledge work, collaboration and learning with emerging technologies in higher education and in work settings. The group has an extensive national and international network of researchers and user partners and participants in the AI-centre TRUST (The Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI - TRUST – The Norwegian Centre for Trustworthy AI).


Qualification requirements
  • The applicants would need to have PhD in either; learning sciences, educational sciences, educational psychology or human-computer interactions studies.   
  • The focus of the PhD-thesis needs to contain knowledge areas such as learning theory, cognitive theories with applications on studies of learning, design of learning environments, design-based research methods, digitalization and AI preferable in higher education, but background in K-12 studies might also be of relevance. Applicants with PhD thesis that involves studies of interaction with intelligent technologies will be given priority. 
  • Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved. 
  • Proficiency in English is required. Fluent and written communication in Norwegian would be seen as an advantage in the work with the study design and data analysis. 

Personal skills
  • Strong collaborative and communication skills
  • A commitment to work towards the project’s common goals
  • Ability to work focused and independently
     

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon applicants with diverse background, variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for colleagues that could contribute to advanced research in the field of collaborative learning with AI. 

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A professionally stimulating working environment
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range from NOK 595.000 - to NOK 670.000 per annum -, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

How to apply

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter that includes statement of motivation, summarizes scientific work and project proposal within research area described above. Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact the contact persons for guidance in the preparation of their application a project description of 7-8 pages, including a progress plan, which should outline 3-4 scientific articles/papers. 
  • Applicants are asked to outline a postdoc project that includes their interest towards collaborative learning and AI in higher education. They must formulate a project proposal with a clear theoretical framing, research methods, description of design processes, data analysis and justification of relevant research questions. 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity)
  • Copy of PhD Diploma or documentation of thesis submission. Applicants who have not yet defended their PhD dissertation need to include an advisor’s letter confirming specific expectations about when the degree will be received 
  • Copies of educational certificates (academic transcripts only), 
  • a complete list of publications, 
  • academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered, 
  • a list of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system Jobbnorge. Foreign applicants are advised to attach an explanation of their university’s grading system. Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language).

Incomplete applications will not be assessed.

In assessing the applications, special emphasis will be placed on the documented, academic qualifications, the project description, and the quality of the project as well as the candidate’s motivation and personal suitability. Interviews with the best qualified candidates will be arranged.

It is expected that the successful candidate will be able to complete the project during the period of employment. 


Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and the guidelines and regulations for appointments to Postdoctoral Fellowships at the University of Oslo.

No one can be appointed for more than one Postdoctoral Fellow period at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 27 400 students and 6 900 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Education  was established in 1938 and is one of three departments at the Faculty of Educational Sciences. Research at the department is characterized by interdisciplinarity and encompasses a broad range of human learning across the entire life course, from early childhood education and care to higher education and workplace learning.The breadth of our research is reflected in our bachelor’s and master’s programmes, which also include an international master’s programme. title: Østensjø Rederi søker Marine Superintendent
description:
Østensjø Rederi søker en proaktiv og strukturert Marine Superintendent til vårt Risk and Compliance-team ved hovedkontoret i Haugesund. Rollen rapporterer til Risk and Compliance Manager og har en sentral funksjon i oppfølgingen av vår flåte. Du vil bidra til at selskapets styringssystem, HMS- og kvalitetsstandarder og operative rutiner opprettholdes og videreutvikles.

Ansvarsområde

Som Marine Superintendent vil du bistå med utarbeidelse, implementering og vedlikehold av selskapets styringssystem. Du vil ha en variert arbeidshverdag med oppgaver innen HMS og kvalitet, revisjoner, granskninger, rapportering og oppfølging av hendelser og korrigerende tiltak.

Du vil samarbeide tett med flåtesjefer og mannskap, og bidra med råd og støtte innen HMS, kvalitet og fartøysoperasjoner. Stillingen innebærer også ansvar for månedlig rapportering til befraktere og for å sikre at mannskapet får nødvendig sikkerhets-, beredskaps- og opplæring i selskapets styringssystem.

Ved behov vil du kunne opptre som selskapets Designated Person Ashore (DPA) og/eller Company Security Officer (CSO).

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter en strukturert og ansvarsbevisst kollega som arbeider grundig og systematisk, og som har god gjennomføringsevne. Du er proaktiv og løsningsorientert, og trives med å jobbe selvstendig samtidig som du samarbeider godt med både sjø- og landbasert personell.

Du har god forståelse for maritime operasjoner og evner å kombinere kravene i styringssystemet med praktiske løsninger i den operative hverdagen. Du kommuniserer godt, både muntlig og skriftlig, og har svært gode engelskkunnskaper.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Operativ erfaring fra maritim virksomhet og god teknisk forståelse
  • Kjennskap til maritimt regelverk
  • Erfaring fra HMS- og kvalitetsarbeid
  • Relevant utdanning på høyskole- eller fagskolenivå
  • Svært gode skriftlige og muntlige engelskkunnskaper

Hvorfor Østensjø Rederi?

Hos Østensjø Rederi blir du en del av et solid og anerkjent rederi med lang historie, sterke verdier og høy teknisk standard. Vi tilbyr:

  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kolleger
  • En spennende arbeidshverdag i et kompetent og profesjonelt team
  • Stor grad av autonomi og mulighet til å påvirke og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring
  • Konkurransedyktige lønns- og arbeidsvilkår, samt gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
  • Moderne kontorlokaler på kaien i hjertet av Haugesund
  • En trygg og stabil arbeidsplass med lojale og dedikerte medarbeidere

Østensjø Rederi er en ledende internasjonal leverandør av offshore-tjenester, og eier og opererer skip innen Offshore Energy, Offshore Accommodation og taubåtsektoren. Siden starten i 1974 er rederiet bygget opp med fokus på høykvalitets leveranser i alle ledd og langvarige samarbeidspartnere. Dette har lagt grunnlaget for de gode kunderelasjoner selskapet har i dag samt en dyktig og solid arbeidsstyrke, både på land og til sjøs. Østensjø Rederi er familieeid og har rundt 500 ansatte. Selskapt har hovedkontor i Haugesund, samt tilstedeværelse i Storbritannia og på Malta.

Klepp kommune har ambisjoner for utviklingen av framtidens helsetjenester. Vi står i et tydelig skifte der behovene øker, ressursene blir knappere, og kravene til samhandling, endring og bærekraft blir sterkere. Dette krever nye løsninger, nye arbeidsformer og tydelig ledelse.

Vi ser etter en motivert og engasjert avdelingsleder i hjemmetjenesten. En leder som ønsker å skape gode tjenester sammen med dyktige medarbeidere. En som vil bidra til å videreutvikle hjemmetjenesten og sikre trygge og helsefremmende tjenester for innbyggerne våre.

title: Sykepleier
description:
Hjemmetjenesten i Sør-Odal er i spennende utvikling!

Vårt mål er å skape trygghet, kontinuitet og livskvalitet for våre tjenestemottakere – slik at de kan leve gode og selvstendige liv i egne hjem.

Vi har nå ledig en fast sykepleiestilling i 70% i avdeling 1, med todelt turnus (dag og kveld), arbeid hver fjerde helg med langvakter og ansvarsvakter på kveld. Avdeling 1 jobber primærbasert, hvor sykepleiere og fagarbeidere jobbet tett sammen med tjenestemottaker i senter. Avdeling 1 arbeider med rehabilitering, forløp, multimorbide tjenestemottakere og palliasjon.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at politiattest må legges fram før oppstart dersom du tilbys stillingen. Vi tar forbehold om at eventuelle merknader på denne kan føre til at tilbud om stilling endres).

Vi ønsker mangfold og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av alder, kjønn, etnisitet og funksjonsnedsettelse.

Vi oppfordrer deg til å laste opp relevante attester og vitnemål sammen med søknaden. Dokumentene vil gi grunnlag for beregning av ansiennitet og lønn ved en eventuell ansettelse.

Søkere som ønsker å være unntatt offentlighet må begrunne dette særskilt. Opplysninger om deg kan bli offentliggjort selv om du har bedt om ikke å bli ført opp på søkerlisten. Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i forhold til reglene i Offentlighetsloven. Dersom anmodningen ikke blir tatt til følge, vil du bli varslet om dette, jf. Offentleglova § 25.



Arbeidsoppgaver

Som sykepleier i hjemmetjenesten får du en variert og meningsfull arbeidshverdag.

Du har ansvar for faglig observasjon, behandling, oppfølging og tiltak, samtidig som du bidrar til å utvikle tjenesten og ta i bruk fremtidsrettede løsninger. Du vil jobbe tett i team, men også ha stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar.

title: Storsjarmør trenger din hjelp!
description:
Storsjarmør trenger flere gode hjelper i hverdagen

Jeg er en gutt på 6 år som bor sammen med mamma og min storebror. Jeg har flere diagnoser, men det som du bør vite spesielt om er epilepsien min. Jeg er multisyk og lungesyk/hjertesyk. Jeg kan bevege meg, men trenger assistanse til alt av forflytning og personlig hygiene. Medisinske apparatet som vi sammen må bli venner med er bi-pap (pustemaskin) og forstøver som er i daglig bruk. Trenger bistand til forflytning og mobilisering, stimulering, og noen flere bestevenner på laget. Jeg har også CVK, PEG, og er på matpumpe hele døgnet.

Pusten min kan skremme oss, og noen ganger snur tilværelsen svært fort og du som skal bli min venn: må ha tæl til og stå i dette sammen med meg! ALT dette får du opplæring til!

Jeg elsker alt i fra å sitte på fanget og få kos, til å ligge på gulvet og leke. Her kan jeg leke med heisekranen og klosser. Selv om jeg har en fysisk funksjonsnedsettelse skjønner jeg alt det som foregår rundt meg og jeg klarer å kommunisere det jeg ønsker - mye med tegn til tale.

Livet mitt kan snu på sekunder, slik at det er viktig at du kan tørre å stå sammen med meg uansett hvor jeg er. Sykehuset er i perioder mitt andre hjem.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver blir

  • overvåke meg på natt og endre stilling
  • leke med meg på dagtid
  • utføre personlig hygiene
  • være avlaster for mamma
  • lage sondemat
  • ellers være der jeg er og sikre at jeg er trygg

Du må være

  • Fleksibel
  • glad i å være med barn
  • tålmodig
  • ikke redd for å ta i et tak
  • ha førerkort
  • ha plettfri vandel

Hva kan Prima Assistanse tilby:

  • Egen kontaktperson i Prima Assistanse
  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du kan gjøre en forskjell
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver hvor ingen dag er helt lik
  • Ansattfordeler
  • Kurs gjennom Prima Assistanse
  • Lønn og andre vilkår ihht. Landsoverenskomsten for BPA


Erfaring med PEG, CVK og metningsmåler er en fordel, men ikke noe krav. Du vil få opplæring i det du trenger, men du må være tøff nok til å tørre dette.

God kjemi mellom deg og meg er alfa omega for at vårt samarbeid skal fungere godt.

Vi har nå behov for flere å spille på. Arbeidstiden blir i hovedsak natt. Selv om dette i hovedsak er tilkalling, kan det bli mulighet for mer fast og mulighet for å kunne jobbe mye i perioder.

Mamma vil være arbeidsleder og Prima Assistanse arbeidsgiver.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

title: Er du fleksibel og ønsker en givende deltidsjobb nær Oslo?
description:
Hei!

Jeg er en ung kvinne med en funksjonsnedsettelse som gjør at jeg trenger praktisk assistanse for å få hverdagen og hjemmet mitt til å fungere. Jeg bor på Sofiemyr i Nordre Follo, med kort reiseavstand til både Oslo og Ski, og 10 meter fra et busstopp med direkte forbindelser til blant annet Oslo sentrum, Kolbotn og Solbråtan stasjon.

Jeg søker nå en personlig brukerstyrt assistent (BPA) som kan jobbe fast én helgedag per uke, vekselvis lørdag eller søndag, i hovedsak på dagtid. Det er også ønskelig at du er fleksibel og kan stille som tilkallingsvikar innimellom, særlig ved akutte behov. Til gjengjeld kan jeg tilby en del fleksibilitet når det gjelder arbeidstid.

Arbeidet som personlig assistent for meg innebærer at din formelle arbeidsgiver vil være Mio BPA, mens den daglige arbeidsledelsen utøves av meg. Arbeidsstedet vil være mitt hjem på Sofiemyr, som jeg deler med en liten papegøye.

Arbeidsoppgavene består i hovedsak av å bistå meg med diverse praktiske gjøremål og følge meg på ulike avtaler og aktiviteter, i tillegg til husarbeid, matlaging, ærender og diverse forefallende arbeid i hjemmet. Jeg trenger også assistanse til noe personlig pleie, men det er ingen arbeidsoppgaver av spesielt intim karakter.

Jeg ønsker å ansette deg som er svært ansvarsbevisst og har høy arbeidsmoral, og som kan være både fleksibel og pålitelig. Som min assistent er det viktig at du har god praktisk sans og kan ta i et tak. Du må også være serviceinnstilt, effektiv, selvgående og trives med varierte oppgaver.

Det er et krav at du har førerkort klasse B, er en svært trygg sjåfør og komfortabel med å kjøre min SUV med automatgir. Du må også kunne kommunisere flytende eller svært godt på norsk.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Bistå med praktiske gjøremål.

  • Følge/kjøre meg til ulike avtaler og aktiviteter.

  • Husarbeid og matlaging.

  • Diverse forefallende arbeid i hjemmet.

Egenskaper:

  • Fleksibel og kan stille som tilkallingsvikar innimellom.

  • Høy arbeidsmoral og ansvarsbevissthet.

  • Praktisk anlagt og løsningsorientert.

  • Allsidig og selvgående.

  • Trygg sjåfør med førerkort klasse B (SUV m/automatgir).

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Over 18 år.

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk.

  • Førerkort klasse B.

  • Godkjent politiattest.

  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges.

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Karen Tonette Bulæg på epost karen.bulag@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. Zakres obowiązków: Do zadań osoby zatrudnionej na tym stanowisku będzie należało:
administracja platformą wirtualizacyjną VMware vSphere;
administracja systemami Windows Server (instalacja, konfiguracja, aktualizacje);
zarządzanie usługą domenową Active Directory; zarządzanie kontami, uprawnieniami oraz wdrażanie polityk bezpieczeństwa;
administracja środowiskiem Microsoft 365: użytkownicy, licencje, grupy, role, podstawowe ustawienia usług (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive);
monitorowanie działania usług (wydajność, dostępność, pojemność, logi) i reagowanie na incydenty;
udział w procesach backupu i odtwarzania (współpraca z zespołem backupu, testy odtworzeniowe);
zapewnienie drugiego / trzeciego poziomu wsparcia dla Helpdesk w obszarze Windows, AD, dostępów, stacji roboczych;
współpraca z zespołami developerskimi, sieciowymi, bezpieczeństwa, przy wdrożeniach i zmianach;
tworzenie i aktualizacja dokumentacji technicznej oraz procedur operacyjnych.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: znajomość systemu Veeam Backup & Replication (konfiguracja zadań backupu, podstawowe scenariusze odtwarzania);
podstawowa znajomość systemów Linux (praca w konsoli, administracja usługami w stopniu umożliwiającym współpracę z zespołem);
znajomość zagadnień związanych z normami i regulacjami bezpieczeństwa informacji (ISO 27001, NIS2, RODO  aspekt praktyczny w IT);
znajomość technologii firmy Fortinet (w szczególności FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiMail);
wiedza z zakresu sieci komputerowych (TCP/IP, VLAN, routing, VPN, podstawowe mechanizmy bezpieczeństwa sieciowego);
doświadczenie w pracy z systemami monitoringu (preferowany Zabbix);
doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku uczelni wyższej lub jednostek sektora publicznego.
Sposób aplikowania:
- bezpośrednio do pracodawcy
- wymagane dokumenty: Ze względu na politykę RODO, aplikacje Kandydatów pracodawca przyjmuje tylko nadesłane poprzez stronę internetową GUMed: https://praca.gumed.edu.pl/62210.html

description:
As an AI Data Annotation Specialist, you will oversee the review and management of user-generated content to ensure it meets company guidelines and quality standards. Your role involves handling administrative and operational tasks to ensure the successful moderation of content while achieving client satisfaction and adhering to company policies.

The AI Data Annotation Specialist will act as the primary point of contact for any content-related issues.

RESPONSIBILITIES

    Review videos and judge videos/accounts in accordance according to processes, policies and guidelines
    Respond to inquiries regarding Trust & Safety actions, such as abuse reports and enforcement appeals
    Liaise with different teams to ensure brand safety, monitoring social media and taking appropriate
    Actions to resolve any situations that may arise during production
    Make well-balanced decisions based on processes, policies and guidelines, using market-specific knowledge

Project overview

    Work Days: Monday - Sunday
    Project duration: 6 months
    Remote job opportunity, from any place in Poland
    Work cannot be performed from any other country

REQUIREMENTS

    Full professional proficiency in Swedish

    Great attention to details and strong analytical skills
    Fast critical thinking
    Strong time management skills
    Strong self-organization, decision making with objectivity
    Resilience - the job involves exposure to disturbing content

WE OFFER

    Multisport card

    Career development opportunities

Full or part time

Convince us with your potential!

title: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description:
Operations and technicians

Teamlead Reliability Engineers

Imagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.

With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 120,000 employees spanning 75 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.

We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.

What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

To Change What's Possible For Everyone

SENIOR NETWORK SECURITY ENGINEER (M/F/D)

Lódz, Poland | Hybrid (3-4 days onsite)

DP World, one of the world's leading logistics providers, is looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer (m/f/d) to join our European Network team in Lódz.

In this role, you will take ownership of our network security landscape across Europe, ensuring the stability, security, and continuous improvement of critical network infrastructure. You will act as a subject matter expert for network security technologies, work closely with Information Security and global IT teams, and support projects across multiple European locations. Please note that regular travel within Europe and occasional out-of-hours work are required.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Own and continuously improve the network security environment across Europe.
* Administer and enhance the Forescout NAC and network segmentation platform.
* Design, implement, and support secure LAN, WAN, Wireless, SD-WAN, and Firewall solutions.
* Manage Check Point and Palo Alto firewalls, IPS technologies, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Collaborate with Information Security teams on threat detection, investigations, and security improvements.
* Support network projects end-to-end, including design, implementation, testing, documentation, and operational support.

YOUR PROFILE

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of experience in enterprise network installation, configuration, and support.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Forescout or similar NAC/segmentation technologies.
* Strong expertise in Cisco Routing, Switching, Wireless, and enterprise networking.
* Proven experience with Check Point and Palo Alto firewall technologies.
* Fluent English (at least C1), strong troubleshooting skills, and willingness to travel across Europe.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Permanent employment with a global and growing logistics leader
* Salary: PLN 91,663 – 145,800 gross per year*
* Private medical care (LUX MED)
* Group life insurance
* Employee Capital Plans (PPK)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) supporting employees and their families
* Employment contract in an international logistics company

The final salary level will depend on the candidate's professional experience, skills, and qualifications.

title: TÉCNICO DE ENGENHARIA CIVIL
description:
Topógrafo - É o trabalhador que concebe, prepara, estuda, orienta e executa todos os trabalhos topográficos necessários à elaboração de planos, cartas, mapas, perfis longitudinais e transversais com apoio nas redes geodésicas existentes e ou nas redes de triangulação locais, por meio de figuras geométricas com compensação expedita (triangulação-quadriláteros) ou por interseção inversa (analítica ou gráfica), recorte ou por irradiação
direta ou inversa ou ainda por poligonação (fechada e compensada), como base de todos os demais trabalhos de levantamentos, quer clássicos quer fotogramétricos ou ainda hidrográficos, cadastrais ou de prospeção geológica. Determina rigorosamente a posição relativa de quaisquer pontos notáveis de determinada zona da  superfície terrestre, cujas coordenadas obtém por processos de triangulação, poligonação, trilateração ou outra.

tendentes à avaliação de quantidades de obra efetuadas, a partir de elementos levantados por si ou a partir de desenhos de projeto e sempre também com base em elementos elaborados por si. PMO Lead (Gestor de Projetos de TIC)

A Buzzvel é uma empresa de desenvolvimento de software com mais de 100 produtos digitais entregues em saúde, SaaS, retalho, hotelaria e governance. Procuramos um PMO Lead para estabelecer, orientar e melhorar continuamente a gestão de projetos.

Missão: assegurar o alinhamento dos projetos internos e de clientes com a estratégia da empresa, supervisionar o portefólio de iniciativas e otimizar a alocação de recursos em múltiplos projetos. Trabalha na dependência direta do CEO, com autonomia e participação ativa nas decisões estratégicas.

Responsabilidades:
- Liderar a equipa do PMO e desenvolver as competências de gestão de projetos, incluindo os Gestores de Clientes

- Estabelecer estruturas de governação e metodologias de gestão de projetos
- Impulsionar a otimização de recursos e o planeamento de capacidade
- Gerir relações com stakeholders ao nível executivo e implementar estratégias de gestão de risco
- Desenvolver métricas de desempenho e sistemas de reporting
- Promover a melhoria contínua e assegurar padrões de qualidade em todos os projetos
- Preparar relatórios, business cases e recomendações para a gestão de topo
- Acompanhar e gerir clientes, em particular os clientes estratégicos

Perfil pretendido:
- Licenciatura e mínimo de 5 anos em gestão de projetos ou programas, com liderança de equipas
- Metodologias de gestão de projetos, conceção e otimização de processos, gestão financeira e orçamentação

- Pensamento estratégico, atenção ao detalhe, negociação e comunicação superior

A Buzzvel adota o conceito de função ampla: nenhuma função é exercida de modo exclusivo e permanente, o que permite desenvolver novas competências e valências.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer: Ai Solution Architect (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
description:
As a Senior AI Solution Architect in our Forward Deployed Engineering team, you see the whole board before a single line of code is written. You partner directly with business leaders across Siemens to map complex challenges to existing data, design cross-platform architectures spanning cloud and enterprise systems, and make critical build-versus-buy decisions in days rather than quarters. You bridge deep technical AI expertise with systems thinking, acting as a force multiplier that enables agile engineering teams to deliver high-impact solutions reliably and repeatedly.

What we offer you:

- An attractive remuneration package- Access to Siemens share plans- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .
The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

You’ll make an impact by:

- Driving rapid solution architecture as the first technical expert in every engagement, translating complex business problems into viable technical blueprints within days. - Designing interconnected solutions across the entire enterprise landscape, leveraging SDC for workloads while integrating seamlessly with SAP, Salesforce, and cloud-native services. - Owning crucial architecture decisions regarding cost, latency, scalability, and stack selection, while documenting clear justifications for every trade-off. - Evaluating emerging AI technologies with rigorous skepticism, providing evidence-backed adoption recommendations and having the courage to say "not ready yet." - Staying actively involved in the codebase through technical spikes, prototype development, and pull-request reviews to ensure your architectures remain grounded in reality. - Designing from day one for seamless handover, establishing explicit interface contracts, evaluation harnesses, and operational runbooks so domain teams can run systems autonomously.

Your defining qualities:

- Education: You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML, or a comparable quantitative field, where a proven track record of shipped systems outweighs advanced degrees. - Experience & Skills:- You bring 8 or more years of experience in software architecture, AI/ML systems design, or solution architecture, including at least 3 years focused on complex enterprise AI solutions. - You demonstrate a robust history of customer-facing delivery and technical leadership, especially when navigating demanding or high-pressure stakeholder environments. - You posses hands-on coding capabilities in Python alongside TypeScript or JavaScript, allowing you to write production-grade code and build functional prototypes. - You provide expertise in cross-platform system design by successfully integrating disparate enterprise environments like SAP, Salesforce, and modern cloud services. - You exhibit deep knowledge of the modern AI stack, covering LLM failure modes, RAG architectures, evaluation metrics, vector stores, and prominent agent frameworks. - You bring working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, or GCP) sufficient to design scalable multi-platform workloads.
- Ways of working:- You demonstrate the critical ability to evaluate emerging technologies objectively, separate genuine value from hype, and communicate technical realities clearly. - You display exceptional live communication skills to sketch defensible architectures in real-time meetings and explain them fluently in business terms.
- Languages: You have fluent English language skills, complemented by strong German proficiency as an advantageous asset for local stakeholder engagements.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.
As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

About us
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

description: ENTIDADE EM PORTIMÃO NECESSITA DE TERAPEUTA OCUPACIONALPARA DA EQUIPA TÉCNICA. OS PRINCIPAIS REQUISITOS SÃO LICENCIATURA EM TERAPIA OCUPACIONAL; CAPACIDADE DE TRABALHO EM EQUIPA MULTIDISCIPLINAR; BOA CAPACIDADE DE COMUNICAÇÃO E RELACIONAMENTO INTERPESSOAL; SENTIDO DE RESPONSABILIDADE, ORGANIZAÇÃO E COMPROMISSO; MOTIVAÇÃO PARA TRABALHAR NA ÁREA DA REABILITAÇÃO E APOIO À PESSOA COM DEFICIÊNCIA; AS PRINCIPAIS FUNÇÕES SÃO AVALIAÇÃO DAS NECESSIDADES E POTENCIALIDADES DOS/AS UTENTES; PLANEAMENTO E IMPLEMENTAÇÃO DE PROGRAMAS DE INTERVENÇÃO TERAPÊUTICA INDIVIDUALIZADOS; PROMOÇÃO DA AUTONOMIA, FUNCIONALIDADE E QUALIDADE DE VIDA; ARTICULAÇÃO COM A EQUIPA MULTIDISCIPLINAR, FAMÍLIAS E OUTROS INTERVENIENTES; ACOMPANHAMENTO E AVALIAÇÃO DA EVOLUÇÃO DOS/AS UTENTES.

title: ENFERMEIRO DE CUIDADOS GERAIS
description:
IPSS RECRUTA ENFERMEIRO/A, PARA AS SEGUINTES TAREFAS E FUNÇÕES:
- AVALIAR O ESTADO DE SAÚDE DOS RESIDENTES E ACOMPANHAR A SUA EVOLUÇÃO,
- ADMINISTRAR MEDICAMENTOS E OUTROS TRATAMENTOS PRESCRITOS;
- EFETUAR TRATAMENTOS E CUIDADOS DE ENFERMAGEM, INCLUINDO PENSOS E CUIDADOS DE FERIDAS;
- MONITORIZAR SINAIS VITAIS, COMO TENSÃO ARTERIAL, TEMPERATURA, PULSO E GLICÉMIA;
- IDENTIFICAR ALTERAÇÕES NO ESTADO DE SAÚDE DOS RESIDENTES E COMUNICAR AO MÉDICO OU À FAMÍLIA, QUANDO NECESSÁRIO;
- ACOMPANHAR RESIDENTES COM DOENÇAS CRÓNICAS E SITUAÇÕES DE DEPENDÊNCIA;
- PRESTAR CUIDADOS A RESIDENTES ACAMADOS OU COM MOBILIDADE REDUZIDA.

REQUISITOS:
- CAPACIDADE DE COMUNICAÇÃO E RELACIONAMENTO INTERPESSOAL;
- SENTIDO DE RESPONSABILIDADE, ORGANIZAÇÃO E PROFISSIONALISMO;
- CAPACIDADE DE TRABALHO EM EQUIPA E DE ARTICULAÇÃO COM DIFERENTES PROFISSIONAIS DE SAÚDE;
- EMPATIA, RESPEITO E SENSIBILIDADE MO RELACIONAMENTOCOM PESSOAS IDOSAS E DEPENDENTES.

title: AJUDANTE FAMILIAR
description: Garantir o bem-estar, a higiene, a alimentação e a segurança dos utentes, colaborando na manutenção e limpeza das instalações da instituição para assegurar um ambiente acolhedor e funcional. As Principais Funções serão os cuidados diretos ao utente, Prestar apoio na higiene pessoal, no vestir/despir, na alimentação e na mobilidade dos utentes.; Manutenção do espaço: Efetuar a limpeza e higienização dos quartos, salas comuns, casas de banho e outras áreas da instituição; Tratamento de roupas: Recolher, lavar, passar a ferro e organizar as roupas dos utentes e as roupas de cama/mesa da instituição; Apoio ao serviço de refeições: Ajudar na preparação, distribuição e recolha das refeições, bem como na lavagem da loiça e utensílios de cozinha; Vigilância e acompanhamento: Monitorizar o estado geral dos utentes, reportando imediatamente à equipa técnica (enfermeiros, assistentes sociais) qualquer alteração de comportamento ou de saúde.

description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
description:
We are looking for an Account Manager to build long-term relationships with our customers, develop existing accounts, and contribute to the company’s revenue growth.

You will be responsible for understanding customers’ business needs, offering suitable services, coordinating commercial matters, and ensuring that customers receive a consistently high level of service.

In this role, you will
Manage and develop a portfolio of existing B2B customers.
Build strong, long-term relationships with customer representatives and decision-makers.
Understand customers’ business objectives, infrastructure needs, and future development plans.
Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional products and services.
Prepare commercial offers, quotations, presentations, and contract-related documentation.
Present the company’s services and explain their business value to customers.
Conduct commercial negotiations and agree on pricing, terms, and service conditions.
Work toward individual sales and revenue targets.
Monitor customer satisfaction, retention risks, and opportunities for account growth.
Coordinate customer requests with Technical Account Management, Support, Billing, Sales, and technical teams.
Assist with the commercial aspects of customer onboarding and service implementation.
Maintain accurate customer, opportunity, and sales information in the CRM system.
Prepare sales forecasts, account plans, and regular reports on account performance.
Follow market developments and collect customer feedback regarding products and services.
Ensure professional and timely communication with customers.
Requirements
At least two years of experience in B2B account management, sales, customer success, or business development.
Proven ability to develop customer accounts and achieve sales or revenue targets.
Experience conducting commercial negotiations and preparing business proposals.
Strong customer relationship-management and communication skills.
Ability to identify customer needs and translate them into relevant commercial opportunities.
Experience working with CRM systems and maintaining an accurate sales pipeline.
Understanding of the complete sales cycle, from identifying an opportunity to closing the deal.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple customer accounts simultaneously.
Results-oriented mindset with a high level of ownership and responsibility.
Strong presentation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
Written and spoken English at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
Fluency in Russian for communication with customers and internal teams.
Interest in technology and the ability to understand and present technically complex services.

What we offer
All equipment required for the role.
Remote work from Bratislava with the option to use our co-working space.
A compensation package consisting of a fixed base salary plus a percentage-based commission on sales.

description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Využívaj všetky hotelové služby – fitness, bazén, sauna, infrasauna – úplne zdarma, aj pre svojich rodinných príslušníkov. Pracuj v mladom a dynamickom kolektíve, kde sa budeš môcť ďalej rozvíjať. Tešíme sa na nového kolegu alebo kolegyňu, ktorý á bude s nami tvoriť príjemnú atmosféru pre našich hostí aj celý tím!

title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Ak chceš vidieť ako to vyzerá za dverami útulku, pozri si videjko: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PWIuYGiNTqE

title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe.
