title: Senior ASIC Verification Engineer
description:
Company Description

AFRY provides engineering, design, digital and advisory services. We are devoted experts in industry, energy and infrastructure sectors, creating impact for generations to come. AFRY has Nordic roots with a global reach.
Our shared principles - Results driven, Client Centric, Empowering and Accountable - guide us in how we work, grow and succeed together. Join us and unlock transitions towards a sustainable and resilient society.

Job Description

AFRY is establishing a new ASIC Verification team delivery at Ericsson, and we are looking for a Senior ASIC Verification Engineer to play a key role in this journey.
Initially, the role is strongly hands-on, where you will contribute directly to advanced ASIC verification work within Ericsson’s hardware development organization. As the assignment progresses, you will also take part in interviewing and growing the team, acting as a technical ambassador for AFRY and helping shape a high-performing verification organization.
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep technical work with team-building and leadership influence, while working at the forefront of telecom ASIC development.

Qualifications

In this role, you will:
Hands-on ASIC Verification
Develop verification test-benches from scratch for ASIC and SoC designs
Develop tests from scratch using SystemVerilog and UVM
Update and maintain existing tests for evolving designs
Develop test-bench components from scratch (drivers, monitors, scoreboards, sequences)
Update and extend existing test-bench components
Develop Verification IPs (VIPs) from scratch
Maintain and enhance existing VIPs
Integrate third-party VIPs into the verification environment
Implement SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA)
Implement functional and code coverage
Analyze coverage results, identify gaps, and create tests to achieve coverage closure

Team & Delivery Responsibilities
Act as an AFRY representative at Ericsson, building strong collaboration with stakeholders
Participate in technical interviews and candidate evaluations
Support team growth and onboarding as the delivery expands
Contribute to defining best practices, verification flows, and ways of working
Support AFRY’s long-term partnership and delivery excellence at Ericsson

Required Skills & Qualifications
Senior-level experience in ASIC/SoC verification
Strong expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM
Proven experience with:

Test and test-bench development from scratch
VIP development and integration
Assertions and coverage-driven verification

Solid understanding of digital design and verification methodologies
Experience working in Linux-based development environments
Strong communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional, multi-company teams

Meriting Experience
Verification of telecom, networking, or high-speed interface ASICs
Experience with coverage analysis and verification metrics
Familiarity with regression flows and CI environments
Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to team ramp-up
Background working in large R&D organizations such as Ericsson

Additional Information

What AFRY Offers

A key role in building a new ASIC Verification team delivery at Ericsson
Combination of deep technical work and team influence
Long-term assignment with growth opportunities
Competitive compensation and benefits
Opportunity to shape the future of telecom and silicon verification.

Apply today and be part of our dynamic team!

Welcome to submit your application, the deadline is 2026-10-31

Contact person for questions: Johan Appelqvist, Group Manager
johan.appelqvist@afry.com

We kindly ask not to be contacted by staffing and recruitment agencies or salespeople offering additional job advertisements.

At AFRY, we engineer change in everything we do. Change happens when brave ideas come together. When we collaborate, innovate technology, and embrace challenging points of view. That’s how we're making future. We are actively looking for qualified candidates to join our inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. Join us in accelerating the transition towards a sustainable future.

title: Field Application Scientist
description:
Rarity Bioscience is growing rapidly, with demand for our products higher than ever. To meet this momentum, we are looking for an Field Application Scientist to join our commercial team. This role offers an opportunity to be part of a dynamic and collaborative scale-up environment where science and innovation are at the heart of everything we do.

About The Role

You will act as the scientific ambassador for our company, empowering researchers and lab professionals to unlock the full potential of our superRCA technology. You will will be key in ensuring customer success, from delivering hands-on training, offering expert guidance, and providing professional technical support.You’ll also collaborate closely with R&D and product management to ensure that real-world customer feedback is translated into meaningful product improvements.

Key Responsibilities:

    

Support customer onboarding and provide technical training on our assays and technologies.

    

Act as the primary technical contact for customers, ensuring a smooth implementation and ongoing support.

    

Collaborate closely with R&D to channel customer feedback into product improvements and innovation.

    

Contribute to sales by demonstrating product value, supporting technical evaluations, and participating in customer meetings.

    

Help build scalable workflows, documentation, and best practices for customer success.

The role is based at our office in Uppsala Science Park, soon in Uppsala Business Park as we are moving, but will require frequent global traveling. You will report to the Sales Director and become part of a growing commercial team.

Calling this opportunity a life-changing journey might be too much, but we can definitely promise dedicated colleagues, an open work culture where collaboration is prioritized in everyday work.

Your Profile

We are looking for you who is not only technically proficient and customer-focused but also driven by a passion for empowering others. You'll be the expert guiding scientists, helping them excel in their research by serving as their trusted advisor and application coach.

Essential Qualifications:

    

MSc or PhD degree in Molecular biology, Biotechnology or related scientific field.

    

Scientifically proficient in Molecular techniques such as; RCA, PCR and Flow cytometry.

    

Previous experience from technical support and/or application science roles in an industry setting is essential.

    

Strong communication and presentation skills. Commercial mindset with a willingness to support sales activities.

    

Proactive, structured, and comfortable working independently as well as in cross-functional teams.

    

Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Why Join Us?

At Rarity Bioscience, we believe in fostering a vibrant and collaborative work environment. We have co-located all functions in a modern office in Uppsala Science Park and we regularly organize team get-togethers and off-site events to strengthen our bonds and celebrate our successes.

Please do not hesitate to reach out to Sandra Bydell Sveder, Senior Recruitment Consultant at SallyQ with questions or to get more input why joining, (sandra.sveder@sallyq.se, 0763199688).

Apply now and become a part of our mission to enable efficinet mutation detection and improve patient outcomes worldwide.

title: Nordic Key Account Manager - Wastewater
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.

About the job

Ready to make a positive impact? This is a role where you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and strengthening long-term partnerships with some of Alfa Laval's most important customers, as well as finding new opportunities with potential customers in the Nordics. You will act as our go-to person and key enabler within municipal wastewater, while also covering a selected portfolio of strategic industrial wastewater customers across the Nordic region.

The Nordic wastewater market requires dedicated ownership to strengthen customer intimacy, rebuild installed-base position, and drive both Capital Sales and Aftersales growth. You will own relationships with utilities, consultants, integrators, and selected industrial customers across the Nordics, coordinate testing activities, and drive market development.

Your primary focus will be:

    Conduct market and customer analysis and mapping to define business potential and opportunities.
    Analyze accounts and define sales strategy, including relationship management (whom to build which relationship with and why).
    Develop a 2-4 year KAM plan by segmenting customers and prioritizing.
- Develop, implement, and follow up on local sales activities for/with relevant key account(s) or markets to meet growth targets and goals.
- Plan which customer contacts should be involved, how and when, in order to move sales forward efficiently.
- Plan and execute systematic follow-up on all relevant steps in the KAM sales process to ensure that we capture all possible business.
    Proactively connect and coordinate internally with BUs and other sales managers to secure aligned customer and/or market strategies.

Success in this role requires excellent relationship-building skills combined with analytical and technical skills and, of course, a desire to win business!
You understand the importance of being visible and staying close to clients; business travel is a part of the role, approximately 60 days/year, in addition to customer visits close to your home location.

You will be part of a team of five and report to Søren Johansen, a trust-based and empowering leader who leads with clear expectations, open dialogue, and regular commercial sparring. We offer you a role where you will be given significant autonomy and accountability, supported by constructive feedback, development opportunities, and help navigating complex customer and organizational challenges.

Who are you

You actively engage and network with stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate customer needs into opportunities. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating across functions and cultures. Most importantly, you are motivated by developing strategic partnerships and delivering sustainable business growth.

What you know

We are looking for someone with experience in a similar role, who has the ability to learn and understand technical solutions and connect them to customer value, as well as being able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions and countries.

Requirements:

    A few years of relevant experience in wastewater, technical B2B sales, key account management, or business development.
    Wastewater expertise and experience with consultancies, integrators, or contractors.
    Strong stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.
    Practical CRM experience.
    Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, environmental technology, water technology, chemistry, business, or a related field is preferred. Equivalent industry experience and documented commercial results may substitute for formal education.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, in addition to a Nordic language.
    Driving licence.

Merit:

    Experience with sludge treatment, dewatering, separation technologies, public tenders, and/or municipal procurement.

Please send your application no later than October 14th, 2026.
We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!

At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in or have an established presence in Søborg/Kolding (Denmark), Lund (Sweden), Sandvika/Oslo (Norway), or Espoo (Finland).

Our commitment to integrity

title: Senior Rock Engineer
description:
Looking to shape the future of underground mining? Join us and help drive long-term mine development while contributing to the next generation of mining levels in Kiruna Mine

The sustainable transformation starts with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transition to a sustainable future. Just as we aim to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally. Do you want to help lay the foundation for the way we live and the world we build around us?

Your role

As a Rock Engineer, you will play a vital role in ensuring safe and reliable mining operations while supporting the long-term development of Kiruna Mine. You will work closely with mine planners, geologists, rock mechanics specialists, and other technical experts to provide geotechnical expertise for both current operations and future mine expansion projects. A significant part of the role involves contributing to prefeasibility studies for mining below the current main haulage level and helping to shape the future of underground mining.

in this role, you will:

    Develop and review mine layouts, ground support strategies, and geotechnical designs.
    Collaborate on mine sequencing to ensure safe and reliable production.
    Provide rock mechanics expertise to Life of Mine planning and future mine development studies.
    Assess geotechnical risks, support mine design, and evaluate monitoring and instrumentation needs.
    Deliver operational rock mechanics support through inspections, seismic monitoring, rehabilitation planning, and damage mapping.

In this position, you will combine hands-on operational support with long-term strategic development, helping shape the future of underground mining in Kiruna.

What you bring

We are looking for someone who is confident in their role, with strong analytical skills and a collaborative approach to solving complex challenges in rock mechanics and underground mining. You are an engaged and communicative team player who listens actively to others and thrives in a dynamic environment where safety, innovation, and continuous improvement are central to success.

Requirements

    Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant engineering or geoscience discipline.
    Experience working in underground mining environments.
    Experience from underground caving operations or similar mining methods.
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
    Valid B driver's license.

Meritorious

    Experience in seismic analysis.
    Experience with numerical modelling.
    Experience in project management.
    Knowledge of Swedish.

Warm welcome with your application!

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we typically do not ask for cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your competence and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Applications are reviewed continuously, so please do not wait to submit your application.

Start: Soon as possible.

Location: Kiruna

Employment type: Full-time, daytime.

title: Web Manager I Brand, Marketing and Communications | Stockholm
description:

Som Web Manager får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla EY:s digitala närvaro i Sverige samtidigt som du bidrar till att forma framtiden för vårt nordiska webbteam. Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett operativt driv med ett intresse för att leda förändring, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa resultat tillsammans med andra.





Möjligheten



Som Web Manager med placering i Sverige har du huvudansvaret för den svenska delen av ey.com och är samtidigt en del av vårt nordiska webbteam. Du kommer också att få möjlighet att påverka arbetssätt, prioriteringar och utvecklingen inom det nordiska webbteamet, med potential att successivt ta en mer ledande roll över tid.



Du blir en del av ett engagerat nordiskt BMC-nätverk (Brand, Marketing & Communications) och samarbetar med kollegor över både lands- och verksamhetsgränser. Här får du möjlighet att dela idéer, utvecklas i din roll och bidra till initiativ som gör skillnad.





Ansvarsområden



Som Web Manager spelar du en nyckelroll i att utveckla EY:s digitala närvaro i Sverige. Du kombinerar strategi, innehåll och analys för att skapa relevanta och engagerande webbupplevelser, samtidigt som du samarbetar med kollegor över Norden och globalt för att driva webbplatsen framåt. Du kommer bland annat att:



    Ha det övergripande ansvaret för den svenska delen av ey.com.
    Utveckla innehåll och användarresor som stärker varumärket och skapar värde för våra målgrupper.
    Arbeta datadrivet med analys, SEO, konverteringsoptimering och kontinuerliga förbättringar.
    Bidra till nordiska och globala webbinitiativ, projekt och utvecklingsinsatser.
    Bygga starka samarbeten med marknads-, kommunikations- och verksamhetsteam för att säkerställa en sammanhållen digital upplevelse.





Färdigheter och egenskaper för framgång



För att trivas och lyckas i rollen kombinerar du digital kompetens med ett starkt affärs- och användarfokus. Du gillar att ta ansvar, samarbeta med olika intressenter och driva förbättringar som ger resultat.





Kvalifikationer



    Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom digital kommunikation, webb, marknadsföring eller liknande område, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet av arbete med webbplattformar, digitalt innehåll eller digital användarupplevelser
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta i ett innehållshanteringssystem (CMS)
    Erfarenhet av webbanalys och datadriven optimering
    Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
    Förmåga att samarbeta med olika intressenter och driva arbete framåt





Meriterande



    Erfarenhet av Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
    Kunskap inom SEO, användarupplevelse och konverteringsoptimering
    Erfarenhet från en större eller internationell organisation likt vår
    Erfarenhet av innehållsstrategi och digitala kundresor





Som person är du



    Initiativtagande och drivande: du vågar utmana befintliga arbetssätt och driva förändring
    Strukturerad med god känsla för kvalitet
    Samarbetsorienterad och relationsskapande där du engagerar människor
    Lösningsorienterad och nyfiken på digital utveckling





Vad vi erbjuder dig



På EY kommer vi att hjälpa dig utveckla och anpassa dina färdigheter framåt utifrån en upplevelse i världsklass. Vi stärker dig i en flexibel miljö och låter dig och din kompentens blomma i en kultur som värdesätter mångfald och inkludering på en global nivå. Läs mer här.





Är du redo att “Shape your future with confidence”? Ansök idag.



Då är du varmt välkommen att söka tjänsten. Skicka in din ansökan senast den den 18e oktober 2026. Vid frågor om tjänsten kontaktar du Nicoline Sundt på Nicoline.sundt@no.ey.com. Vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontaktar Simon Aspler på simon.aspler@se.ey.com. Vi accepterar inte ansökningar eller intresseanmälningar via email.



Observera att en bakgrundskontroll kommer att genomföras som en del av rekryteringsprocessen.



På EY värdesätter vi mångfald och uppmuntrar ansökningar från individer från olika bakgrunder. Om du har frågor, behöver stöd, eller anpassning av rekryteringsprocessen på grund av en funktionsnedsättning, tveka inte på att kontakta oss på recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. Vi finns här för att stötta dig.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Sales Development Representative - SE, DK & NO
description:
Help Global Brands Get Discovered Online 📍

Are you energetic, competitive, and ready to take the next big step in your career?

PinMeTo is a fast-growing tech company helping global brands (like H&M, 7-Eleven, and Hertz) connect their physical stores with the digital world. We’re looking for a hungry Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join our HQ in Malmö.

Whether this is your first real step into B2B tech or your second job in sales, this is your entry ticket into modern SaaS sales. You don't need a master's degree in business, we value drive, grit, and the willingness to learn above all else!

Your Role

Based at our HQ in Malmö, you’ll be on the frontlines helping us expand our reach across Sweden, Denmark, and Norway.

    

Connect with Decision-Makers: Reach out to prospective clients via phone, email, and LinkedIn to spark curiosity about PinMeTo.

    

Book High-Value Meetings: Qualify leads and schedule meetings for our senior sales team (Account Executives).

    

Research & Target: Identify exciting multi-location brands and map out key contacts in your target markets.

    

Learn from the Best: Get continuous coaching and training through our internal Sales Academy to build your sales toolkit.

Who Are You?

    

Fluent Swedish: You will lead professional business conversations in Swedish.

    

Strong English: You’re confident collaborating in English with international colleagues and clients.

    

Hungry & Self-Motivated: You have high energy, a strong work ethic, and a winning mindset.

    

Background in Sales: Experience in phone sales (B2C), telemarketing, telecom, or insurance sales is a huge plus! You know how to pick up the phone and handle objections.

    

Resilience: You don't get discouraged by a "no", you see it as just a stepping stone to the next "yes".

    

Bonus points: Fluent or proficient in Danish or Norwegian, as you will also be reaching out to prospective clients in these markets.

Why Start Your Career at PinMeTo?

🚀 Build a Solid Foundation: You’ll gain hands-on experience in B2B SaaS sales, mastering tools and methodologies that will set you up for long-term success in the tech industry.

📚 Continuous Learning: We invest in your personal development with hands-on coaching, clear feedback, and training through our internal Sales Academy.

🌍 Great HQ in Malmö: Work alongside ambitious, international colleagues in an open, high-energy environment.

🍕 Fun Culture: We celebrate wins together, support each other, organize team activities, and make sure work is something you look forward to every day.

Hiring Process
    

Intro Call: A quick video meeting to get to know each other.

    

Onsite Interview: Meet the team at our Malmö HQ and get a feel for the workplace.

    

Offer: Welcome aboard! ⭐️

Ready to kickstart your career in tech sales? Send us your CV in English today, we interview candidates continuously! 🧡

PinMeTo was founded in 2013, when location data of most companies was outdated, inconsistent or simply missing on services like Google, Facebook and Apple. The vision was to provide a solution that enables brands with multiple locations to connect with their customers, outperform their competitors and thrive. Since then we have grown to 100+ employees located in 8 countries, helping 1,000+ companies manage 125,000+ locations worldwide. Trusted by enterprise companies like H&M, 7-Eleven, and Hertz, PinMeTo stands as a leading player within the local search and marketing technology industry.

title: Director Corporate Affairs, Circular Economy, Nature and Packaging Policy
description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Director Corporate Affairs – Circular Economy, Nature and Packaging Policy, for a strategic advisor role to lead policy stakeholder engagement and strategic partnerships in this area and to develop and drive development and deployment of the global Tetra Pak policy toolbox related to circular economy, nature and packaging policies.

In this role you will be part of the global Corporate Affairs team working closely with our Packaging Solutions business unit, our Corporate Affairs markets team of 20+ professionals as well as in our Sustainability and Communications teams and other business units. As Director Corporate Affairs – Circular Economy, Nature and Packaging policy, you will report to the Vice President Corporate Affairs and you will have a team of two collaborating with you in the internal and external activities in these policy areas.

Position can be based in selective Tetra Pak locations in Europe.

You may be required to travel 20% of your time globally.

What you will do

As Director Corporate Affairs – Circular Economy, Nature and Packaging Policy, you will:



    Monitor global policy and regulatory developments in the relevant policy areas as well as emerging trends, and assess issues with potential business impacts within; propose response strategies and solutions and inform business decisions.
    Innovate on models, initiatives and strategies to engage in circular economy related policies and practices in support of business strategy, R&D and innovation.
    Lead internal governance and regulatory risk readiness on circular economy, nature and packaging policies ensuring that relevant functions understand the emerging policy changes and are equipped to take action based on this.
    Lead Corporate Affairs collaboration with the Packaging Solutions Business Unit, Development and Technology, Supplier Management, Sustainability Operations, Corporate Sustainability and Communication teams in areas of circular economy, nature and packaging policy and preparedness.
    Build and manage relationships with policy stakeholders – especially at global level- including multilateral organizations, thinktanks and civil society while positioning Tetra Pak as partner and solution provider for positive change within the area of circular economy, nature and packaging.
    Lead and coordinate global and/or regional advocacy campaigns and external positioning with government bodies and policy stakeholders; identify external opportunities and platforms to lead strategic collaboration and deploy thought leadership.

Technical knowledge of packaging materials, packaging and recycling is a strong asset.

title: Postdoc Researcher in Resilient Edge Computing for Critical Infrastructure
employer: RISE Research Institutes of Sweden AB
description:
The Project

This position is part of CIRES (Critical Infrastructure Resilience through Edge Computing Systems), a European research project funded under the Chips Joint Undertaking. CIRES addresses a fundamental and urgent challenge: how to design distributed digital infrastructures that remain operational, secure, and trustworthy under failures, cyber attacks, degraded connectivity, and large-scale disruptions.

Modern critical infrastructure increasingly relies on tightly coupled edge computing, distributed communication networks, and cloud coordination. While these architectures offer autonomy and scalability, they also introduce complex failure modes and new attack surfaces. CIRES develops next-generation resilient edge-cloud architectures with a focus on secure communication, distributed coordination, adaptive service continuity, and rapid recovery under adverse conditions.

The project brings together leading European research institutes, universities, and industrial partners, offering an opportunity to address scientifically challenging distributed systems problems while contributing to technologies that safeguard essential societal infrastructure.

About the Role

As a postdoctoral researcher in CIRES, you will develop network and system mechanisms that keep critical infrastructure services running when connectivity and power are degraded or disrupted. The work combines protocol and architecture design with implementation and experimental validation in real environments, together with the project's application partners.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Designing resilient network protocols and architectures that work across connectivity conditions, from well-connected, high-capacity networks to intermittently connected, delay- and disruption-tolerant networks (DTN), and adapt to the conditions at hand

    

Applying these mechanisms so that sensors, IoT and other low-power devices, user devices, and edge systems keep sufficient communication services during disruptions to communication and power infrastructure

    

Developing methods for offloading computation between end devices, edge, and cloud based on available resources and current and predicted service needs, together with efficient data collection and caching

    

Contributing to robust AI/ML and data analysis methods that support resilient decision making when only partial data is available

    

Integrating solutions with partners' software and platforms and evaluating them in large-scale tests in real environments

    

Publishing results in leading international conferences and journals

    

Contributing to EU project deliverables and technical reporting

    

Collaborating with industrial and academic partners across Europe

You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team and engage with industrial partners to validate solutions in relevant environments.

What We Offer

This position provides a strong platform for building an internationally visible research career. Specifically, you will benefit from:

    

The opportunity to publish in leading international venues in distributed systems and networking

    

Influence over technical direction within your research area

    

Access to realistic deployment environments and industrial validation scenarios

    

Participation in large-scale European research collaboration across industry and academia

    

Exposure to the full research-to-deployment pipeline within critical infrastructure contexts

    

Career development support toward senior roles in academia, research institutes, or industrial R&D

The position is a full-time, fixed-term appointment for two years, starting as soon as possible, designed to support your career development. You will gain experience in large-scale European collaboration, applied research in critical infrastructure, and direct interaction with industrial stakeholders. Travel is included in the role, primarily within Europe, with an estimated 3-4 international trips per year for consortium meetings, workshops, and conferences.

Who Are You?

Requirements:

    

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field

    

Strong background in networked and distributed systems, for example network protocols, wireless or IoT networking, or edge computing

    

Experience in system design and experimental evaluation

    

Demonstrated ability to publish scientific research

    

Strong programming skills (e.g., Python, C/C++, or equivalent)

    

Excellent written and spoken English

Meriting:

    

Experience with EU-funded research projects

    

Experience with robust or distributed AI/ML, for example federated learning

    

Experience with delay- and disruption-tolerant, opportunistic, or mesh networking

    

Familiarity with containerization, virtualization, or distributed deployment environments

    

Experience with computation offloading, caching, or edge resource management

    

Experience with testbeds or real-world deployments, including low-power IoT devices

    

Familiarity with semiconductor or embedded hardware platforms

    

Experience collaborating with industrial partners

Personal qualities:

We are looking for a researcher who combines intellectual rigour with practical systems thinking. We value:

    

Strong analytical capability and independent problem-solving

    

Ability to drive research forward with initiative and self-leadership

    

Collaborative mindset in multidisciplinary, international environments

    

Clear and structured communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

    

Curiosity, technical depth, and motivation to work on challenging problems with real-world relevance

title: Project Manager Internal & External Logistics

In this role, you will help develop and optimize internal logistics operations, including warehousing and picking, as well as external logistics processes such as consolidation and distribution. title: Full Stack Engineer

Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.

MUI (Material-UI) based front-end components

    

E2E testing frameworks like Playwright

What’s in it for You?

title: Master Thesis: Reimagining Outdoor Experiences for Diverse Audiences
description:
Dometic is a global market leader in the mobile living industry. Millions of people around the world use Dometic products in outdoor, residential, and professional applications. We are on a growth journey – now looking for our next star – a passionate Master's Thesis student with a strong interest in human-centered design, user research, and innovation. Exploring new opportunities and transforming insights into impactful product experiences. You bring creativity, analytical thinking, and a drive to tackle complex challenges.

About the position

As a Master’s thesis student collaborating across Group Sustainability, Global Design, and Global Marketing, you will investigate how product design, consumer insights, brand positioning, and strategic partnerships can make outdoor products and experiences more accessible, relevant, inclusive, and desirable.

Women will serve as the primary research focus and starting point for uncovering overlooked needs and barriers. The ambition is not to design exclusively for women, but to translate these insights into inclusive solutions with broader market relevance. Building on recent Design for Inclusion research, consumer insights, and market segmentation, you will turn research findings into actionable recommendations for future product concepts, experiences, marketing strategies, and collaboration opportunities.

    Duration: Planned for 6 months (Spring Semester)
    Team: Open to 1 or 2 students working together

Your main responsibilities

    Conduct qualitative and quantitative user research with diverse user groups, with a particular focus on women, to understand needs, preferences, experiences, and barriers to outdoor participation. 
    Evaluate current outdoor gear and translate research findings into clear, actionable recommendations for product design, accessibility, and user experience. 
    Develop messaging and brand recommendations that help make outdoor experiences more relevant and welcoming to a broader audience. 
    Benchmark how leading brands address inclusiveness and collaborate with Dometic specialists across sustainability, design, marketing, and inclusive design to identify future product, partnership, and innovation opportunities.

What do we offer?

You will join a dynamic, fast-paced global environment with access to real-world data, consumer insights, and industry specialists across Group Sustainability, Global Design, and Global Marketing. Primary mentorship will be provided by our Senior Industrial Designer who is part of the Global Design team.

This multidisciplinary setup offers a complete 360-degree view of how a global company transforms user insights into tangible product and brand innovations. Your research will directly inform and influence Dometic’s future product roadmap.

Suitable Background

We are looking for candidates with a solid foundation in user research, product design, or innovation management, along with:

    Industrial Engineering and Management, Industrial Economics and Management, Technology and Innovation Management, or Technology-based Entrepreneurship.
    Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, preferably with a focus on design engineering, product development, or product management.
    Industrial Design with focus on user experience, consumer research, or another relevant discipline.
    Academic or practical experience in qualitative user research, such as interviews, surveys, usability testing, or structured feedback analysis, with the ability to translate findings into actionable recommendations.

To be successful in this role, we believe that you possess the following skills, competencies & characteristics:

    A genuine interest in the outdoors and hands-on experience with camping-related products, together with a strong drive to make outdoor activities more enjoyable and welcoming for everyone.
    A basic understanding of inclusive design and how products and experiences can be made more accessible.
    The ability to build trust with diverse or underrepresented user groups and uncover genuine, sometimes unstated, needs.
    Curiosity, analytical thinking, strong communication and collaboration skills, and the drive to take ownership of the research scope and navigate ambiguity.

Dometic's Core Values

To thrive and succeed in this role, you understand the importance of our core values – Together We build our future, We play to win, We embrace change and We walk the talk; these values reflect the heart and soul of Dometic and they define what it takes to work here and how we do things.

Dometic is a global outdoor technology company dedicated to making mobile living easy. Leveraging our core expertise in cooling, heating, power and electronics, mobility and space optimization, we enable more people to connect with nature and enjoy a greater sense of freedom outdoors. We do this by designing smart, sustainable and reliable products with outstanding design. Millions of people worldwide use our solutions while camping or exploring nature in RVs, boats and cars. Our portfolio includes installed products for land vehicles and boats, as well as standalone solutions for outdoor enthusiasts.

We employ approximately 7,000 people globally and sell our products in more than 100 countries. In 2025, we reported net sales of SEK 21 billion (USD 2.3 billion) and are headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

Lindab is looking for a Strategic Supply Chain Developer to join our Group Strategic Supply Chain team. The role combines inventory management with group-wide supply chain analytics and development, offering the opportunity to work with both operational improvements and strategic initiatives. You will report to the Strategic Supply Chain Manager and work closely with the Inventory Manager & Data Analyst. The role will be divided approximately equally between Inventory Management and Strategic Supply Chain Analytics and can be based in either Grevie or Malmö.

About the role

As a Strategic Supply Chain Developer, you will transform data into reliable analytical and operational solutions, actionable insights and recommendations that support better business decisions. You will work with information from different companies, business systems and supply chain functions, covering areas such as inventory, sourcing, manufacturing, warehousing, transportation and distribution.

Within Strategic Supply Chain Analytics, you will contribute to group-wide analyses of Lindab's supply chain footprint and product flows. This includes understanding where products are purchased, produced, stored and sold, identifying opportunities for improvement and support in implementation of these opportunities. You will collaborate with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Operations, Purchasing, Sales and IT.

Within Inventory Management, you will analyse performance and support Lindab companies in developing their processes, systems and ways of working. Together with the Inventory Manager, you will examine stock levels, availability, demand patterns, planning parameters and replenishment settings. You will also contribute to initiatives aimed at reducing tied-up capital while maintaining appropriate availability and service levels.

A central part of the role is developing analytical solutions and supportive tools for Lindab from underlying business and ERP data. You will work across the full process, from collecting, validating and structuring data to creating data and semantic models, defining business logic and developing clear reports and decision-support tools. You will also contribute to data-quality improvements, master-data development, documentation and the automation of recurring analytical activities.

Who we are looking for

We welcome candidates with strong analytical and technical capabilities and a solid understanding of supply chain, business intelligence, inventory management, logistics, or data development. You have a master’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science or equivalent in a related field.

You have strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills and are interested in how data, systems, processes and business decisions interact. You understand the principles of databases, data modelling, semantic models and business intelligence and have the ability to present complex findings in a clear and practical way. Experience in developing analytical solutions, working with ERP data or using programming and automation tools is a merit. Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English are required.

To succeed in this role

You are curious, structured and motivated by solving business problems through data and technology. You are comfortable developing complete solutions rather than only creating reports from existing models. You can move between technical development and supply chain analysis, take ownership of your work and translate complex data into practical recommendations. Comfortable working independently when needed while collaborating effectively across functions, companies, and countries. The role requires flexibility to work from both Grevie and Malmö as needed, based on business priorities and meeting requirements.

What Lindab offers

You will join Lindab's Group Strategic Supply Chain department, a central team working across companies, regions and functions throughout the organization. The department combines specialist expertise in sourcing, transportation, inventory and warehouse management. Its work includes group-wide projects, supply chain concepts and shared services, as well as the development and improvement of common processes, systems and analytical solutions.

We provide structured onboarding and education covering Lindab's organization, supply chain processes, analytical methods and ways of working. You will learn from experienced colleagues and specialists while gradually taking greater ownership of solutions, improvement initiatives and cross-company projects. This provides strong opportunities to broaden your supply chain knowledge, develop your technical capabilities and build an international network across Lindab.

Learn more about us at www.lindab.com.

Additional Information

For questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please contact:

Dag Jarlson - Strategic Supply Chain Manager, dag.jarlson@lindab.com, +46431-850 88

Selection and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

Start date: By agreement

Employment type: Full-time, permanent position

Location: Grevie or Malmö, Sweden

Lindab Group is a leading ventilation group in Europe, consisting of companies that develop, manufacture, market and distribute products and systems for energy-efficient ventilation and a healthy indoor climate. We aim to be the most attractive workplace in the industry, built on responsible values regarding sustainability, innovation, and diversity.

title: Post-doc position at the Center for Migration and Integration at SSE
description:
About the Center for Migration and Integration Research

The Center for Migration and Integration Research (CMIR), housed at the SSE House of Governance and Public Policy (GaPP), aims to create a platform to support the sustainable integration of third-country nationals in Sweden. Together with key stakeholders in the migration and integration process, experiences and insights are researched and incorporated into a systemic perspective. The Center emphasizes the importance of the collaboration of multiple stakeholders in the governance of migration and integration, at multiple levels, and focuses not only on employment, but also on other dimensions of sustainable migration and integration. The research team collects, creates, and disseminates multiple-actor, science-based knowledge on the governance of migration and integration in Sweden for societal and social sustainability.  

About the position

As a postdoctoral researcher, you will be expected to independently and together with the other researchers contribute to:

    Conducting and publishing original research aligned with the Center’s thematic focus and scholarly ambition.  
    Collaborating with fellow researchers on interdisciplinary projects  
    Participating in the scholarly community through conferences and workshops
    Participating in the Center’s multistakeholder activities, e.g., workshops, roundtables, and dialogue forums  
    Translating research findings into formats that are accessible to external audiences.

Your profile

The successful candidate will have built a research agenda during their PhD, as evidenced by publications, and are keen to extend methodological and theoretical expertise in the broad field of migration and integration. Their general disciplinary background should be within the social sciences, preferably with a legal, economics or business focus connected to the fields of migration and integration. The center is led by the Center Director, Associate Professor Lin Lerpold, together with the Scientific Director, Professor Laurence Romani.

As a candidate, you thrive in a research environment directed towards impact, that is, a multidisciplinary and multi-paradigmatic environment where research aims at making contributions to both academic knowledge and a more sustainable society. You are open, considerate, and sympathetic to different research disciplines and paradigms such as positivist, interpretivist, and critical. You have strong qualities in both research and outreach communication activities.

While successful candidates are expected to master either qualitative or quantitative  methods, knowledge of and the ability to use both are a merit. Though research aims to be published in high-ranking international journals, an interest in the Swedish context within the larger EU frame, as well as sufficient reading and oral communication in Swedish is necessary. Beyond basic academic research, the successful candidates will be expected to contribute to, and participate in, the Center’s multistakeholder activities as well as communicate their research in policy and practitioner briefs.

The applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment and show an ability and ambition to publish manuscripts in highly ranked, international scholarly journals. To be eligible, applicants must have obtained their doctoral degree within the three years preceding the date of employment. This period may be extended only where special circumstances apply. Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) is a requirement, while full proficiency in Swedish is an advantage. We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm.

How to apply:

Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest October 30th, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application:

    A curriculum vitae
    A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings).
    Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5)
    Evidence of stakeholder engagement, for example copies or links to blogs, opinion pieces, podcasts, LinkedIn posts
    Names and contact information for three people willing to provide references.

We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before October 30th, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around January 2027. The employment is postdoctoral employment of up to 18 months.

For further questions on the positions, please contact Lin Lerpold: lin.lerpold@hhs.se or Laurence Romani: laurence.romani@hhs.se. For HR-related questions, contact Ellen Falkenström: ellen.falkenstrom@hhs.se.  

About the Stockholm School of Economics

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer - Network Security (CISSP)

description:

Join our Cyber Security Engineering unit, where innovation and security drive us. We are transforming technology with modern Network Security, integrations and cloud services. We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer to join our Network Security Engineering team. This role involves architecting, designing, implementing, and maintaining robust security measures to protect our global network infrastructure. The ideal candidate will blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on expertise. This role requires a deep understanding of cybersecurity principles, Network Security technologies, and the ability to collaborate across multiple globally dispersed stakeholders and teams.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

    Lead the development, optimization and integration of network security policies, rules and monitoring across platforms such as NDR, SSE, SD‑WAN and proxy solutions
    Design and improve network security solutions across branches, stores and data centers, ensuring strong alignment with business and security needs
    Conduct security architecture reviews, risk assessments and threat modelling, and drive hardening initiatives across our network landscape
    Modernize network security by transitioning from legacy systems to modern SSE and ZTNA solutions, supported by clear roadmaps, policies and plans
    Monitor and enhance the performance, availability and reliability of network security solutions, ensuring compliance with ISO, NIST, GDPR and internal standards
    Design, configure and troubleshoot network security devices and services across on‑prem and cloud environments, providing advanced Level‑3 support when needed

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You’ll join a friendly and collaborative Network Security Engineering team of seven, soon to be eight, working closely with colleagues across Business Tech. Your daily partners will include network SMEs, Cyber Security Advisors, Core Platforms and Global Infrastructure Services, as well as teams supporting stores, warehouses and new market entries. You’ll also connect with external partners and contribute to cross‑functional projects where network and cyber security come together. This is a highly collaborative environment where your expertise will help shape our security posture and uplift the team’s cyber maturity.

WHO YOU ARE

    6+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering, with a focus on network environments
    Strong, practical knowledge of: Network security technologies (firewalls, IDS/IPS, SWG, SASE, VPN, CASB, ZTNA), Cloud platforms: Azure, GCP, Security architecture methodologies and governance frameworks
    Expertise in network security solutions and products provided by Cisco, HP Aruba, Zscaler and Citrix NetScaler (proven by certificates)
    Strong knowledge of risk assessment and security control frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST).
    Familiarity with security maturity models including C2M2
    Excellent ability to translate security requirements into implementable engineering solutions.
    Strong understanding of IP networking and protocols, including IPsec, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, and QoS.
    Understand regulatory and compliance requirements (GDPR, PCI-DSS, Schrems, etc.).
    Independent problem-solving, addressing complex security challenges with minimal supervision.

Preferred qualifications:

    CCNP (Security) or higher-level certifications such as the CCIE.
    CISSP or OSCP security certifications.
    Azure Security Engineer, or GCP Security Engineer certification.
    Experience with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Jira/Confluence)

WHO WE ARE

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

Benefits

    Work-life balance, 30 days’ vacation and wellness allowance 4000 SEK/yearly
    Access to Benify, for discounts on e.g. Gym memberships, travel, hotels and many other great deals.
    Compensation boost during parental leave

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

Inclusion & Diversity

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organization. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. title: Intensive Care Nurse for the ICU, Torsby Hospital
description:

We are looking for an ICU Nurse for a full-time position (100%).

As an ICU Nurse, you will provide advanced care to patients with a wide range of diagnoses and with threatened or confirmed failure of vital functions. In this role, you will monitor vital parameters and, when necessary, respond to changes in the patient's condition.

You will work as part of a team together with an assistant nurse and an anaesthesiologist. If a patient's condition changes during your shift, you will support one another and work together as a team. The work is varied and challenging and provides opportunities for continuous learning every day.

Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for a registered nurse with at least three years of professional experience in intensive care, or a relevant specialist qualification in intensive care.

Personal qualities are important to us. We are looking for someone who is confident, reliable, and highly motivated. You are able to work independently, take initiative, and are prepared to act based on your professional assessment.

We value strong teamwork and communication skills, flexibility, and a strong commitment to quality. You are proactive and eager to contribute to the continued development of our services.

Your benefits as an employee

At Region Värmland, we have an important mission. We are here to help everyone in Värmland live healthy and fulfilling lives. As your employer, we therefore make sure to support and take care of you. Here are some of the benefits we offer:

All our employees are entitled to at least 25 days of annual leave. As a new employee, you also earn paid vacation from your first day of employment. We support you as an employee and create conditions for financial security throughout your working life. We offer attractive benefits and various insurance policies. We share knowledge, experience, and clear strategies to help you manage new challenges and quickly integrate into Swedish society. We also assist you and your family with the relocation and settlement process.

Read more at New to Värmland – Ny i Värmland - nyivarmland.se

Your workplace

Torsby Hospital is a small hospital in northern Värmland with a big heart for our patients and employees. We consider every employee and every department important in ensuring high-quality care for our patients.

We are known for excellent collaboration between our different departments, short decision-making paths, and close contact with hospital management.

Our Intensive Care Unit (ICU) consists of ICU nurses, registered nurses, and assistant nurses. We have a positive working environment, take pride in our work, and value one another. We offer an individually tailored induction programme based on your experience and needs.

Torsby – Small in size, big on quality of life

Torsby is an ideal place for anyone who appreciates the tranquillity of nature combined with a strong sense of community and good services throughout the municipality. Here, you can enjoy all the advantages of a smaller town while having excellent opportunities for a relaxed lifestyle in beautiful surroundings.

Read more about life in Torsby here: Torsby ENG - Värmland

title: IT Security Specialist
description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.



Your role

We are seeking a highly organized and relationship-driven IT Security Specialist to join our team at Business Area Surveillance. As an IT Security Specialist at Saab, you will work in an international context where advanced security threats, complex IT environments and high-impact business projects are part of the everyday business.

In this role, you will ensure the technical effectiveness of our Security Management System (SMS) by defining and validating the controls that secure our environment. You will be responsible for modernizing our technical oversight and bridging the gap between compliance requirements and operational reality. Acting as the primary lead for technical security validation, you will work closely with IT to provide the necessary oversight and ensure robust risk mitigation throughout the IT system lifecycle.



Your main tasks will be:

    Translate SMS and security requirements into technical standards, guidelines, and specifications.
    Turn security policies into practical technical solutions and secure system designs.
    Oversee the implementation of security controls across the IT lifecycle.
    Drive requirements for automation and digital tools to improve security monitoring and compliance.
    Validate technical compliance through reviews, audits, scans, and configuration assessments.

Preferred locations for this role are Solna/Stockholm or Kallebäck/Göteborg.



Your profile

Personal qualities are of paramount importance for this role. We are looking for someone with unwavering integrity, strong ethics, and a high level of trustworthiness. You should possess the ability to build and cultivate strong professional networks and relationships, both internally and externally.

You are a self-starter who can work independently while remaining a collaborative team player, always maintaining a focus on business and the collective result. Desired skills:

    Experience from the defense industry, government authorities, or global organizations.
    Knowledge of security tools such as vulnerability scanners, SIEM, and IAM solutions.

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

title: PhD student in ultrafast spectroscopy of organic semiconductors
description:
We are looking to recruit a PhD researcher in the group of Dr. Gillett in the Electronic and Photonic Materials division in the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (IFM). The successful applicant will work in collaboration with the Swedish company Epishine AB on a research project funded by the Åforsk Foundation that will use ultrafast optical spectroscopy to understand the degradation mechanisms of organic photovoltaics. The recruited researcher will also have the opportunity to take advantage of the state-of-the-art spectroscopy setups developed in the group to pursue their own research interests more broadly in the field of organic materials. Topics currently being studied in the group include organic photovoltaic and OLED systems, vibronic coupling in organic molecules, molecular photoswitches, circularly polarized luminescence, and photocatalysis.

Your work assignments

This project aims to understand the stability and failure mechanisms in the light-absorbing layer of organic photovoltaic devices under conditions relevant to commercial applications. To achieve this, we will take a unique approach that involves using ultrafast optical spectroscopy techniques to probe how material degradation impacts the fundamental photophysics of the organic materials that underpin device operation (see https://doi.org/10.1016/j.joule.2023.03.002 for a recent example of this approach from the group). This project will be carried out in collaboration with the Swedish company Epishine AB (https://www.epishine.com/), also based in Linköping, who are currently working on the commercialization of organic photovoltaics for indoor light harvesting applications.

You will be responsible for performing transient absorption spectroscopy measurements, spanning the visible to mid-infrared, on organic photovoltaic samples provided by Epishine AB to understand how the photophysics of these materials change after different material degradation protocols. This will be supplemented by steady-state spectroscopy measurements (UVVis, photoluminescence/PLQY, FTIR), as well as morphology and computational characterization through collaborators, to provide a complete picture of the degradation mechanism under real-world conditions. Through this, you will provide new design rules for organic photovoltaic materials that will have a direct impact on commercial applications of the technology.

In addition, Dr. Gillett strongly encourages his research group to follow their curiosity and develop their own research projects. Therefore, the successful candidate will also have the freedom to explore other topics during their PhD within the broader fields of organic materials and ultrafast spectroscopy. Through this, you will have the opportunity to develop as an independent researcher ready to pursue an academic or industrial career path.

As a PhD student, you devote most of your time to doctoral studies and the research projects of which you are part. Your work may also include teaching or other departmental duties, up to a maximum of 20 per cent of full-time.

Your qualifications

You have graduated at Master’s level in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, or related discipline, or completed courses with a minimum of 240 credits, at least 60 of which must be in advanced courses. Alternatively, you have gained essentially corresponding knowledge in another way.

In addition, the following are requirements for the role:

    Previous experience working with organic or perovskite materials.
    A high level of self-motivation and independence, good problem-solving skills, and the demonstrated ability to work in a team.
    The ability to fluently communicate in English (written and spoken).

The following requirements are not essential, but considered highly beneficial for the role:

    Previous experience working on organic photovoltaic materials and devices, including stability measurements
    Experience of independently performing ultrafast optical spectroscopy measurements, including, but not limited to, transient absorption and time-resolved photoluminescence
    Experience of working with laser systems, in particular femtosecond and nanosecond pulsed laser sources
    Good coding skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, LabView) for the development of custom code for running experiments and analysing experimental data

Finally, a letter of intent should be attached to the application covering how your background and skills make you a good match for the research project on organic photovoltaics. In addition, please provide a short description of your own research interests and a potential idea for another research project that you would like to explore in the group. Note that this doesn’t necessarily have to be in the area of organic photovoltaics.

Your workplace

You will be employed in the research group led by Dr. Alexander Gillett (https://liu.se/en/employee/alegi69), located in the Electronic and Photonic Materials Division: https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/ifm/efm. Here, you will be part of a small (currently the PI and ~5 researchers) and supportive team where the freedom to think critically and define your own research path is strongly encouraged.

The employment

When taking up the post, you will be admitted to the program for doctoral studies.

The employment has a duration of normally four years’ full-time equivalent. Extension of employment up to five years is based on the degree of teaching and institutional assignment. Further extensions may be granted in exceptional circumstances. You will initially be employed for one year, after which your employment will be renewed for a maximum of two years at a time, depending on your progress through the study plan.

Starting date by agreement.

Salary and employment benefits

The salary of PhD students is determined according to a locally negotiated salary progression.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than 5th of October 2026.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior lecturer in dairy cow management
description:
Faculty of Veterinary Medicine and Animal Science

The Department of Applied Animal Science and Welfare

Our aim is to advance responsible animal management, welfare, and sustainable food production while ensuring high product quality. Through research and education, we focus on feed and nutrition, management and environment, ethology and animal ethics, as well as animal welfare and protection.

Subject description

The subject focuses on how the housing and management of dairy cows affect their health, welfare and productivity, as well as the sustainability of dairy production. It also covers the interactions between animals, their environment, technology and people at both farm and system levels.

Duties

The applicant will be responsible for developing research and teaching within the subject area, in collaboration with other researchers at the faculty and across the university. The successful candidate will also contribute to the development of teaching and learning within the subject area.

The research can be based on controlled experiments as well as production data from commercial farms, questionnaire-based studies and modelling.

The applicant will be expected to:

    develop and lead internationally successful research;
    develop, lead and participate in teaching at first, second and third cycle level;
    primarily teach within animal sciences, in addition to other components at first, second and third cycle level covering the subject;
    develop and maintain national and international networks with academia, the relevant public authorities, industry, organisations and society at large;
    collaborate with other SLU research teams to strengthen interdisciplinary activities at the university;
    apply for external research funding from both national and international sources;
    supervise doctoral students;
    contribute to the strategic development of the department, faculty and SLU;
    communicate research findings and other relevant information to society at large;
    be able to teach in Swedish within four years;
    be able to participate in discussions with colleagues and stakeholders in the sector, as well as carry out administrative duties in Swedish, within four years.

The department uses Swedish and English in parallel. The senior lecturer should be able to perform the majority of their tasks in English. However, as a public authority, the university has Swedish as its main language according to the requirements of the Language Act and the senior lecturer must be able to use Swedish as their working language within four years of beginning the position. The department will provide support with language learning.

Eligibility

The applicant must:

    have successfully completed a doctoral degree or have the equivalent academic qualifications within a subject relevant to the position;
    demonstrate research expertise in the subject for the appointment;
    demonstrate teaching expertise and have the ability to integrate research and a scientific approach into their teaching;
    have experience of teaching at first, second and third cycle level;
    have good knowledge of English;
    have a valid driving licence for passenger car.

Assessment criteria

The assessment criteria for appointment must be the degree of expertise required as qualification for employment.

The assessment of research expertise will be based on:

    completed and ongoing research and its relevance and development potential for the faculty and department;
    the ability to independently initiate and run successful and internationally-recognised research;
    the ability to compete for external research funding;
    experience as a supervisor in doctoral education.

The following will be taken into consideration when assessing teaching expertise:

    planning, implementation, examination and assessment of own teaching;
    supervision and examination at first and second cycle level;
    ability to integrate research and scientific approaches into teaching work;
    training in teaching and learning in higher education, or equivalent knowledge acquired in other ways;
    pedagogic vision and reflection;
    documented pedagogical ability.

The following abilities will also be assessed:

    developing and leading activities and staff within academia;
    communicating and collaborating internally;
    collaborating with external stakeholders and society;
    communicating research and development work.

It is an advantage if the applicant has an established network within the sector in Sweden or internationally.

The appointment will be offered to the applicant who, following a qualitative comprehensive assessment is in the best position to conduct and develop the duties in question, and contribute to the positive development of the organisation.

Additional information

* Swedish “universitetslektor”, a tenured position approximately equivalent to Senior lecturer (UK) or Associate professor (US). The applicant who is offered this employment at SLU will be employed as Senior lecturer.

Application deadline: 2026-11-23

Place of work: Uppsala

Scope: 100 %

Form of Employment: Permanent employment.

Starting date: By agreement.

Application:

For the guidance of your application, there is SLU's appointment procedure for teachers at SLU and General assessment criteria for the appointment of teachers.

Please apply by clicking the apply-button.

title: Group IT Director

On the road to a more sustainable future, with the support of TataAutoComp Systems our owner, we are expanding our thermal management product portfolio to bring innovative solutions for a cleaner and electrical transport. In parallel, we bring our performing heat transfer technology to other segments such as off-road and industrial applications.

At TitanX every team member is relied upon to make a difference, contribute with innovative ideas and add value to the company. Our decision paths are short; we act with speed and own the outcome. We are one global team and achieve better results together.

We are looking for a Group IT Director to lead and further develop our global IT organization across TitanX.This is a key leadership role combining IT strategy with the operational needs of an international manufacturing business. You will be responsible for Infrastructure & Business Services, Operational Technology (OT), Information & Cyber Security and plant-level IT support.Working closely with the Group CDO, Operations and business leaders, you will shape the future IT landscape, strengthen IT/OT collaboration and ensure secure and reliable technology support across the Group.The role offers significant impact and the opportunity to drive the further development and transformation of IT within TitanX.

Your responsibilities

    Define and execute the Group IT strategy and roadmap together with the Group CDO, balancing long-term development with the operational needs of our manufacturing plants.
    Lead and develop the global IT organization covering Infrastructure & Help Desk, Operational Technology, Information & Cyber Security and plant-level IT support.
    Ensure reliable and secure IT operations across the Group, including infrastructure, networks, cloud services and effective day-to-day support for manufacturing and business functions.
    Develop the IT/OT landscape, strengthening the connection between corporate IT and factory systems, including MES, Industrial IoT and PLC environments, while driving the roadmap for legacy systems.
    Own the Group's approach to cybersecurity, IT risk, business continuity, disaster recovery and incident response, including cooperation with external SOC/MDR providers.
    Manage the Group IT budget, investment portfolio and strategic vendor relationships, including outsourcing/MSP partnerships and contract negotiations.
    Partner with Operations and other business functions on digitalization initiatives, ensuring effective prioritization and transition of solutions between IT, OT and Operations.
    Act as a trusted IT partner for plant management, business leaders and Group Management, while building and developing a strong global IT team.

Our requirements

    University degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent professional experience.
    At least 10 years of relevant IT experience, including significant leadership responsibility in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Proven experience leading multi-site or international IT organizations and working in a cross-cultural environment. Collaboration with teams in India would be an advantage.
    Solid understanding of IT infrastructure and Operational Technology (OT), including manufacturing environments such as MES, Industrial IoT and PLC-based systems.
    Strong understanding of cybersecurity, IT risk, business continuity and disaster recovery.
    Experience managing IT budgets, investments, strategic vendors and outsourcing partners.
    Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and senior business leaders.
    A pragmatic, hands-on mindset and the ability to balance strategic development with operational reality.
    Fluent English.

What we offer

    Stable employment in very dynamic and international automotive environment
    A key leadership role with a real impact on the Group IT strategy and future technology landscape.
    Company car
    A flexible working model, combining remote work with presence at our locations when needed.
    Good work conditions including additional benefits
    Friendly atmosphere, respect and support
