title: Global Sales Developer - Mining
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.

As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the job

Mining is an attractive growth market for Alfa Laval, driven by increasing demand for critical and base minerals and a growing focus on more sustainable and efficient mining operations. As part of our global Process Mining Separation team, you will contribute to strengthening Alfa Laval's position in the mining market by turning market knowledge, customer relationships and new opportunities into business.



As Global Sales Developer - Mining, you will work closely with customers, sales companies and colleagues across the global organization to identify where we can grow and how we can win. You will contribute your market insights and ideas to the sales strategy, develop opportunities together with the team, and help turn agreed priorities into commercial results. The role offers broad market exposure and the opportunity to help shape a growing business area without working in isolation-you will influence through knowledge, collaboration and strong relationships.



Key responsibilities include:

    

Identify and develop new sales opportunities for Alfa Laval decanters within the mining market.

    

Build and strengthen relationships with mining customers, sales companies and external partners.

    

Contribute customer and market insights to sales strategy, including target customers, applications and market priorities.

    

Work with the global team to explore and develop opportunities across different regions and technology conversion.

    

Build partnerships that support Alfa Laval's growth and position within the mining industry.

    

Follow market trends, customer needs and industry developments to identify new business opportunities.

    

Contribute to external messaging and market activities that position Alfa Laval's decanter technology as a sustainable solution for mining operations.



Who are you

You are a commercially driven and proactive person who enjoys being close to the market, building relationships and turning ideas into contracts. You are curious and open to learning, while confident enough to challenge ideas, share your perspective and stand behind your recommendations. You influence through credibility, dialogue and persuasion, and you value finding the right solution together with others rather than competing for ownership. You are comfortable working in a global team, take initiative when you see an opportunity, and maintain your drive when building a market requires persistence and patience.



What you know

To succeed in this role, you combine strong commercial understanding with a technical mindset and the ability to understand customer needs and translate them into business opportunities.

    

Several years of experience in a technical-commercial, sales or business development role in mining.

    

Strong commercial and business orientation, with a track record of developing customer relationships and sales opportunities.

    

Engineering degree or equivalent technical education.

    

Technical background, preferably within separation technologies, process equipment or a related field.

    

Knowledge and experience from the mining industry.

    

Ability to understand technical solutions and connect them to customer needs and business value.

    

Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to interact with customers, partners and internal stakeholders at different levels.

    

Fluent English. Spanish is an advantage.



What's in it for you

You will join a global team working in an attractive and evolving mining market, with significant opportunities to grow Alfa Laval's presence and impact. The role gives you broad exposure to customers, markets and sales organizations across the world, while allowing you to work alongside colleagues with deep technical and industry expertise. You will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of a growing business area and play a visible role in bringing more sustainable separation solutions to the mining industry.

description:
Are you passionate about engineering, product development, and innovative vehicle design? We are looking for a Design Specialist to join the expert team at SSAB Knowledge Service Center.

SSAB is a globally recognized leader in advanced high-strength steels, helping automotive manufacturers build safer, lighter, and more sustainable vehicles. In this role, you will work at the intersection of materials technology, structural analysis, and forming simulation to support the development of next-generation automotive solutions.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges, collaborating with customers, and using advanced simulation tools to turn innovative concepts into robust, manufacturable products.

We are seeking an experienced engineering professional with strong analytical skills, deep technical expertise, and a genuine interest in product development, structural analysis, and sheet metal forming. Location: Borlänge

Becoming part of the SSAB family means joining a journey. A journey that we believe is essential for the sustainability of this planet. Steel has been one of the most important materials for developing our society and it will continue to be so. In the roofs over our heads, in the bridges connecting our cities and in the cars of tomorrow. At SSAB we are proud of our history and leadership in high-strength steel. But we are also aware that the production of steel is one of the largest emitters of greenhouse gases in the world. That has to change. That is why we have developed the world’s ﬁrst fossil free steel production and has committed to becoming largely fossil-free. As part of SSAB you will be instrumental in realizing this goal and push for the green transformation of the whole steel industry.

About the position

As a Design Specialist, you will provide expert guidance on structural performance, forming feasibility, simulation methods, material behavior, and application development. Your expertise will help customers optimize components and structures for performance, manufacturability, and sustainability using SSAB’s portfolio of advanced steel grades.

You will focus on the mobility segment, developing conceptual designs, evaluating structural performance, and predicting manufacturing outcomes, often in close collaboration with vehicle manufacturers.

Your daily work will include structural analyses, forming simulations, material data evaluation, method development, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing.

You will join a highly skilled team of steel experts who combine deep technical expertise with strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.  

Main responsibilities

    Develop design concepts that illustrate the benifits and applications of advanced steel grades
    Collaborate with automotive customers in designing and optimizing components and body structures  
    Perform structural analyses using finite element methods (FEM) to assess structural performance and lightweighting possibilities
    Conduct forming simulations to evaluate manufacturability and process robustness
    Develop and validate simulation methodologies, material models, and engineering workflows
    Provide customers and colleagues with technical expertise in structural performance, forming processes, material behavior, and design optimization
    Develop and deliver technical training, workshops, seminars, and presentations tailored to customers and business needs



About you

    A master’s degree or higher in mechanical engineering, materials engineering, engineering physics, vehicle engineering, or a related field
    At least five years of experience in the automotive, manufacturing, or engineering industry
    Solid knowledge of and experience in structural analysis and/or sheet metal forming simulation.  
    Experience using CAE tools such as LS-DYNA, Abaqus, ANSYS, AutoForm, or PAM-STAMP
    Excellent written and spoken English



To thrive and succeed in this role, you should also:

    Communicate clearly and build strong working relationships
    Enjoy solving complex technical challenges and finding practical solutions
    See the big picture and connect technical details to broader business needs
    Contribute as a collaborative team player  



It is an advantage if you have:

    Experience in automotive product development, body-in-white engineering, crash analysis, durability, or lightweight design
    Knowledge of advanced high-strength steels and their use in automotive structures
    Knowledge of Swedish and a strong ambition to become fluent

Our offer

We offer a range of valued employee benefits, including:

    Profit sharing
    Improved work-life balance through reduced working hours
    Wellness grants

Recruitment process

    Application
    Assessments
    Interview
    Reference check
    Health examination
    Offer and contract signing

A background check may form part of the recruitment process. The health examination includes drug testing.

Questions? Contact us about this position

Email linda.petersson@ssab.com

Trade union information is provided by Akademikerföreningen, Unionen, and Ledarna, who can be reached through our switchboard at +46 243 700 00.

A message from your future manager

“At the Knowledge Service Center, our multi-site team of 25 skilled experts works closely with SSAB’s customers to develop new solutions and technologies and solve unique challenges. Every day brings new opportunities to learn, innovate, and create value.

If you are passionate about product development, structural analysis, and engineering innovation, you will find exciting challenges and great colleagues here. We look forward to welcoming you to our team.”

Linda Petersson

Head of Knowledge Service Center, SSAB Europe

title: Product Owner - Core Automation
description:
Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  


As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the job

The Incubator within Alfa Laval's Core Automation organization explores new platforms, technologies and development initiatives that shape the future of Alfa Laval's control systems offering. As Product Owner, you will turn the technology roadmap into coordinated, meaningful deliveries, from early research into new toolkits, platforms and technologies to development initiatives that will serve as the foundation for next-generation control system applications.



Working at the intersection of the Technology Manager, stakeholders and development teams, you will create clarity, align priorities and help the team move forward without unnecessary obstacles. You will translate complex needs into well-defined work items, guide initiatives across the OT platform portfolio and ensure that users, customers and their everyday challenges remain central throughout the design and development process.



Key responsibilities:

    Deliver initiatives supporting the direction in the technology roadmap for the initiatives' relevant stakeholders.

    Refine work items and translate stakeholder needs into clear user stories and backlog items.

    Maintain and prioritize the development backlog in line with agreed commitments for development, rollouts and support.

    Align stakeholders and product groups across the OT platform portfolio.

    Prepare teams for incremental deliveries by clarifying scope, setting objectives and supporting demos.

    Bring contributors together, facilitate alignment and create momentum across initiatives.

    Collaborate with the Agile Team Coach and Focus Manager to improve team performance and share effective ways of working.

    Drive product, technology and platform evaluation initiatives.



Who are you

You are passionate about turning complex needs into contemporary solutions that provide an excellent user experience. You create clarity by listening carefully, structuring information and communicating in a way that helps stakeholders and technical teams understand one another. You are comfortable orchestrating several perspectives, aligning people around priorities and keeping initiatives moving without imposing unnecessary processes. With strong business acumen, analytical thinking and a customer-centric mindset, you are also able to build trusted relationships across teams, departments and organizations.



What you know

To succeed in this role, you combine practical Agile experience with an understanding of product management and complex operational technology environments.

    2-4 years of experience as a Product Owner or Scrum Master.

    Solid understanding of product management and complex OT solutions.

    Strong knowledge of Agile development methodologies.

    Experience working with product roadmaps, backlog prioritization and user stories.

    Experience aligning stakeholders and development teams around shared objectives.

    Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, data science or equivalent experience.

    Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

    Knowledge of control systems, embedded software or electrical design deliveries is appreciated but not required.



What's in It for You?

You will join a highly motivated team working with the latest OT technologies while developing solutions that have not been built before. This is an opportunity to influence Alfa Laval's future automation offering, work across technology and product domains, and help transform early ideas and research initiatives into solutions that create value for our customers and users.



We are conducting a continuous review of received applications.

We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Please send your application no later than October 4th, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long!

At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Lund or Flemingsberg, or have an established presence in the area.

As part of Alfa Laval's commitment to a safe and healthy workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role, and alcohol and drug testing is applied during the pre‑employment process.

title: Customer Support Engineer
description:
Ready to find your path? Try new things. Share experiences. And discover what you truly enjoy!

Welcome to a dynamic and innovative work environment, with great opportunities for professional growth and development.

Your role

As a Customer Support Engineer at Saab, you will be the first point of contact for our customers, providing exceptional support and ensuring their needs are met efficiently. You will work closely with our design department, acting as the bridge between our customers and our technical experts.

Responsibilities:

    Act as first-line support for customers, gathering all necessary information to create clear and comprehensive cases for our second-line support team.
    Provide post-installation support to ensure our customers' systems are running smoothly.
    Utilize the Saab Customer Support Portal to provide solutions and follow-up on customer-initiated support cases.
    Ask the right questions and gather all relevant information to facilitate effective problem-solving.



Your profile

If you are passionate about customer support and see a future at Saab, we want to hear from you! We see this role as an entry point at Saab with possibilities to grow and develop further in our organization. A strong interest in technology and advanced systems and a will to learn is therefore an important part of your personality.

Qualifications:

    Recent graduate with a university degree within relevant area.
    Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
    Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
    Enthusiasm for a career in customer support and a desire to grow with Saab.



This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 28,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

title: Global Regulatory & Public Affairs Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to: R&D Sustainability, Compliance and Quality Manager.

As Global Regulatory & Public Affairs Specialist, you will drive regulatory intelligence, stakeholder engagement, and advocacy activities that support compliance, business continuity, and growth. In this highly visible role, you will monitor regulatory developments, assess business impacts, and help shape strategies that align global regulatory requirements with ABB's business objectives.

Our division, IEC LV Motors, holds a market‑leading position by delivering exceptional customer value in efficiency, reliability, and safety - the attributes most valued by our customers and partners. Our strength lies in deep domain expertise and a strong global presence, combined with an unwavering commitment to sustainability, quality, reliability, and safety. Our commitment is to empower our customers with innovative solutions that drive productivity and enhance energy efficiency through our unmatched application expertise and technology leadership, delivering tailored solutions and a first-class customer experience.  The outcome of your work will have a direct impact on our division.

You will work closely with colleagues across R&D, Product Management, Sustainability, Trade Compliance and Supply Chain, while also representing ABB in industry associations, technical forums, and discussions with policymakers and regulatory stakeholders. Your work will contribute to positioning ABB as a trusted voice and thought leader in key regulatory and standards-related topics.

Main Responsibilities

    Monitor and assess international, regional, and national regulatory developments affecting the IEC Low Voltage Motors business.
    Develop and maintain a regulatory landscape map and strategic roadmap aligned with divisional business priorities.
    Analyze regulatory risks and opportunities, communicate impacts to stakeholders, and recommend actions to ensure compliance and business readiness.
    Represent ABB in relevant industry associations, regulatory working groups, and external stakeholder forums, advocating for the division's interests.
    Collaborate across multiple functions to provide regulatory guidance and support product, technology, and business decisions.
    Develop and deliver awareness and training initiatives that strengthen regulatory knowledge and promote a culture of compliance.

The position is based in Sweden (Vasteras), Finland (Vaasa) or Germany (Mannheim). We offer a hybrid working model; however, the role requires regular on-site presence at the local office.

Qualifications

     Several years of experience working with regulatory affairs, standards development, public affairs, compliance, or related fields in an international environment.
    Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks, standards organizations, and how regulations impact industrial products and technologies.
    Proven ability to influence and collaborate across functions and with external stakeholders, including industry associations, government agencies, and policymakers.
    Experience from the industrial, manufacturing, automation, motors and drives, or comparable sectors is highly valued.
    Degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Political Science, International Studies, or another relevant discipline.
    Fluent English communication skills are required. German language skills are a strong advantage and highly desirable.

More about us

The IEC Low Voltage Motors division is a technology leader, offering a complete portfolio of IEC low‑voltage motors, from standard to highly specialized solutions, including ultra-efficient solutions such as IE5 SynRM (synchronous reluctance motors). Through a global production footprint in Finland, India and China, domain expertise and rugged designs, the Division provides reliable technology that improves efficiency and productivity even in the most demanding applications.

Hiring Manager Santanu Singha +46 76 791 00 19 will answer your questions about the position. All other questions can be directed to Talent Partner Robert Norén +46 72 461 20 95.

We look forward to reading your application in PDF format. Please note that the interview process is ongoing, apply now to secure your spot in the recruitment process!  Last day to apply is 19th of October.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Quality Assurance Engineering Leader
description:
Hej QA Engineering Leader,

Do you want to furnish the future with innovative solutions?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, discover new tech possibilites, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. As our QA Engineering Leader, you’ll have many opportunities to try things you’ve never done before.



Your new job

We’re looking for a QA Engineering Leader who wants to solve complex, real-world problems to make life at home simpler. Join us on our journey as we level up our technology to enhance everyday experiences. Your primary focus will be on leading and continuously refining the quality and test automation approach within Range experience together with the other Software Engineering Leaders and Specialists.  

You will also be sharing your work in the wider Range Areas and you’ll report to the Quality Platform QA Manager. The impact of your work will touch homes and hearts around the world.

On a typical day, you will:

    Develop QA test plans and define acceptance criteria for both built and purchased software solutions.  
    Plan, coordinate, and lead QA activities to ensure testing is executed effectively and delivered on time.  
    Coach and mentor members of digital product teams on QA frameworks, methodologies, and best practices.  
    Drive clarity, consistency, and quality in requirements across product and platform teams.  
    Champion test data creation, mocking, and test automation as the preferred testing approach, always balancing cost, value, and efficiency.  
    Provide coaching and constructive feedback to engineering and platform communities to strengthen quality practices and a quality-first mindset.  
    Collaborate closely with engineering and platform leaders to ensure features are implemented with quality assurance built into the delivery process.  
    Support product and platform teams in working in a decoupled way to improve software quality and enable effective interface-level testing.  
    Act as the subject matter expert on specialist QA disciplines such as performance testing, penetration testing, and high-availability assurance when needed.  
    Support Engineering Managers in follow-ups, reviews, and quality discussions with consultancy partners.

What we’d like you to bring to the table

As a person you see the joy of sharing your knowledge and experience with your colleagues across different teams. Being curious and innovative is at the core of everything you do, and you know that making mistakes sometimes is part of your own development and learning journey.

You bring extensive experience and knowledge in software development and are fully familiar with agile/DevOps practices and tooling, and how the quality aspect is an integrated part of the development. Ideally, you have experience in building test automation frameworks and building their usage in an organization of cross-functional product teams.

You are an experienced leader with the ability to coach our product teams, testers and developers alike around test automation as an integrated part in software development, helping to ensure that we use our resources in the best way to achieve the strongest outcome.

You enjoy an agile, iterative and structured way of working and achieving results together with a team in a flexible environment but also have a strong individual drive to deliver high-quality results on time. You have great communication and networking skills and are fluent in written and spoken English.

The role as a QA Engineering Leader requires you to:

    Hold a degree in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent experience.  
    Have at least 2 years of hands-on software engineering experience.  
    Have at least 5 years of hands-on experience working with QA processes, testing methodologies, and QA tooling.  
    Demonstrate strong knowledge of modern digital product development principles, including aligned autonomy, Conway’s Law, product decomposition, DevOps, automation, blue-green deployments, and automated regression testing.  
    Coach and support engineering teams in adopting quality-first ways of working and embedding quality throughout the development lifecycle.  
    Advocate for early defect prevention through practices such as automation, clear requirements, and decoupled architectures.  
    Communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels, both verbally and in writing.  
    Be a trusted subject matter expert in quality assurance, providing guidance on specialist QA approaches when needed.  
    Have experience of building and maintaining modern test automation frameworks for web using Playwright, Cypress or similar, including custom framework design in JavaScript/TypeScript with deep CI/CD integration via GitHub Actions

It’s a plus if you also have experience with:

    Using Sentry, Splunk or similar tools for monitoring and real-time error tracking
    Procurement processes and quality assurance of off-the-shelf or SaaS solutions.  
    Non-functional requirement (NFR) quality assurance and performance testing practices.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 8th of October.

This is a full-time position located in Malmö (Hyllie). We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact the recruiter vera.bendz1@inter.ikea.com.

This position is based in the QA Platform of Inter IKEA Range Operations. Business platforms are new at Range and will support products to be more efficient.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organisational changes. For this specific recruitment priority will be given to impacted co-workers in IKEA of Sweden and Inter IKEA Technology Services AB, provided competence requirements are met for the role.

title: Embedded Software Engineer - C/C++, Linux & Embedded Systems
description:

We are now expanding our teams and are looking for Embedded Software Engineers with strong foundations in C/C++, Linux, and low-level systems development to support both customer projects and internal product development.

What You Will Do

    Work with MCU-level development (Bare Metal and/or RTOS) depending on project context
    Contribute across the full product lifecycle – from concept and design to production and maintenance
    Collaborate closely with hardware, software, and product teams in cross-functional environments
    Participate in system design, debugging, testing, and performance optimization
    Work with resource-constrained systems and low-level programming

    Experience with MCUs, RTOS, or bare-metal programming
    Experience working in product development environments (from concept to production)

    Structured, problem-solving mindset with a strong technical curiosity

Meriting Experience

    Experience with networking protocols and Linux-based systems
    Development of Linux drivers or low-level system components
    Experience with Yocto or custom Linux distributions
    Background in cybersecurity, functional safety, or safety-critical systems

    Experience with Python or scripting for automation
    Swedish Citizenship and Security Clearance

Why Multiply & VisFlow

    Work on advanced embedded systems across multiple industries
    Combine hands-on development with structured engineering and compliance
    Be part of long-term, technically challenging assignments
    Opportunity to work with both customer projects and product development (VisFlow)
    Flexible and competence-driven environment with strong technical depth

title: Senior Projektledare
description:
Om Multiply & VisFlow

Multiply är ett teknikdrivet end to end solution provider som verkar i gränslandet mellan avancerad mjukvaruutveckling, systemdesign och datadrivna plattformar. Tillsammans med VisFlow – vår egen produkt för strukturerad, visuell och spårbar teknisk kunskap – hjälper vi organisationer att bygga, driva och vidareutveckla komplexa system inom säkerhetskritiska och dataintensiva domäner.

VisFlow omvandlar komplexa tekniska processer, systemflöden och operativ kunskap till tydliga, visuella och sammanlänkade representationer. Plattformen gör det möjligt för team att förstå, förvalta och skala avancerade system genom hela livscykeln – från utveckling och införande till drift och kontinuerlig förbättring.

Rollen

Multiply är ett teknikdrivet konsultbolag som verkar i gränslandet mellan avancerad systemutveckling, mjukvara och komplexa industriella miljöer. Vi arbetar med uppdrag där struktur, tillit och genomförandekraft är avgörande – ofta i säkerhetskritiska sammanhang.

Vi söker nu en Senior Projektledare för uppdrag inom försvarsindustrin, där du får ett tydligt mandat och ett stort ansvar att leda komplexa projekt från start till mål.

Om rollen

Som senior projektledare ansvarar du för helheten i projektleveransen. Du leder och samordnar projektteam, skapar tydlig struktur och säkerställer framdrift i alla projektets faser – från initiering till avslut. Rollen kräver stark kommunikativ förmåga, hög integritet och vana att arbeta nära både styrgrupp och operativa team.

Ansvarsområden

    Leda och samordna projektteam i komplexa miljöer
    Engagera och inspirera team mot gemensamma mål
    Planera, organisera och följa upp projektets samtliga faser
    Rapportera tydlig och korrekt status till styrgrupp och intressenter
    Kommunicera effektivt med interna och externa parter
    Säkerställa rätt förutsättningar och arbeta proaktivt med hinder
    Identifiera, mitigera och rapportera risker
    Dokumentera och strukturera beslut, åtgärder och lärdomar
    Bygga starka relationer och långsiktigt förtroende
    Leda styrgruppsmöten och säkerställa rätt stöd vid rätt tid

Kvalifikationer

    Minst 10 års erfarenhet i ledande roller, varav flera år som projektledare
    Dokumenterad erfarenhet från försvarsindustrin
    God förståelse för arbete i säkerhetsklassade miljöer
    Godkänd säkerhetsprövning (krav)
    Mycket god förmåga att skapa struktur, driva beslut och leverera resultat

Varför Multiply & VisFlow?

Hos Multiply blir du del av en end-to-end-leverantör där djup teknisk kompetens, systemtänkande och långsiktigt värdeskapande står i centrum. I kombination med VisFlow erbjuder vi inte bara projekt, utan ett produkt- och kunskapsekosystem som hjälper organisationer att förstå och förbättra komplexa system över tid.

Denna roll innebär spännande perspektiv och betyder att du kommer jobba med:

    Tekniskt djup – inte förvaltning
    Långsiktighet och stabilitet
    Arbete med system som har direkt betydelse för nationell säkerhet
    En miljö där erfarenhet, struktur och ingenjörsmässighet värderas högt

Hos Multiply arbetar du i sammanhang där systemförståelse, tekniskt ledarskap och långsiktigt tänkande verkligen spelar roll, tillsammans med mycket erfarna ingenjörer i krävande och meningsfulla tekniska miljöer.

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python/DevOps) - Hybrid
description:
Senior Backend Developer (Python/DevOps) -Hybrid, Stockholm

The company is a Nordic-Baltic venture studio founded in Stockholm in 2016. They work hands-on with both startups and larger enterprises to build digital products — investing in and building companies, rather than just consulting. Employees get the opportunity to invest in the portfolio companies and share in the upside if there's an exit. The culture is described as entrepreneurial and ownership-driven, with a focus on work-life balance — working close to founders and core teams where decisions are actually made, rather than off a backlog.

Are you an experienced Backend or Fullstack Developer who enjoys bridging the gap between robust code and cutting-edge tech? Do you want the unique possibility to invest in the next generation of tech startups while building large-scale solutions? Then you might be the right fit for us!

Location: Stockholm (Onsite/Hybrid)

Our Vision & Mission

Our vision is to be the ultimate partner for building the tech companies of the future. We transform innovative ideas into thriving businesses. As an employer, our goal is to provide an environment where technical excellence meets entrepreneurship, and where your personal growth drives our collective success.

Your Impact: Builder & Investor

You are more than a developer; you are a builder and an investor,

    Strategic Growth: Gain deep business acumen by working across both the startup ecosystem and the enterprise world.
    Ownership & Equity: We combine the impact of high-level consulting with the strategic upside of venture capital. Through our unique model, you gain ownership in the companies we support, becoming a shareholder in our diverse portfolio of over 35 ventures.
    The Investment Council: No matter your current project, you are always a core part of us. You’ll for example have the opportunity to join our Investment Council and help decide which companies we back next.
    AI Landscape: We encourage initiative and provide the space to turn your curiosity about AI/ML into real-world growth.

The Role: Tech & Innovation

You will join our Tech Forum, a collaborative group of experts (Fullstack, DevOps, Architects) dedicated to high-quality code and modern solutions.

    Core Backend: Design and develop scalable systems primarily in Python with frameworks such as django, flask or fastapi.
    DevOps & Infrastructure: Take ownership of CI/CD pipelines and cloud environments using GCP (preferred), AWS, Docker, and Terraform.
    Dynamic Projects: Toggle between high-stakes projects, moving seamlessly from building products from the ground up to solving complex challenges for large enterprises.

Culture & People

Our culture is built on our values: Adventurous, Caring, and Inspiring.

    Community: We are a dog-friendly office that loves spending time together through Hackathons, After Works, and communal lunches.
    Balance: We respect that everyone is in different stages of life. Your well-being and work-life balance are top priorities.
    Growth Mindset: We offer a dedicated education budget and a clear path for career progression.

Who You Are:

    Experience: 5-7 years of professional backend or fullstack development.
    Technical Stack: High proficiency in Python (e.g., Django, flask, fastapi)
    Cloud infrastructure: Preferably GCP or AWS.
    DevOps: CI/CD Pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) (e.g. Terraform, Ansible), Microservices containerization (e.g. Docker/Kubernetes)
    Consultancy Mindset: You have experience working as a consultant or across various projects and thrive in the journey from Startup to Enterprise.
    Business Acumen: You are interested in the "why" behind the code and how it creates value.
    Language: Fluent in Swedish and English.

AI - No need to be an expert, but a keen interest with some experience:

    Agent-Native: You integrate AI agents and autonomous workflows as a natural part of your backend architecture and infra-stack.
    Master of Tools: You’ve moved beyond simple chats. You leverage Cursor, Copilot, and advanced agents to accelerate delivery without ever compromising on code quality.
    Scalable AI: You know how to build and grow AI features in a fullstack environment while keeping the system stable and fast.

Nice to Have:

    Frontend: Experience or interest in collaborating with our experts in React/Next.js.
    Startup Experience: Experience building products from scratch.

Ready to be more than just a developer? Apply now and help us build the next generation of successful companies, regardless of the project.

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

You will be employed directly by the company. You will receive information about which company the advertisement refers to when you are in contact with the recruiter. Bumbli Group is therefore not the employer but the recruitment agency.

Welcome to submit your application!

Bumbli Group is part of House of Recruitment — a personal, traditional and quality-driven recruitment agency in Gothenburg.

title: AI - Data Engineer - Hybrid
description:
AI - Data Engineer, Stockholm - Hybrid

The company is a Nordic-Baltic venture studio founded in Stockholm in 2016. They work hands-on with both startups and larger enterprises to build digital products — investing in and building companies, rather than just consulting. Employees get the opportunity to invest in the portfolio companies and share in the upside if there's an exit. The culture is described as entrepreneurial and ownership-driven, with a focus on work-life balance — working close to founders and core teams where decisions are actually made, rather than off a backlog.

We are looking for a Senior Data / AI Engineer to design, build, and scale modern data platforms and AI-driven solutions. You will operate at the intersection of data engineering, analytics engineering, and applied AI - leveraging robust data pipelines and transformation workflows to enable advanced analytics, machine learning, and emerging AI agent use cases.

This role is especially well-suited for someone with a strong consulting background who is comfortable working in client-facing environments, translating ambiguous business requirements into structured, production-ready data and AI solutions.

Do you want the unique possibility to invest in the next generation of tech startups while building large-scale solutions for mid-to-large enterprises?

Then we might be the right fit for you!

Location: Stockholm (Onsite/Hybrid)

Your Impact: Builder & Investor

You are more than an engineer; you are a builder and an investor.

    Ownership & Equity: We combine the impact of high-level consulting with the strategic upside of venture capital. Through our unique model, you gain ownership in the companies we support, becoming a shareholder in our diverse portfolio of over 35 ventures.
    The Investment Council: You’ll have the opportunity to join our Investment Council and help decide which startups we back next.
    AI Strategy & Workshops: Beyond pure engineering, you will help our internal AI Forum on the business side - conducting workshops and identifying AI possibilities for our mid-to-large size clients.

The Role: Tech & Innovation

You will join a collaborative group of experts dedicated to high-quality code and modern solutions. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Software Engineering and Advanced Data Science.

Technical Requirements

Must-haves:

    Consulting Experience: 6-7+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering, with a strong track record in consulting, professional services, or client-facing project work. Proven ability to manage stakeholder expectations and deliver solutions in dynamic environments.
    Expert-level dbt: Deep experience in modular data modeling, including macros, custom materializations, and version-controlled SQL.
    Production-grade Python: Ability to write clean, reusable code (not just scripts) using testing frameworks like pytest and dependency management.
    Modern Cloud Warehousing: Senior-level expertise in BigQuery or Snowflake, with a strong focus on architecture and performance optimization.
    Data Engineering Best Practices: Experience implementing CI/CD for data, data quality monitoring, and automated testing.

Preferred skills:

    AI & LLM Foundations: Experience with Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector) and building data pipelines for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
    Advanced Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect for complex workflow management.
    Distributed Processing: Experience with Apache Spark (PySpark/Scala) for handling large-scale, decentralized data.
    FinOps Mindset: A track record of monitoring and optimizing cloud compute costs and warehouse spend.
    MLOps: Familiarity with Vertex AI or similar platforms for managing the machine learning lifecycle.
    Semantic Layer: Experience defining metrics and business logic via the dbt Semantic Layer or MetricFlow.

Culture & People

Our culture is built on our values: Adventurous, Caring, and Inspiring.

    Community: We are a dog-friendly office (Barkend developers welcome!) that loves spending time together through Hackathons, After Works, and communal lunches.
    Balance: We respect that everyone is in different stages of life. Your well-being and work-life balance are top priorities.
    Growth Mindset: You own your trajectory: we simply provide the space and resources for you to master new tech, sharpen your business acumen, and evolve far beyond just your technical field.

Ready to build the future of AI and data with us?

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

You will be employed directly by the company. You will receive information about which company the advertisement refers to when you are in contact with the recruiter. Bumbli Group is therefore not the employer but the recruitment agency.

Welcome to submit your application!

Bumbli Group is part of House of Recruitment — a personal, traditional and quality-driven recruitment agency in Gothenburg.

title: Work from Home: Norwegian-Speaking Customer Service Representative  Sikom
description:
Transcom is currently recruiting for our subsidiary, Xzakt, and we are looking for a Norwegian-speaking Customer Service Representative to join the team in Gävle, working from home anywhere in Sweden.

Are you passionate about delivering outstanding customer service while working alongside great colleagues in a modern office with hybrid work opportunities? Then you could be our next team member at Xzakt Gävle!

We are looking for a customer-focused and service-minded individual who enjoys helping people and has an interest in sales. At Xzakt, we believe your engagement and ambition should be rewarded with opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.

What We Offer

At Xzakt, you'll have the opportunity to develop your professional skills while growing both personally and professionally. We provide a paid onboarding and training program to ensure you have the knowledge and tools you need to succeed.

In addition, we offer:

    Work remotely from your own home
    Collective agreement and occupational pension
    Wellness allowance
    Rikskortet employee benefit card for savings on groceries and restaurant purchases
    Career development opportunities within a global company

About the Role

As a Customer Service Representative, you will provide support for our client, Sikom, handling incoming phone calls and emails from customers using heating control solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Providing technical support
    Answering invoice and billing questions
    Guiding customers to the products that best suit their needs
    Delivering an excellent customer experience through professional and solution-oriented service
    Identifying customer needs and recommending relevant products or services through consultative sales

You will have a high level of responsibility while always receiving support from experienced colleagues and clear processes. We work in a fast-paced environment where teamwork is key.

Position: Customer Service Representative (CSR)

Working hours: Scheduled weekdays between 08:00–16:00

Employment rate: 94% permanent contract, with 6month probation time

Employment type: Work from Home

Start date: 12th of October 2026

About You

We are looking for someone who is curious, communicative, and genuinely enjoys working with people. You are flexible, adaptable, and comfortable presenting different options and solutions to customers. You are patient, goal-oriented, and motivated by personal development and continuous learning.

To succeed in this role, you should have:

    Fluency in Norwegian, both spoken and written
    Fluency in English, both spoken and written
    Good technical understanding and interest in technology
    A completed high school diploma or equivalent
    Have a reliable high-speed internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace suitable for working from home.

Previous experience in customer service and/or sales is considered an advantage but is not required.

About Xzakt

Xzakt is part of the Transcom Group, a global leader in customer experience (CX) solutions. As a specialized customer service provider, Xzakt combines the agility and close-knit culture of a local organization with the resources, expertise, and international opportunities of a global company.

At Xzakt, we are passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences by delivering high-quality support across a wide range of industries. We invest in our people through comprehensive training, continuous development, and clear career paths, empowering our employees to grow both personally and professionally.

Being part of the Transcom Group gives our employees access to global best practices, innovative technologies, and career opportunities within an international organization, while still enjoying the collaborative and supportive environment that defines Xzakt. Together, we are committed to helping our clients build stronger relationships with their customers through outstanding service.

title: People & Production Manager - Material & Delivery
description:
Are you ready to lead a major production organisation and play a key role in shaping the future of one of Sweden's leading manufacturing businesses? At DOVISTA, you'll have the opportunity to drive operational excellence, develop leaders and make a lasting impact in an international industrial environment.

<img src="https://sae3ndp007.blob.core.windows.net/swe/4aa67c38-b348-4a74-81f8-9b8225ef9e06.jpg">

Your Opportunity

We are looking for a strong people and operations manager to take responsibility for our Material & Delivery operations, a critical part of our window manufacturing business. Leading approximately 200 employees through a team of six first-line managers and two process developers, you will play a key role in driving performance, strengthening the organisation and ensuring operational excellence across the organisation.

This role offers the opportunity to take responsibility for a large production area and make a significant impact on people, culture and operational performance. Whether you currently manage a production department, a manufacturing unit, or a sizeable operational team, you are motivated by driving results through others and developing strong leadership teams.

You will work closely with our Senior Director, Head of Operations Sweden, and be part of the production management team, contributing to both strategic direction and operational execution. This is a visible leadership position with significant responsibility and the opportunity to make a lasting impact on people, performance and culture. With around 600 colleagues at our Edsbyn site, you'll join a growing team in a company that's shaping the future.

Who You Are

You have a solid background in manufacturing or industrial operations and a track record of creating results through people, structure and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking responsibility for a larger operation, setting clear expectations, and creating accountability at all levels of the organisation. Just as important, you know how to engage people, develop talent and build a culture where performance and collaboration go hand in hand.

We believe you have:

    Proven experience from a manufacturing or industrial environment.
    Experience building strong teams and creating results through others
    A track record of driving operational improvements and delivering results
    Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
    A university degree in engineering, production, operations, or a related field, or equivalent experience gained through a successful leadership career in manufacturing.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
    To be considered for this position, you must hold a permanent work permit in Sweden.

Why Edsbyn?

Choosing to live and work in Edsbyn means embracing balance. You'll find proximity to nature, space for family life, and a welcoming community - all while making a real impact in a globally connected business. For the right person, this role offers a rare combination of significant leadership responsibility, long-term career opportunities, and a high quality of life in one of Sweden's most scenic regions.

Application

This recruitment is managed in collaboration with Jefferson Wells. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Recruitment Consultant Marjo Carlson at +46 70 377 06 64 or marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se.

Please submit your CV and a cover letter explaining your interest in the position and how your background, experience, and qualifications make you a strong fit for the role.

Please note that we do not accept applications via email. To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted through our recruitment system.

Apply as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-10-17.  Selection is ongoing, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.

About DOVISTA

DOVISTA is a leading European provider of vertical windows and exterior doors. With 13 distinctive brands and approximately 7,000 employees across 10 markets, the Group is locally strong and internationally connected, driven by a shared purpose to bring daylight and fresh air into people's everyday lives.

DOVISTA is built on a heritage rooted in Danish design, an entrepreneurial mindset and industry knowledge dating back to 1941. The company is part of the VKR Group and is wholly owned by VKR Holding A/S, a family- and foundation-owned company that includes a grant-giving Employee Foundation. Together, the VKR Group employs approximately 17,600 people in 38 countries.

About DOVISTA Sweden

DOVISTA Sweden brings together well-known brands such as Svenska Fönster, Mockfjärds Fönster, and VELFAC with local experts within a strong international group.

With approximately 700 employees, we are one of Sweden's leading window manufacturers. Together, we develop sustainable, high-quality solutions with a focus on our customers and the future.

title: Thesis project: Pallet perception through deep learning and sensor fusion
description:
Develop methods using deep learning models to improve the current pallet perception system, with a focus on fusing model outputs with data from other sensors. The main focus will be on general pallet identification and localization.

In your Master Thesis at Toyota, you will work on:

A modern sensor system featuring:

    2D RGB camera
    Time-of-Flight (ToF) 3D camera
    Correlation between pixels from the RGB camera and points in the 3D point cloud from the ToF camera
    NVIDIA chip in an embedded environment (GPU) for data processing

Tasks include:

    Training and evaluation of deep learning (DL) models using different methodologies
    Algorithm development for data fusion
    Evaluation using real-world data and comparison with training results from a synthetic environment

At Toyota, we work with innovative technologies to develop our autonomous trucks. The thesis project will investigate training methodologies, model architecture, and the selection of suitable model outputs that can be effectively combined with point cloud data to accurately localize a pallet in relation to the camera position. The training data will be generated in synthetic environments, which will be provided as part of the project. Therefore, the gap between synthetic and real-world data will also need to be considered when evaluating the results. The thesis project will be carried out in close collaboration with one of Toyota's teams specializing in machine learning development.

SCOPE
Master thesis 30 hp, 1-2 students

Requirements
For this master thesis, we are looking for students with following education or equivalent:

    3D Computer vision
    Deep learning specialization / Machine Learning specialization

Who is Toyota Material Handling?
Toyota Material Handling is a global leader in material handling, and we are making significant investments to meet the needs of the future. At our site in Mjölby, 3,000 employees work across the entire material handling value chain, from development concepts to finished vehicles. Our product range spans from manual hand trucks to autonomous vehicles and innovative energy solutions.

At Toyota Material Handling, we strive to create a friendly, safe and forward-thinking workplace. Our culture is built on Toyota's core values, where respect and consideration guide us in our daily work. Our ambition is to strengthen our competitiveness by increasing diversity across the organization and embracing our differences.

Start
January 2027

Your application:
Your application is individual. If you plan to do the master thesis together with another student, please specify name of that person. Latest date for application 2026-11-01.

Your application can be written in English or Swedish.

If you have any questions, please contact:

    Josefin Nilsson, HR, josefin.nilsson@toyota-industries.eu

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie 80-100% für die Region Schinznach gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Schinznach sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Schinznach

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Schinznach

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Schinznach liegt im Kanton Aargau und besticht durch seine zentrale Lage in der Schweiz mit ausgezeichneter Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Sie profitieren als Arbeitnehmerin oder Arbeitnehmer von der Nähe zu größeren Wirtschaftszentren wie Aarau und Baden. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Umfeld mit hoher Lebensqualität, günstigen Immobilienpreisen gegenüber städtischen Gebieten und gleichzeitig kurzen Pendlerwegen zu etablierten Unternehmensstandorten.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie in Schinznach

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie in Schinznach verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplom-Pflegefachpersonen in der Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie in der Region Schinznach zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage. Spezialisierte Fachkräfte sind gesuchte Profis, die von etablierten Arbeitgebern gezielt akquiriert werden. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler dabei, passende Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum zu finden und den Einstieg in spezialisierte Einrichtungen zu vereinfachen. Durch unser Netzwerk zu regionalen Kliniken und Instituten profitieren Sie von besseren Chancen auf eine schnelle und qualifizierte Platzierung.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Schinznach

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Kinder- und Jugendpsychiatrie in Schinznach

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie jederzeit auf med-ipersonal.ch.

***À propos de l'entreprise***  
*L'identité de l'entreprise reste confidentielle. Cette opportunité est proposée à titre exceptionnel aux entreprises suisses clientes de JobCloud, à condition qu'elles puissent démontrer à JobCloud l'existence d'un besoin légitime de confidentialité (par exemple, pour des raisons organisationnelles ou stratégiques). Dans ce cas, le nom de l'entreprise n'apparaît pas dans l'offre d'emploi. L'entreprise est seule responsable du processus de recrutement et du respect de la réglementation en matière de protection des données. Elle révèle, à sa seule discrétion, son identité au cours du processus de recrutement.*



Pour le compte d’une entreprise genevoise active dans le domaine de la sécurité et des solutions techniques, nous recherchons un Responsable Technique afin de renforcer son équipe et d’assurer la gestion, la coordination et le suivi de ses activités techniques.

candidat idéal dispose d’une solide expérience dans le domaine de la sécurité, du courant faible ou des installations techniques, ainsi que de bonnes compétences en gestion d’équipe, en organisation et en résolution de problèmes. Une expérience confirmée dans les systèmes d’alarme, de vidéosurveillance, d’interphonie et de contrôle d’accès est fortement souhaitée.



**Responsabilités :**

* Superviser et coordonner les activités techniques de l’équipe.
* Planifier et organiser les installations, mises en service, maintenances et interventions techniques.
* Assurer le suivi technique des projets et des installations auprès des clients.
* Contrôler la qualité des travaux réalisés et veiller au respect des normes et procédures de sécurité.
* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problématiques techniques complexes sur les installations existantes.
* Apporter un support technique aux collaborateurs et les accompagner dans la résolution des problèmes rencontrés sur le terrain.
* Participer à la configuration, à la mise en service et à la maintenance des systèmes d’alarme, de vidéosurveillance, d’interphonie et de contrôle d’accès.
* Coordonner les interventions avec les clients, fournisseurs et partenaires techniques.
* Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus et des solutions techniques.
* Assurer le suivi administratif et technique des interventions et des projets.




**Exigences :**

* Formation professionnelle dans un domaine technique : électricité, électronique, informatique, télécommunications ou domaine similaire.
* Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine de la sécurité, du courant faible ou des installations techniques.
* Expérience confirmée dans la gestion ou la coordination d’une équipe technique.
* Très bonnes connaissances des systèmes de vidéosurveillance, Genetec et Milestone un plus, Sytèmes d’alarmes et contrôle d’accès.
* Solides compétences en réseaux IP et infrastructures informatiques.
* Excellentes capacités d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes techniques.
* Sens de l’organisation, autonomie et capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.
* Excellentes compétences en communication et aisance dans les relations avec les clients et les collaborateurs.
* Permis de conduire valable.
* De très bonnes connaissances en allemand et en anglais oral constituent un plus.




**Conditions :**

* Salaire compétitif selon l’expérience et les compétences.
* Véhicule de fonction, téléphone et carte essence fournis.
* Environnement de travail dynamique au sein d’une entreprise genevoise spécialisée dans les solutions de sécurité.
* Casier judiciaire vierge.


Si vous êtes un professionnel expérimenté, organisé et passionné par les technologies de sécurité, et que vous souhaitez évoluer vers un poste à responsabilités au sein d’une entreprise genevoise, nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Berufsbildung 80-100% für die Region Thalwil gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Thalwil sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Berufsbildung.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Thalwil

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Berufsbildung

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Thalwil

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Thalwil liegt malerisch am Zürichsee und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direkter S-Bahn-Verbindung nach Zürich. Die Region bietet Ihnen als Arbeitsort eine ideale Kombination aus ländlicher Ruhe und urbaner Nähe, kombiniert mit hoher Lebensqualität. Die Nähe zur Natur, das attraktive Umfeld am See sowie die gute Infrastruktur machen Thalwil zu einem besonders beliebten Arbeitsstandort in der Region.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Thalwil

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Berufsbildung

Der Schwerpunkt dieser Stelle liegt in der Berufsbildung: Sie begleiten Lernende durch ihre Ausbildung, planen Lernangebote und nehmen Qualifikationen ab. Denn wer Nachwuchs stark macht, prägt die Pflege von morgen. Didaktisches Flair ist hier ebenso gefragt wie Fachkompetenz.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Thalwil verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachfrauen und Pflegefachmänner HF/FH in der Region Thalwil ist äußerst dynamisch und bietet hervorragende Chancen. Die Nachfrage nach qualifizierten Fachkräften ist aufgrund des demografischen Wandels und der steigenden Patientenzahlen in Kliniken, Pflegezentren und Spitälern kontinuierlich hoch. Sie profitieren von attraktiven Positionen mit flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent und branchenüblichen Löhnen. Als etablierter Vermittler vereinfacht iPersonal Ihnen den Einstieg durch ein gezieltes Matching mit geeigneten Arbeitgebern, umfassende Beratung und die Übernahme administrativer Aufgaben.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Thalwil

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv

- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Thalwil

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

- Ihre neue Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Berufsbildung in Thalwil wartet – zudem beraten wir Sie gerne zu weiteren Stellen als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH in Ihrer Region.

Manager de Programme \- Secteur Public \- Cybersécurité (H/F/X)
=================================================================







Groupe de conseil international fondé en 2019, Ekkiden anime un écosystème de consultants passionnés et engagés qui mènent des projets de transformation organisationnelle, opérationnelle et technologique dans l'IT/Digital, l'Industrie/R\&D et la sustainability, chez les grands comptes et PME, en , Suisse, Espagne et Allemagne.



Manager de Programme \- Secteur Public \- Cybersécurité (H/F/X)
=================================================================



rôle :
-------





Nous recherchons un(e) Directeur(trice) de programmes / Program Manager Senior disposant d'une solide expérience dans le pilotage de programmes complexes et stratégiques, acquise notamment au sein du secteur public.



Vous prenez en charge la structuration, la gouvernance et le pilotage de programmes impliquant de multiples projets, parties prenantes et dépendances. Vous assurez une vision consolidée des enjeux, des risques, des ressources, des budgets et des échéances et accompagnez les instances de direction dans les arbitrages nécessaires.



Les programmes concernés évoluent notamment dans des environnements IT, de transformation et de sécurité de l'information. Une expérience en cybersécurité, protection des données ou conformité constitue donc un atout, mais le cœur du rôle reste avant tout le management de programmes.



Responsabilités :
------------------



**Pilotage de programmes complexes**



*      Prendre en charge le pilotage global de programmes stratégiques composés de plusieurs projets et chantiers interdépendants.

  

*      Définir et structurer la gouvernance, les objectifs, les jalons, les livrables et les indicateurs de performance.

  

*      Piloter les budgets, ressources, plannings, risques, dépendances et priorités à l'échelle du programme.

  

*      Maintenir une vision consolidée de l'avancement et anticiper les écarts, risques et points de blocage.

  

*      Identifier les arbitrages nécessaires et accompagner les instances décisionnelles dans leur prise de décision.

  

*      Garantir la cohérence et l'alignement des différents projets avec les objectifs stratégiques du programme.

  



**Gouvernance et coordination**



*      Mettre en place et animer les instances de gouvernance, comités de programme et comités de pilotage.

  

*      Coordonner un large éventail de parties prenantes : directions métiers, IT, experts, responsables de projets, partenaires externes et sponsors.

  

*      Produire des reportings consolidés à destination du management et des instances décisionnelles.

  

*      Assurer une communication claire sur l'avancement, les risques, les décisions et les priorités.

  

*      Définir et faire appliquer les méthodes et standards de gestion de programme.

  



**Gestion des risques et transformation**



*      Identifier, évaluer et suivre les risques à l'échelle du programme.

  

*      Piloter les plans d'actions et mesures correctives nécessaires.

  

*      Accompagner les transformations organisationnelles liées aux programmes.

  

*      Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes, outils et processus de pilotage.

  



**Environnements sécurité et conformité**



Selon les programmes concernés :



*      Collaborer avec les équipes en charge de la sécurité de l'information, de la protection des données et de la conformité.

  

*      Intégrer les contraintes réglementaires et de sécurité dans le pilotage des programmes.

  

*      Faciliter la coordination entre experts techniques, métiers et instances décisionnelles.

  



**Ce que nous recherchons :**
-----------------------------



**Expérience**



*      Expérience senior et significative en tant que Program Manager, Directeur de programmes ou fonction équivalente.

  

*      Expérience démontrée dans le pilotage de programmes complexes et stratégiques, au\-delà de la gestion d'un projet individuel.

  

*      îtrise de la gouvernance de programmes comportant plusieurs projets, équipes et parties prenantes.

  

*      Expérience significative dans le secteur public ou auprès d'administrations / organismes publics.

  

*      Habitude de travailler avec des instances de direction et de gouvernance et de gérer des environnements comportant de nombreuses parties prenantes.

  

*      Expérience du pilotage de budgets, ressources, risques, dépendances et indicateurs de performance.

  



**Compétences clés**



*      Excellente maîtrise du management de programme et du pilotage multi\-projets.

  

*      Très bonnes compétences en gouvernance, planification et gestion des risques.

  

*      Capacité à structurer et piloter des programmes dans des environnements complexes.

  

*      Excellentes capacités de communication, de présentation et d'influence auprès d'interlocuteurs de tous niveaux.

  

*      capacité d'analyse, de synthèse et d'aide à la décision.

  

*      îtrise des méthodologies et outils de gestion de projets et programmes.

  

*      Capacité à coordonner des équipes et parties prenantes multidisciplinaires.

  



**Atouts appréciés**



*      Certification HERMES et expérience pratique de la méthodologie HERMES.

  

*      Expérience dans le secteur public suisse.

  

*      Expérience dans des programmes liés à la cybersécurité, à la sécurité de l'information, à la protection des données ou à la conformité.

  

*      Connaissance des principes et standards de gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information.

  

*      Expérience en conduite du changement et transformation organisationnelle.

  

*      Connaissance des environnements Agile.

  



**Qualités personnelles**



*      Leadership et capacité à fédérer.

  

*      Excellente capacité de coordination et de priorisation.

  

*      Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.

  

*      Orientation résultats.

  

*      Capacité à prendre de la hauteur tout en assurant un suivi opérationnel rigoureux.

  

*      Autonomie et force de proposition.

  

*      Excellente capacité d'adaptation.

  

*      Résilience et aisance dans des environnements complexes et fortement structurés.

  



Certifications :
----------------



**Particulièrement appréciée :**



*      HERMES

  



**Autres certifications en gestion de programmes/projets appréciées :**



*      PgMP (Program Management Professional)

  

*      PMP (Project Management Professional)
